Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.  

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

The responsibilities of our Platform team include building and maintaining all backend services, including, but not limited to, payments, analytics, subscriptions, new products, text to speech, and external APIs.

This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast-paced environments, is passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount. 

Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week.

title: (Senior) Collection Merchandiser Shoes (f/m/d)
description:
What you will do:

As the (Senior) Collection Merchandiser for the Shoes category, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the strategic direction of the footwear assortment. 

This role requires a deep understanding of luxury fashion, strong collaboration skills, and the ability to drive innovation while maintaining the brand's identity. You will work closely with the design, product development, sales, marketing, and operations teams to create a cohesive and successful shoe collection that meets the needs of both direct-to-consumer (D2C) and business-to-business (B2B) channels.

Assortment Strategy:

  • Develop and implement a long-term assortment strategy for the Shoes category, aligning with the brands product vision and catering to the unique requirements of D2C and B2B channels.
  • Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and consumer insights to inform strategic decision-making.
Collection Creation:
  • Lead the seasonal collection creation process for Shoes, working in close partnership with the design and product development teams.
  • Ensure the collection reflects the brand's DNA, resonates with target customers, and meets commercial objectives.
  • Own the range and the line plan and ensure they are constantly updated.
Critical Path Management:
  • Own the critical path for the Shoes category, ensuring all key milestones and deadlines are met.
  • Schedule and coordinate all relevant meetings, ensuring appropriate stakeholders are involved and prepared.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:
  • Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to develop compelling campaigns and product stories that enhance the visibility and desirability of the Shoes category.
  • Work with sales teams to gather feedback from wholesale partners and clients, ensuring their needs are reflected in the assortment.

Vi har ansvaret for alt fra udvikling af ruter til udlejning af butikker og spisesteder, parkering, kommunikation og den samlede passagerrejse.  Du bliver en del af Passenger Journey Development. Vi er et team på 11 personer med forskellige faglige kompetencer inden for forretningsudvikling, service excellence, monitorering og kvalitetsopfølgning og CX, som deler en fælles passion for at udvikle og forbedre passagerrejsen. Du anvender også din forståelse for sammenhængen af det fysiske og digitale rum. description: Business Operations Manager | Palmerston North      Ready to make a real impact in a growing local business?     Auto Interiors Ltd is a well-established, family-owned Palmerston North business with a strong reputation for quality workmanship and genuine customer service.     We’re looking for a commercially minded, customer-focused person to become a key part of our business and help us improve the way we operate.     This is a hands-on role combining customer service, quoting, workflow management, financial administration and business improvement.     We’re not simply looking for someone to keep the office running. We’re looking for someone who can help make the business run better. As the business continues to grow, we want to strengthen our customer experience, commercial management, workflow, financial administration and systems while making better use of technology and business information.     The new Business Operations Manager will take responsibility for many of the important day-to-day functions Carol has looked after so well, while also taking on a broader role in helping us improve and develop the business.     We’re not starting again. We’re building on strong foundations and preparing Auto Interiors for its next stage of growth. title: Renewals Manager
description: This role engages early and often with customers and partners, together with Renewals Specialists, often initiating and leading conversations to understand business needs, technology objectives, and long-term plans across multiple accounts and segments. It builds relationships with customers and channel partner teams to understand business priorities and objectives, ensuring alignment with the CX recurring revenue strategy. Throughout the renewal process, the position collaborates with the Renewals Specialist from opportunity identification to close, initiating engagement through a warm handoff from Sales and Customer Success, and confirming roles and responsibilities early to ensure a smooth transition, aligned activation strategy, and unified customer engagement. The role collaborates cross-functionally with field sales, inside sales, channel teams, delivery, operations, and customer success to provide a unified customer-facing solution, ensure on-time renewals, and identify expansion opportunities. It partners with sales on deal strategy and with customer success on adoption and sentiment to address competitive, adoption, and technology risks across the renewal portfolio, ensuring the appropriate expertise is involved to resolve complex scenarios. The role conducts proactive risk assessments to identify potential risks early in the renewal process, collaborating with relevant teams to develop and implement resolution strategies that ensure successful renewals and customer satisfaction. It leads the end-to-end renewal process for support services and collaborates with the Renewals Specialist on software subscriptions, engaging customers, partners, and Cisco teams to ensure successful agreement renewals. The position leverages AI tools to provide actionable insights, optimize renewal strategies, and strengthen customer relationships for effective revenue retention and growth, while developing and executing comprehensive renewal strategies that include commercial positioning, value articulation, and negotiation oversight for both transactional and complex, multi-product agreements. Additionally, it manages forecasting for renewals and potential churn, advising account teams and leadership on pipeline health and revenue retention, and identifies and drives growth opportunities-including cross-sell and upsell-across the customer base by leveraging insights from data, customer feedback, and market trends. description:
Headquarters:  Remote, United States
 

 At Squarespace, Customer Operations empowers users to give voice to their ideas and make it easy for them when they need help.  $100 per month remote Stipend 
 Education reimbursement 
 Employee donation match to community organizations 
 7 Global Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)

title: Frontend Engineer
description:

GlassFlow is the data infrastructure for AI agents in production. It has two products: GlassFlow Tares, which feeds agents correlated data from every system they touch, and GlassFlow Rius, which traces and debugs what agents do once they're running.

We’re a Berlin startup with a Silicon Valley mentality, backed with $5.9m from Upfront Ventures, the CEO of GitHub, the ex-CTO of Aiven, and more world-class investors.

The founders are serial entrepreneurs with more +10y of experience in building and selling data products.

Tasks

Your Role

As one of the first engineers, you'll get to lay the tech foundations of GlassFlow. As a frontend engineer, you will design and implement our web applications in close collaboration Backend Team, and CTO. You will join a small team solving challenging problems in the field of Data engineering and building a product that will be used by developers across the world.

Requirements

Previous experience that could be helpful:

  • Fluent in TypeScript and frontend frameworks like React or similar
  • Experience with public or private clouds (AWS / GCP / Azure)
  • Experience with DevOps (Kubernetes, Docker, GitHub Actions)
  • Worked in fast-growing environments or early-stage startups

Benefits

title: Backend Engineer - Golang
description:
About GlassFlow:

GlassFlow is the data infrastructure for AI agents in production. It has two products: GlassFlow Tares, which feeds agents correlated data from every system they touch, and GlassFlow Rius, which traces and debugs what agents do once they're running.

We’re a Berlin startup with a Silicon Valley mentality, backed with $5.9m from Upfront Ventures, the CEO of GitHub, the ex-CTO of Aiven, and more world-class investors.

The founders are serial entrepreneurs with more +10y of experience in building and selling data products.

Tasks

Why is this role special

We are Backend Engineer at GlassFlow, you’ll be shaping the core technology, culture, and trajectory of the company. The code you write will power AI agents for billions of data events around the world.

You’ll be working in a fast, high-ownership environment where speed matters, curiosity is rewarded, and ambition is the norm.

What you’ll do

  • Build and scale high-performance, low-latency systems in Golang.
  • Take complete ownership of projects from idea to production.
  • Ship fast, break things, learn, and ship again.
  • Help define the technical culture of GlassFlow.
  • Work directly with the founders to solve problems in a way that no one has solved before.

Requirements

What we’re looking for

You are:

  • Deep expertise in Golang.
  • Hungry, competitive, and resilient.
  • Someone with impressive achievements that prove you’re a 10x builder.
  • A fast learner who thrives in chaos.
  • Hands-on, pragmatic, and deeply technical.
  • Actively looking for startup culture.

Previous experience that could be helpful:

  • Experience with public or private clouds (AWS / GCP / Azure)
  • Experience with K8s, Docker, Docker

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. title: Werkstudent AI Engineering (m/w/d)
description:
Prozesse verstehen. Lösungen bauen, die bei KMUs tatsächlich laufen.

Warum es diese Stelle gibt

Wir sind ein kleines Team in Neumarkt und entwickeln IoT-Cloud-Lösungen für Maschinen- und Fahrzeughersteller. Parallel bauen wir eine Automatisierungsplattform, mit der wir Prozesse automatisieren – für uns selbst und für unsere Kunden. Mit KI-Agenten, LLM-Anbindungen und der Integration bestehender Fachsysteme.

Der Bedarf ist größer als das, was wir nebenbei erledigen können. Deshalb suchen wir jemanden, der genau daran arbeitet: bestehende Prozesse aufnehmen, verstehen wo es klemmt, und dann eine Lösung bauen, die läuft.

Was wir nicht suchen: jemanden, der Konzepte schreibt, die niemand umsetzt. Und keine Forschungsprojekte. Unsere Lösungen müssen zu einem Mittelständler passen – also einfach genug, dass sie auch ohne dich weiterlaufen.

Aufgaben

Was du machst

  • Prozesse aufnehmen. Du sprichst mit den Menschen, die einen Prozess täglich durchlaufen – bei uns oder beim Kunden. Du hältst fest, wie er heute wirklich läuft (nicht, wie er laut Handbuch laufen sollte), wo Zeit verloren geht und was am Ende besser sein soll.
  • Konzipieren. Du entscheidest, welcher Teil sich automatisieren lässt, wo KI echten Mehrwert bringt und wo eine einfache Regel genügt. Du schätzt Aufwand und Nutzen ab und legst dem Prozessowner eine Empfehlung vor – keine Optionsliste.
  • Umsetzen, hands-on. Du baust die Lösung selbst: KI-Agenten auf Basis von LLM-APIs, Automatisierungs-Workflows, Anbindung bestehender Systeme über REST-Schnittstellen und Webhooks, dazu die nötige Datenaufbereitung. Und ein Skript in Python oder JavaScript, wo Klicken nicht reicht.
  • Review und Übergabe. Du gehst mit dem Prozessowner durch, ob die Lösung im Alltag hält. Du prüfst nach, dokumentierst so, dass eine andere Person daran weiterarbei

title: Pediatrician Contractor
description:
At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need - and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Since 2020, Sword has expanded across Musculoskeletal, Women’s Health, Cardiometabolic, and Mental Health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 1 million members across three continents have completed over 15 million AI sessions, helping 2,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 59 clinical studies, 43 patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare.

Role

We're hiring pediatricians (Contractors) to provide clinical care to families through our platform. This is a genuine clinical role: you'll assess cases, reply directly to patients, prescribe, refer, or set follow-up plans as needed.

The role involves rotating shift coverage, including evenings and weekends, and requires supporting Portuguese-speaking families.

AI Proficiency at Sword Health

AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword Health. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework — be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work.

  • Explorer (Level 1) — Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity

  • Builder (Level 2) — Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team

  • Integrator (Level 3) — Embeds AI into products and processes at scale

    • Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role.

What you’ll be doing

  • Provide clinical support to parents of children;

  • Review the clinical picture and resolve cases where clinical input is needed, performing appropriate follow-ups that might include prescriptions or other type of medical guidance;

  • Share qualitative member feedback with the product and clinical teams to help improve the experience.

What you need to have

  • Medical degree (Mestrado Integrado em Medicina): current standing as a final-year pediatr

title: Director, Data Governance (REMOTE, WA)
description:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

About the Role

Are you a curious builder who thrives in a fast-moving, data-driven execution role, curious about how AI can turn quality data into real, operational trust?

Veeam's business runs on data flowing from four source systems, v-Power for Sales, Marketo for Marketing, NetSuite for Finance, and Workday for HR, through a governed Databricks Lakehouse to certified outputs consumed by Tableau dashboards and AI agents. The Senior Director, AI-Ready Data Governance has authored the strategy for how this gets governed: a federated, pragmatic model, central standards, distributed ownership, sequenced by outcome so scope is committed on evidence rather than ambition. Continuous, agent-driven scoring keeps watching a certified object's quality on an ongoing basis, well past the moment of sign-off.

This is a builder and execution role for a deep subject matter expert, with full autonomy to move fast and deliver results. You will lead highly complex, high-visibility initiatives, shape the approach to problems that arrive ambiguous, and influence organizational direction through the standards you set. The strategy, mission, and vision are set. The job is to run Databricks Unity Catalog as the technical backbone and Atlan as the business-facing catalog on top of it, build the certified Bronze-to-Silver-to-Gold pipeline domain by domain, and make certification, lineage, and continuous scoring real enough that governance becomes a standing rhythm rather than a one-off exercise. AI tooling is moving fast enough that the sequence of what gets built when will keep shifting. What does not shift is the outcome bar: certified data, a live trust score behind it, and a named owner for both.

This is a job for someone who is curious by default. Someone who would rather have an agent draft the first pass of a lineage map than wait for a meeting about it, who gets energy from ambiguity because the pace of AI tooling means the plan will keep changing, and who treats data quality as something they are personally accountable for at every level, source system to dashboard to agent output, ahead of whatever a report tells them after the fact.

title: Talent Partner (m/f/d)
description:
Job Description

We build the operating system for renewables: more than 10 GW across 8,000+ plants run on the Amperecloud Platform. Growing that requires energy expertise, and it requires exceptional people. Finding them, developing them and keeping them is what this role exists for.

As

Talent Partner (m/f/d) you work directly with our founders. You own everything talent: who we hire, how we assess, how people grow, and the culture all of it runs on.

Lead: Frederik (CEO) & Florian Strunck (COO)

Contract type: Full-time, permanent

Start: October/November
Location: Berlin

#The role

The focus is singular: talent density and the culture that sustains it. You make sure the few people we hire are exceptional, that our strong people stay and grow, and that our values remain a working standard rather than a poster.

Within that focus, you are the third voice beside the founders on people decisions: who we hire, who we promote, who we bet on, when we part ways. You read people precisely, see early where they are heading, and say it out loud in the room where it counts. No process replaces that; ours is built to support it.

The same logic extends beyond the founders: to our decision-makers you are an advisor, not an order-taker. You read the talent market and tell them what their plans will cost, you sharpen how we present ourselves to candidates, and you build pipelines for the roles we will need before we need them.

You will not start from zero. Over the past year we built our People Guild: values translated into observable behaviors, a leveling framework with Berlin salary bands, structured interviews with an independent bar raiser who holds a veto, a lean feedback cycle. You inherit the engine mid-build, documented, with deadlines and founder sponsorship. You finish it, run it, and make it yours.

title: Product Designer (Experimentation) (f/m/d)
description:
Your mission

We're looking for a designer who decides with evidence. Most design roles stop at the handover. This one does not. You will design a part of the product, form a view about what should change, build the experiment that tests it, and read the results yourself. If you have ever shipped a redesign and never really found out whether it worked, this is the opposite of that.

You will sit inside one product delivery leadership team, working closely with the person accountable for that part of the business and with the engineers building it – not off to one side taking requests. And you will not be doing it alone: you join a group of Product Designers across the company who work the same way and hold each other's standards.

English is our working language. German matters here too: you will be designing flows that German-speaking neighbours read.

Concretely, you will:

  • Design experiences that fit how people already live. Our product mirrors real neighbourhood life. Your job is to design flows and screens that feel natural to someone standing on their doorstep with one hand on their phone, not to add features because we can.
  • Frame the real problem before solving it. Take a vague ask, find the actual question underneath it, and make it explainable. A well framed problem to solve is half the battle.
  • Run the experiment, and read it honestly. Design a testable change, get it instrumented properly, and analyse the outcome with our data team. That includes reporting the tests that did not work, which is most of them, and saying what you would do differently.
  • Talk to neighbours. Experiments tell you what happened, not what people needed. You will spend real time with the people who use this, because you cannot A/B test your way to understanding somebody.
  • Direct AI, and spend your judgment where it counts.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer / SRE – Kubernetes & Hybrid Cloud (m/f/d)
description:
Introduction

At a glance 

  • Location & work model: Berlin, hybrid
  • Tech stack: Kubernetes on our own servers, Harvester (KubeVirt), Argo CD/Flux, Prometheus/Grafana, Longhorn/Ceph
  • Team: A growing SRE team – you report to our CTPO for now and to the Team Lead SRE we're hiring next; two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware
  • Process: Intro call · take-home task (~2h) · 90-min tech interview with our developers · leadership conversation · meet the team
  • Languages: Fluent English required; German is a plus, not a must

Why this role is special 

Most SRE jobs today mean clicking around a managed cloud console. This one doesn't. We run our own hardware in Frankfurt and are building a modern private cloud platform on Kubernetes and Harvester – on-prem by default, with elastic burst into the public cloud and the option to go cloud-only later. You won't inherit a finished SRE practice: you'll help define it, side by side with our Berlin development teams – and you won't do it alone, a Team Lead SRE hire is coming next. 

SRE here is an enabling discipline: you build what our developers need to ship reliably, while two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware. And the impact is direct – our product discovery technology powers more than 2,000 European online shops (Intersport, SPAR, Douglas and more), handling billions of shopper queries a year. When product discovery is slow or down, our customers lose revenue in real time.

KotiCharge on kasvava suomalainen sähköautojen latausoperaattori ja ohjelmistoyritys. title: Service Manager - ERP Solutions
description: Siamo la  Tech Company  leader in Europa che da oltre 45 anni supporta l’innovazione digitale.   Portare il digitale in ogni impresa  è la nostra missione. Come? Mettendo al centro il cliente e diventando il partner di riferimento di professionisti, piccole, medie e grandi aziende  offrendo soluzioni e servizi personalizzati per ottimizzare i processi aziendali , che si tratti di gestire le risorse umane, le relazioni con i clienti, la fatturazione elettronica o i pagamenti digitali.   In ENTERPRISE siamo il partner ideale per le aziende che ambiscono alla trasformazione digitale.  Comprendiamo le sfide di un mercato in continua evoluzione e per questo abbiamo progettato  soluzioni su misura per realtà ambiziose, orientate alla crescita e desiderose di mantenere il pieno controllo delle proprie performance.   Offriamo un supporto completo per ottimizzare le aree chiave di ogni attività, dall'amministrazione e gestione del personale, alle vendite e acquisti, dalla gestione dei progetti alla produzione e logistica.  Unisciti al nostro team, qui potrai affinare le tue competenze, partecipando a progetti stimolanti e crescendo in ambito ERP,  con l'obiettivo di garantire la soddisfazione del cliente nella fase di post-vendita e sfruttare le opportunità di upselling e cross selling    .  In particolare, ti occuperai di:    Interagire efficacemente con i clienti e garantire gli standard qualitativi attesi, pianificando adeguati e costanti confronti e producendo relativa documentazione;  Presiedere ai meeting di confronto in cui i principali interlocutori saranno costituiti da rete commerciale e System Integrator;  Gestire le interazioni con il team retention e quello di recupero crediti, predisponendo azioni volte a far rientrare le situazioni bloccanti.  Essere il punto di riferimento tecnico e costruire relazioni di fiducia.   Comprendere le necessità del cliente e offrire un supporto tecnico sempre all’altezza delle sfide.   Anticipare i bisogni del cliente, individuando nuove opportunità di business.     Quali competenze cerchiamo?     Esperienza di almeno 3 anni nella gestione di clienti in aziende strutturate;  Gestione di progetti che prevedono scadenze a medio e lungo termine, calcolo di costi finanziari e definizione dell’ottimale mix di risorse da utilizzare per il raggiungimento degli obiettivi prefissati;  Pregressa esperienza e conoscenza del mondo consulenziale;  Rilevante esperienza di guida e governance di Business Processing Outsourcer;  Conoscenza di metodologie di Project Management quale PMP, Prince2, ITIL Expert;  Capacità di sviluppo di soluzioni che supportino le decisioni in sistemi aziendali complessi;  Forte propensione all’utilizzo di strumenti informativi avanzati quali CRM e BI;  Disponibilità a frequenti trasferte sul territorio aziendale di riferimento.    Ti rivedi nelle competenze che cerchiamo? Ottimo inizio! Ma vogliamo anche persone che, grazie al loro  growth mindset , vedano ogni sfida come un'opportuni

description: At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Qualifications and background:    Education: Higher scientific education (biomedical laboratory scientist, bachelor, master), preferably with experience from laboratory operations. Experience with pathology laboratories is a plus  Experience: Documented results from sales and customer-oriented work, ideally towards the Norwegian healthcare sector  Commercial understanding: Good business acumen and focus on results  Relationship builder: You are a natural relationship builder, thrive in dialogue with people, and are comfortable spending time with customers  Work style: You are proactive, structured, and independent, but also value teamwork

At the core of the platform is the Extraordinary Card, a digital Mastercard that employers fund through flexible modules for corporate gifting, public transport, rewards and recognition, and controllable allowances. title: Onboarding & Customer Success Specialist
description: Jet Studio è il prodotto di Jet HR pensato per semplificare la vita ai Consulenti del Lavoro. Tu li aiuterai a sfruttarlo al meglio.   Cosa farai  Il ruolo ha due anime.  Customer Support,  sei il punto di riferimento quotidiano degli studi:   Gestisci ticket e chiamate in arrivo su Zendesk, email e Slack, con l'obiettivo di risolvere problemi o dubbi il prima possibile.  Fai da ponte con prodotto e team tecnico. Raccogli e dai una struttura ai bug segnalati, porti dentro i feedback, segui i ticket perché vengano chiusi.  Costruisci e mantieni l'help center e i materiali di supporto. In modo che le domande ricorrenti si risolvano da sole.    Customer Success,  sei responsabile della vita dello studio con Jet Studio:   Onboarding.  Gestisci il passaggio di consegne dall'Account Executive, il setup della piattaforma e lo scambio documentale. Poi fai formazione allo studio - sessioni 1:1 o in gruppi, in presenza presso lo studio (raramente), oppure su Meet.   Adoption.  Ti assicuri che lo studio usi il prodotto per davvero: calendario presenze, portale azienda cliente, email forwarding, andando oltre le funzionalità base. È il lavoro che più di ogni altro determina se lo studio capisce il potenziale del prodotto.   Retention.  Monitori i segnali di rischio (adozione bassa, ticket ricorrenti, silenzi prolungati) e intervieni prima che diventino un mancato rinnovo.   Upsell.  Individui le opportunità di vendita, incluse quelle verso le aziende clienti dello studio.     Chi cerchiamo   Minimo 2 anni di esperienza in un ruolo di Customer Onboarding, Customer Success o Customer Support, preferibilmente in startup o contesti in rapida crescita.  Capacità di comunicare in modo semplice e strutturato, a voce e per iscritto: davanti a un consulente del lavoro, al collaboratore di studio o all’HR dell’azienda cliente dello studio.  A tuo agio al telefono e in videochiamata: buona parte del lavoro passa da lì, e serve saper ascoltare, cogliere quando qualcosa non è chiaro e riformularlo senza far sentire nessuno in difficoltà.  Attitudine a mettere ordine dove ancora non ce n'è: sei il secondo ingresso nel team, quindi ti troverai spesso a definire tu il processo invece di seguirne uno già scritto. Serve autonomia e la voglia di lasciare le cose meglio di come le hai trovate.     Cosa offriamo    RAL tra €25.000 e €37.000  a seconda dell'esperienza, composta da una parte fissa e una parte variabile legata a obiettivi di adozione, retention e soddisfazione degli studi   Lavoro ibrido.  Abbiamo l’ufficio a Milano. Per 2 giorni a settimana è richiesta la presenza, gli altri 3 flessibile. Senza essere fiscali, operiamo molto a buonsenso e siamo flessibili con gli orari. Due volte l'anno abbiamo un retreat di 3 giorni, tutto pagato da Jet.      Founding member . Sarai il secondo hire del team Customer Support di Jet Studio: il tuo lavoro e le tue idee peseranno da subito, con ampio spazio per crescere di responsabilità.   Impatto concreto . Ascoltiamo le tue ide

title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
description: Job Title:  Enterprise Customer Success Manager   Type:  Full-time   Location:  Paris   What about us?   Launched in 2023, INFINIT is a fast-growing fintech scale-up operating in multiple countries across Europe and Americas.  At INFINIT we are on a mission to reshape the future of SMEs with AI at the forefront. Our all-in-one operating system has banking at its core, and empowers small business owners and their teams to seamlessly manage and optimize every aspect of their business with AI agents.  By focussing on specific industries, INFINIT delivers tailored, high-value solutions, while building innovative AI products to further unlock significant growth opportunities for our customers. INFINIT operates globally, with ambitions to further expand its footprint to redefine the fintech landscape for SMEs worldwide.  Join us on the INFINIT journey as we revolutionise the SME economy and drive meaningful impact through innovation 🚀   The Role   We have signed our largest customer to date: a European automotive dealer group operating hundreds of agencies across several countries, with thousands of daily users moving their entire used-vehicle operation onto INFINIT.  As the Enterprise Customer Success Manager — Dealer Groups, based in Paris, you own that relationship. Not as one of ten logos in a portfolio — this is one account, and you go deep into it. You will know their network, their brands, their agency managers and their numbers better than anyone at INFINIT, and you will be the name they think of when they think of us.  The role has two chapters. The first is the migration: you are embedded with the pilot agencies while we tailor the product, and you then own the deployment programme for the whole network — the setup of every agency and the rollout, country by country, on a committed date. Our project leads own the integration and the custom development; getting hundreds of agencies configured, trained and live is yours. The second chapter is the one that lasts: once we are live, this is pure enterprise account management at depth — adoption across thousands of users, the group's commercial results, the renewal, and the expansion of INFINIT across everything else they do.  If your idea of account management is quarterly reviews and a shared inbox, this will not suit you. You will spend real time in dealerships.   What do we want to achieve together?    First chapter — land it (through the migration)      Be embedded with the pilot agencies. On site, in the showroom, next to used-vehicle managers, sales advisors and call-centre agents. You learn how they genuinely work — not how it was described in a meeting room — and you make the pilot succeed on their terms.   Own the deployment programme. You build and run the rollout plan for hundreds of agencies: sequencing, setup and configuration, user provisioning, training, go-live criteria, hypercare, and the migration tracker the group's leadership reads every week. This is genuine programme owner

title: シニア カスタマーサクセスマネージャー（エンタープライズ）
description: [EN] Japanese business-level proficiency is required for this role. English is not required.     ■ このポジションについて  お客様の経営層（常務・事業本部長・CDO・事業責任者）と並走し、自社製品でお客様の事業数字を動かすポジションです。  担当は1人あたり10〜20社（エンタープライズ中心）。1社単位の高関与（High Touch）で深く入り込みます。  個社対応にとどまらず、業界別Playbookの構築とCSチームの型づくりに責任を持ち、加えて標準機能では実現できないご要望を、ご自身でカスタムAppとして形にするところまでを担当します。     海外ではAnthropicやOpenAIをはじめとする企業が「Forward Deployed Engineer」という職種を置いていますが、日本で「経営層と事業の話ができる」×「ご要望を自分で動くものに変えられる」の掛け算を持っている方はまだ多くありません。私たちはこの役割を、日本における「FDE型カスタマーサクセス」の第一期と位置づけています。FDEという肩書きをお約束するものではありませんが、ここで積む経験はまさにこの新しい職種のものです。     ■ なぜ今、募集しているのか  私たちのWeb改善プラットフォームは国内外で導入が拡大し、お客様の事業成長をさらに飛躍させるという新しいフェーズに入っています。  あわせて、新しい自社製品の提供を開始しました。お客様の企業の中で育っていくグロースシステムです。データインサイト／集客／サイト内コンバージョン／リピート購入／カスタム——複数のAppがお客様の実務に入り込み、データ・AI・日々の施策が一緒に蓄積されることで、次の判断がより速く、より正確になっていきます。     新しい製品の提供開始にともなって、提案先の層も変わりました。従来の部長・課長クラスに加えて、常務・事業本部長・CDOクラスの経営層と、事業そのものの話をする機会が増えています。  そこで必要になるのが、お客様の経営層と並走し、業界別の勝ち筋を構造化し、さらに技術的にも自分で判断できるリーダーです。ご要望をお聞きしてエンジニアに引き渡すのではなく、その場で「できます」「ここは難しいです」を助言できること。それがお客様との関係を一段変えます。     ■ キャリアの階段（実際の設計）  ・〜6ヶ月：既存の大手顧客を引き継ぎ、経営層との定期戦略対話を確立。並行してカスタムAppのコードを読み、軽微な改修から着手  ・1年目：お客様のご要望をその場で判断し、動くプロトタイプまでご自身で。業界Playbookの言語化を開始  ・1〜2年目：業界Playbookを3パターン言語化し、チームメンバーの育成を担当  ・3年目：領域Lead、5〜10名のCSMをリード、業界レポート発表——短期間でこの経験を積める環境は稀です     ■ 主な業務  ＜お客様と並走する＞  ・ご面談前の事前リサーチ。IR・中期経営計画・組織体制・競合動向をもとに、事実に基づく仮説を持って臨みます  ・担当エンタープライズ顧客の経営層・キーパーソンとの戦略対話（月次／四半期）  ・定期的な事業レビューの実施。事業数字への自社製品の寄与を整理  ・大型顧客のオンボーディング設計、活用深化（A/Bテスト・LPO・CRM連携・データ分析）  ・アップセル提案（ROI設計）、解約リスクの早期検知と再生プロジェクトのリード     ＜技術視点を活かす＞  ・お客様のご要望をその場で判断し、実現方法・必要なデータ・前提条件・お届けできる時期までを言語化する  ・標準Appでカバーできる領域と、カスタムAppで作るべき領域の切り分け  ・自社製品のSDKを用いたプロトタイプの設計・実装（次回ご訪問までにお持ちする、が基本の型です）  ・CRM／MA／BIツール等のデータ環境を踏まえた実現可否の判断と、自社製品のMCPを用いたデータ抽出     ＜組織に残す＞  ・業界別Playbookの構築／拡張  ・チームメンバーの育成・レビュー  ・現場で得た要件のProduct・Engineerチームへの還元     ■ この仕事の具体的な場面  ・商談中、お客様の役員から「外から買うSaaSではなく、社内で作れるようにしたい」というお話が出たとき。ここで話題を流さず、私たちの製品が目指している方向——お客様の社内にノウハウが残る形——につなげて議論を進めます。 title: HEAD OF CUSTOMER SUCCESS
description: À propos   L'ambition.  Fabriq fait rayonner l'industrie européenne en rendant l'usine plus compétitive et l'ouvrier plus autonome. Au-delà du logiciel, l'entreprise construit le projet de société de la relocalisation industrielle.   L'activité.  Fabriq est l'Operating System des ateliers de production. Sa plateforme SaaS digitalise les rituels de Lean Daily Management (AIC, SQCDP, QRQC, Hoshin Kanri, Gemba) pour résoudre les problèmes terrain 3 fois plus vite que le papier ou Excel. Devenu le leader européen de la digitalisation du Lean, Fabriq construit aujourd'hui la couche agentique de cette discipline.   Les preuves.     26 M€ levés au total, dont 22 M€ en juin 2025 menés par Expedition Capital.  Plus de 1000 sites équipés dans 60 pays, pour des leaders comme Safran, Airbus, Renault et LVMH.  Une équipe de 110 personnes qui joue collectif.    Descriptif du poste   Contexte :  Tu rejoins Thibaud (VP Customer) pour prendre la tête d'une équipe CS d'une dizaine de personnes, sur un portefeuille qui bascule du mid-market vers l'enterprise multi-sites et international.   L'Objectif :  Sécuriser le GRR (Gross Revenue Retention) et maintenir le churn sous 5 % sur le portefeuille enterprise, tout en industrialisant le CS.   Les Enjeux     Industrialiser le CS enterprise : Construire et déployer les playbooks d'adoption et de rétention, les cadences QBR, le health scoring et le capacity planning, en semaines et non en quarters.  Hisser les grands comptes au standard enterprise : Installer une discipline solide sur des clients multi-sites et internationaux, où la relation ne peut plus reposer sur un seul sponsor.  Faire progresser l'équipe : Amener le collectif vers le standard enterprise et faire grandir chaque CS, en coachant par l'exemple sur 1-2 comptes stratégiques.  Créer les conditions d'expansion : Démontrer la valeur au niveau ComEx et détecter les signaux d'upsell, en relais avec l'équipe AM.    Profil recherché   Les OBLIGATOIRES     Expérience : 6 à 10 ans en CS B2B SaaS, dont au moins 3 ans de management d'équipe CS.  Enterprise : 3 à 5 ans d'exposition à des comptes enterprise multi-sites dans un contexte de land & expand.  Track-record : Réduction de churn ou amélioration de GRR démontrée, chiffres à l'appui.  Structuration : A construit des playbooks d'adoption et de rétention from scratch, pas hérités.  Posture : Attrait fort pour la mission et le monde industriel. Envie d’aller se confronter au terrain, pas peur de se déplacer.  Langues : Français et anglais courants.     Les "PLUS" (optionnels) :     Usage avancé de l'IA dans les workflows CS.  Passage en scale-up en forte croissance ayant vécu une phase de structuration.  Appétence pour l'expansion et l'upsell.    Process de recrutement    Un premier échange avec Edouard, Talent Acquisition.  Un entretien avec Thibaud, VP Customer.  Un business case à traiter avec François, Co-founder et Thibaud.  Une étape culturelle et de fit avec François et Victoria (VP People).

description: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. title: Director, Customer Success, EMEA
description: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.  The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.    Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.    Position overview  GitLab is looking for a strategic, commercially minded, and operationally rigorous Director of Customer Success to lead our EMEA Customer Success Management & Architecture (CSMA) and Customer Success Engineering (CSE) organizations.  This leader will own the regional customer-success operating model across relationship management, adoption architecture, technical enablement, customer health, and outcome realization. The role brings together the strengths of CSMA and CSE so customers can move from implementation to adoption, measurable business outcomes, expansion, and renewal with a consistent experience.  You will lead through managers and senior leaders, build a high-performing all-remote organization, and partner closely with Sales, Renewal Management, Professional Services, Support, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Customer Success Operations.  What you will do  Set the regional customer-success strategy    Translate GitLab’s customer-outcomes strategy into a clear EMEA plan for CSMA and CSE.  Define the regional engagement model, coverage strategy, segmentation, capacity model, and operating rhythm across dedicated, pooled, and scaled motions.  Establish a single view of the customer journey, from onboarding and implementation through adoption, optimization, expansion, and renewal.  Ensure the organization consistently connects GitLab adoption to customer-defined business outcomes—not activity, features, or meetings alone.  Represent EMEA customer needs and patterns in global Customer Success strategy and planning.    Lead CSMA and CSE as one integrated organization

title: Coordinateur/Coordinatrice relation client
description: A propos d'imagino         Créée en 2017, imagino est une société qui développe et commercialise un logiciel à destination des directions Data, Marketing et Digitale des entreprises.     La solution répond aux besoins croissants autour de la donnée client : accès et enrichissement, connaissance client et segmentation, activation et personnalisation, etc.   imagino a été créée par les fondateurs de Neolane  (https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neola ne) qui ont l’ambition de construire et vendre une nouvelle plateforme SaaS de référence mondiale.  Suite à une levée de fonds réussie de 25 millions d'euros en juin 2024, imagino, déjà présente en France et au Royaume-Uni, accélère son développement mondial en ouvrant un bureau aux États-Unis afin de renforcer encore sa croissance et sa présence sur le marché      Description du poste      Au sein de l’équipe Relation Client d’imagino, vous serez en charge de l’animation de notre base clients installée et du bon déroulement de l’onboarding.  Votre mission principale est de développer une relation proactive avec les clients afin de garantir leur adoption de la plateforme, d'en maximiser l’usage et la valeur, et de renforcer leur engagement sur le long terme.  Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la satisfaction client, en assurant un suivi régulier, en accompagnant la montée en compétence des utilisateurs, et en identifiant les leviers d’activation de nouveaux cas d’usage.  Ce rôle est transverse : vous travaillerez en interaction quotidienne avec les équipes Produit, R&D, Consulting, Support, Sales et Opérations, afin d’aligner les actions, remonter les besoins clients, résoudre les irritants et faire progresser l’expérience utilisateur.      Missions principales :       Assurer un suivi régulier et structuré des clients via des points d’étape (revue trimestrielle, rendez-vous de suivi...)  Présenter la roadmap produit, les évolutions récentes et les cas d’usage pertinents pour nourrir la réflexion des clients  Analyser les usages et KPIs de la plateforme côté client pour détecter les signaux faibles, les axes d’optimisation ou les zones de friction  Recueillir les besoins, attentes et irritants du client, et piloter leur résolution en s’appuyant sur les bons interlocuteurs internes ou partenaires (consultants, formateur, partenaires, support…)  Piloter l’adoption globale de la solution : vous identifiez les leviers, priorisez les actions et coordonnez les ressources pour favoriser l’appropriation  Identifier les risques de churn ou de sous-utilisation, et mettre en œuvre les actions adaptées  Repérer les opportunités de développement et/ou d’upsell  Faire remonter et partager en interne les retours clients pour enrichir la roadmap et l’orientation des développements  Identifier les clients susceptibles de participer à des actions marketing, telles que des témoignages, partages de cas d’usage, interventions lors de webinars, petits déjeuners ou autres événements de la communauté client, en lien avec les éq

title: Senior Customer Relationship Management Consultant
description: Location: Remote across Europe, with the option to work from our offices in Finland or Stockholm.      Hey Klaviyo expert! 👋 If you know Klaviyo inside out and want to become the person others turn to when the question is  “How should this actually work?”  – while helping shape and grow Woolman’s CRM capability around complex ecommerce clients – this could be your next challenge.      Key points about the role at a glance   ✅  Own Klaviyo expertise at Woolman  – become the go-to person for how the platform works and how clients can get more value from it.  ✅ Own CRM work end-to-end across complex ecommerce migration projects and continuous-service clients.  ✅ Solve real Klaviyo challenges across customer data, segmentation, lifecycle automation, migrations and deliverability.  ✅ Help build Woolman’s Klaviyo capability by guiding the wider team, strengthening our Klaviyo partnership and shaping repeatable services.  ✅ Join a flat, trust-based international team with real autonomy and room to influence.  ✅  Salary:  Starting from €5,000/month, depending on experience and location. For a strong Klaviyo expert, we’re open to discussing a salary level that reflects your experience and the value you’d bring to the role.      Why Klaviyo matters at Woolman      Woolman's mission is simple:  help ecommerce brands run and grow on Shopify – and make better use of the customer data and technology around it.      CRM – and particularly Klaviyo – has become an increasingly important part of that work. Our Shopify projects are getting larger and more complex, and around 80% of the Shopify Plus clients we work with use Klaviyo.     We’ve made a clear strategic choice to develop this capability further:  Klaviyo is one of Woolman’s most important technology partners alongside Shopify.      We already see strong commercial potential around Klaviyo, both within existing clients and through new ecommerce projects. Our goal is to deepen our expertise, serve more clients and turn recurring needs into clearer, scalable services.     That’s where you come in.     You won’t be one Klaviyo consultant among twenty. You’ll be one of the people  owning and shaping this expertise at Woolman  – solving demanding client cases, helping colleagues navigate Klaviyo questions and influencing how our services develop.     As the business grows, this role can become a key senior position in a broader Klaviyo/CRM capability.      What you'll do as our Senior CRM Consultant      You’ll be the  go-to Klaviyo expert  across Woolman’s client work.     This is primarily a  hands-on, client-facing role . You’ll combine deep product knowledge with an understanding of ecommerce and customer behaviour to determine what clients need, what Klaviyo can actually do and what the best solution looks like in practice.     Our clients are typically mid-sized and larger retail and consumer brands. You’ll usually work across a couple of substantial projects alongside ongoing client relationships.

title: Performance Marketing Manager (m/w/d) - Berlin
description:

Unsere Software vereinfacht komplexe Personaleinsatzplanung, senkt Kosten und bindet Mitarbeitende aktiv mit ein. Wir arbeiten mit namhaften Industrie-Playern wie B. Braun, Omterra und Haribo und haben das Ziel, Marktführer in Deutschland zu werden.  Mit dem Einstieg unseres Investors Maguar, spezialisiert auf B2B-Software mit 600 Mio. € AUM, und der kürzlichen Übernahme von ScableOne erweitern wir unser Spielfeld deutlich: Wir bauen eine ganzheitliche Plattform für Menschen in der Fabrik auf: Workforce Management, Shopfloor-Execution, Qualifikationsentwicklung und strategische Personalplanung. Damit wir dieses Wachstum weiter gestalten können, suchen wir einen Customer Success Manager (m/w/d):    Success Management: Führe anspruchsvolle Rollouts bei Top-Kunden durch eine proaktive und partnerschaftliche Projektsteuerung zum Erfolg.  Solution Scoping & Consulting: Identifiziere und gestalte gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden den optimalen Einsatz von shyftplan sowie die nahtlose Integration in bestehende Systemlandschaften.  Onboarding Workshops: Leite interaktive Workshops für Key User und Projektteams, um eine hohe Nutzerakzeptanz von Anfang an sicherzustellen – solo und im Team.  AI Tooling & Innovation: Gestalte eigene AI-basierte Lösungen und internes Tooling mit, um unsere Customer-Success-Prozesse technologisch führend und hochgradig effizient zu gestalten.     Dein Profil     Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium – gern in Wirtschaft, Informatik oder einem MINT-Fach.  Du bringst einschlägige Erfahrung im Customer Success oder im Projektmanagement mit (z. B. SaaS, Consulting, Konzern).  Im Kontakt mit Kund:innen trittst du souverän, empathisch und lösungsorientiert auf.  Du bist ein Teamplayer, der den Austausch liebt und Kundenbeziehungen nachhaltig aufbaut.  Digitale Tools und Software-Implementierungen begeistern dich.  Du denkst analytisch, handelst proaktiv und verstehst dich als "Trusted Advisor" deiner Kunden.  Für On-Site Termine bei unseren Kunden bist du gelegentlich reisebereit.     Was wir dir bieten     Eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit und ein motiviertes, internationales Team  Volle Integration ab dem 1. Tag und tiefe Einblicke in den Alltag eines Tech-Startups  Ein modernes, offenes Büro im Herzen Kreuzbergs  Zahlreiche Benefits wie Deutschlandticket, Urban Sports Club & Mobilitätsbudget  Regelmäßige Teamevents (Kart fahren, Escape Room, Sommerfest..) und Company Lunches     Über uns   https://careers.shyftplan.com  https://shyftplan.com/impressum

title: Customer Service Manager
description: Ben jij een ervaren Customer Service professional die energie krijgt van het aanbrengen van structuur, het verbeteren van processen en het begeleiden van medewerkers? Houd je ervan om midden in de operatie te staan en tegelijkertijd een team verder te ontwikkelen? Dan is deze functie bij VDL TBP Electronics iets voor jou.  De functie  Als Customer Service Manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing van het Customer Service team in Dirksland, bestaande uit vier medewerkers. In deze rol combineer je operationeel meewerken met leidinggeven. Het grootste deel van je tijd ben je actief betrokken bij de dagelijkse werkzaamheden rondom klantvragen, orderverwerking en afstemming met interne afdelingen. Daarnaast focus je op het coachen van medewerkers, het verbeteren van processen en het verder professionaliseren van de afdeling. De afdeling bevindt zich in een ontwikkelfase waarin meer structuur en uniforme werkwijzen worden aangebracht. Er worden nieuwe procedures geïmplementeerd en er liggen kansen om processen verder te optimaliseren. Jij speelt hierin een belangrijke rol door overzicht te creëren, prioriteiten te stellen en medewerkers mee te nemen in veranderingen. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:    Coördineren en prioriteren van de dagelijkse werkzaamheden;   Onderhouden van contact met klanten, accountmanagers en interne afdelingen;   Sparren met Accountmanagers over klantontwikkelingen en commerciële kansen;   Bewaken van de kwaliteit en volledigheid van klant- en orderinformatie;   Zorgdragen voor een optimale bezetting en continuïteit binnen het team;   Coachen en begeleiden van medewerkers in hun ontwikkeling;   Signaleren en doorvoeren van procesverbeteringen;  Signaleren van ontwikkelbehoeften en bijdragen aan de verdere groei van medewerkers.    Jouw kracht  Je bent een coachende en mensgerichte leider die medewerkers weet te motiveren en structuur brengt in een dynamische omgeving. Je staat dicht bij het team, werkt graag mee in de operatie en weet tegelijkertijd overzicht te houden en verbeteringen door te voeren. Met jouw pragmatische aanpak creëer je draagvlak voor verandering en zorg je samen met het team voor een optimale dienstverlening aan de klant. Daarnaast beschik je over:    HBO werk- en denkniveau;  Ervaring binnen Customer Service, Sales Support of Order Management, bij voorkeur in een technische of productieomgeving;  Ervaring met het coachen of aansturen van medewerkers;  Kennis van ERP-systemen en een proactieve, resultaatgerichte instelling;  Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal.    De kracht van VDL  Bij VDL TBP Electronics kom je terecht in een innovatieve en technisch uitdagende omgeving waar ondernemerschap, samenwerking en vakmanschap centraal staan. Als onderdeel van VDL Groep werk je binnen een sterk internationaal familiebedrijf met een informele en no-nonsense cultuur. Daarnaast bieden wij:    Een salaris afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring tussen €3950 en €5122 bru

title: Key Account manager

title: Customer Success Manager - DACH
description: As a Mid-Market Customer Success Manager for the DACH market, you will manage, grow, and retain a portfolio of dynamic clients to drive product adoption, satisfaction, and Net Revenue Retention (NRR). This role demands a deep understanding of customer needs and scalable success strategies to foster a strong client community. You will proactively uncover upsell opportunities alongside Account Managers to drive revenue, while optimizing self-service resources, user groups, and events for best-practice sharing. Collaborating closely with operations, you will refine CS processes and tools for maximum efficiency. Finally, you will analyze customer data to provide actionable insights, share critical feedback with product teams, and host educational workshops to continuously improve the overall customer experience.   Your First Year Journey    First 3 Months  You will focus on learning Tellent’s products, customer base, and scalable CS strategies. Through onboarding sessions, training on engagement techniques, and hands-on participation in customer interactions, you will build a strong foundation. By the end of this period, you will be comfortable using CS tools and contributing to small-scale initiatives like webinars and customer workshops.   After 6 Months  You will independently manage your portfolio, executing scalable initiatives to drive product adoption and customer satisfaction. You will actively lead webinars, community engagement events, and improve self-service resources. You will also collaborate with AMs on renewals and upsell opportunities while refining customer engagement processes.   After 12 Months  You will have a measurable impact on customer satisfaction, churn prevention, and NRR. You will be fully embedded in scalable customer success initiatives, fostering strong customer communities, and optimizing processes. With a proven track record in driving value, you will be well-positioned for growth and professional development.   What You’ll Be Doing     Hybrid Engagement Strategy: Manage and retain a dedicated portfolio using both 1:1 consultative deep dives and scalable 1-to-many initiatives.  Digital Customer Journey Design: Design, execute, and continuously improve the digital journey for mid-market customers, ensuring value-driven touchpoints from onboarding through renewal.  Scaled Program Execution: Build and run digital programs using email, in-app messaging, video, and webinars to drive product adoption at scale.  Data-Driven Proactivity: Analyze usage patterns and behavioral signals to prioritize outreach, identifying "silent" customers or those at risk before churn occurs.  Commercial Growth: Partner with Account Managers to identify, qualify, and document expansion (upsell/cross-sell) opportunities discovered during your digital campaigns or 1:1 sessions.  Community & Feedback: Foster a sense of community by hosting user groups and events, while relaying critical customer feedback to Product and Development

title: Senior Lead Customer Success
description: Functieomschrijving     Geloof jij dat complexe technologie eenvoudig kan zijn?    En kan je andere mensen meenemen in dat geloof, terwijl jullie tegelijk klanten laten groeien, upsell-kansen pakken, en zorgen dat churn daalt? Dan zoeken we jou!   Over Workspace 365    Bij Workspace 365 bouwen we aan één ding: werk eenvoudiger maken. Voor partners. Voor hun eindgebruikers. Dag in, dag uit. Dat klinkt simpel. Maar het vraagt iets van ons. Het vraagt om mensen die niet tevreden zijn met "zo is het nu eenmaal", maar die zien dat IT-complexiteit weg kan.    Jouw rol    Als Senior Lead Customer Success geef je leiding aan vier Customer Success Managers en drie Technical Success Managers. Je brengt structuur, inspiratie en commerciële scherpte in het team. Je houdt overzicht over de status van je klanten: wie loopt risico op churn, wie heeft aandacht nodig en wie biedt kansen op upsell. Je zorgt dat je team dat overzicht net zo scherp heeft en dat de dagelijkse focus daarop ligt. Je maakt duidelijk waarom dat ertoe doet: het is goed voor de klant, maar het zijn ook onze targets, onze omzet en onze groei. Je neemt zelf deel aan gesprekken met grote klanten, ziet waar kansen op meer omzet liggen en durft te sturen op resultaat. Commercie is voor jou geen bijzaak, maar een vanzelfsprekend onderdeel van customer success.    Dit ben jij:      Je gelooft dat complexiteit kan verdwijnen, in processen, in tools en in de manier waarop teams werken. Je neemt geen genoegen met plannen die niet landen. Wordt een target niet gehaald? Dan zoek je uit waarom en los je het op.   Je motiveert liever dan dat je opdrachten geeft. Je neemt je team mee in het waarom, zodat ze niet volgen omdat het moet, maar omdat ze voelen dat het ertoe doet.   Je ziet commercie als onderdeel van succes. Je begrijpt dat klanten moeten groeien en partners moeten verdienen, en dat wij daarin meegroeien. Je spreekt makkelijk over targets, NRR en upsell-kansen, en je stuurt er ook op.      Vereisten     Wat vragen we van jou?      Minstens vijf jaar saleservaring. Ervaring in customer success is een pré, maar een ervaren salesmanager is ook welkom.   Vijf jaar ervaring in leidinggeven.   Een commerciële mentaliteit. Je begrijpt NRR, upsell, churn en portfoliomanagement, en je stuurt er actief op. Omzet en groei zijn voor jou geen bijzaak, maar een KPI waar je dagelijks naar handelt.   Nederlands en Engels op niveau.   Een hbo- of wo-opleidingsachtergrond.       Wat krijg je van ons?     Autonomie:     Je krijgt eigenaarschap en vertrouwen. Je weet samen met je team waar jullie naartoe werken en bepaalt zelf hoe. Je krijgt vrijheid, en de verantwoordelijkheid die daarbij hoort.   Je ziet je impact terug. Partners die groeien, eindgebruikers die productiever worden en churn die daalt. Ook je team voelt dat resultaat.   Je krijgt ruimte om te bouwen. We hebben plannen, maar niet alle antwoorden al klaar. Zie jij een betere aanpak? Dan luisteren we.      Geld:     €5.900 tot €6.800 euro bruto

title: Partner Success Manager, Data & Content
description: Job description   Vesper is a commodity market intelligence platform for the food and beverage industry. Buyers, sellers and traders use it to see where prices sit today, where they are heading, and what that means for what they pay or charge. Dairy, oils, sugar, grains, cocoa, coffee, eggs, meat, nuts, freight, packaging and more.  None of that works without data. Our benchmarks and forecasts are built on data from partners: traders, exchanges, industry bodies, publishers, processors. Every new partner fills a gap in what we can show customers, or makes an existing benchmark better. That is the part of the business you would own.  Our partner network has grown fast and keeps growing: new commodities, new regions, and a serious push into the US. It now deserves someone who owns it full time.  This is a commercial role. You keep the relationships we have strong, negotiate licensing terms with data owners, lead renewals, and find the next opportunity inside a relationship that already works. If you like closing deals and also like building the systems that make partner management repeatable at scale, you will not run out of things to do here. Direct access to commercial leadership:  Small team, short lines, quick decisions. Larger agreements you co-sign with the Head of Partnerships, who you report to.   You sit where the product gets made:  Data Research turns partner data into benchmarks and Product set where we grow coverage next, so the effect of a deal you close is visible in the platform.   Your work directly enables our product and commercial teams:  Our partners provide critical data and capabilities that make Vesper more valuable. Partnerships ensure Sales and Customer Success have the right partner offering to sell and deliver value to customers.   Bring structure and make it happen:  We won’t hand you a playbook. You’ll be expected to identify where we need more structure, come up with your own ideas and solutions, and then execute them. We value strategic thinking, but we need someone who turns ideas into action.   Get out of the office:  Roughly four to six trips a year to trade events and partner visits around the world, meeting the people you work with face to face.      What you'll be doing    Own the partner relationships:  You are the person our data partners call. You run a review cadence that matches how important each partner is, visit the key ones face to face, and never let a relationship rest on a single contact.   Lead renewals:  You own the renewal calendar and every conversation on it. A renewal is a commercial moment, not paperwork: wider scope, longer term, better commercials, more rights.   Negotiate with data owners:  Licensing models, pricing, exclusivity, redistribution and attribution rights, how data may be used

The Profiles Platform team owns Klaviyo’s core customer data system, the foundation that powers every product experience across the platform. You’ll work at the intersection of data infrastructure, computed data, and scalability, ensuring that profile data remains trustworthy and performant as Klaviyo grows into more complex enterprise and global use cases. This is a high-impact platform role where your work will directly influence nearly every product team and customer experience. Please note that this is an onsite role that requires 5 days/week in our Boston office. Fully remote candidates will not be considered at this time.

How You’ll Make a Difference

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for Klaviyo’s core profile data system, including profile traits, transformations, and storage layers
  • Serve as the product owner for the source of truth for customer data across the platform
  • Partner closely with engineering to evolve profile data architecture and services at massive scale
  • Collaborate with the Identity, Data, and Consent teams to ensure accurate and unified customer records
  • Drive improvements in profile data quality, usability, and modeling for downstream consumers (segmentation, flows, analytics, AI)
  • Enable enterprise and global expansion by supporting data residency, compliance, and regional infrastructure requirements
  • Define and track key metrics around data quality, performance, and system efficiency

title: Instandhaltungstechniker (m/w/d) Werkstudent:in
description:
Du möchtest nicht irgendeine Anlage warten, sondern eine Technologie betreuen, die es so weltweit kein zweites Mal gibt? ⚡ 

Unser Kunde ist ein schnell wachsendes GreenTech Startup, das eines der weltweit ersten skalierbaren Straßenkraftwerke entwickelt. Die Technologie nutzt bestehende Straßeninfrastruktur, um aus dem darüberfahrenden Verkehr erneuerbare Energie zu gewinnen, ohne dafür zusätzliche Flächen zu benötigen.

Deine Erfahrungen aus dem laufenden Betrieb fließen damit direkt in die weitere Entwicklung der Serviceprozesse ein.

With a strong presence in New Zealand and Australia, we help property managers streamline their operations through seamless automation and smart integrations.  Tradies get a rough deal out of property maintenance. They chase the quote. They chase access. Then they chase the money — and do the invoicing at the kitchen table after dinner.  Tapi helps trade businesses run maintenance work without the admin grind. We’re building software that makes it simpler to quote, schedule, communicate, invoice and get paid — and we’re on a mission to improve the property maintenance experience for everyone.  The job  You own Tapi’s trade network in New Zealand — who’s on it, how well they use it, and how fast it grows.  We build market by market: bring great trade businesses onto Tapi across every category in a city, help them see real value quickly, get the network humming, then go again somewhere new. You’ll be on the ground in each one.    Sign the growing ones. Our sweet spot is the trade business with a few vans, where the owner’s still quoting at nine at night and wondering whether it’s time to hire someone for the office. Tapi is the alternative to that hire.  Win the big ones. You’ll open doors, earn the meeting and show larger operators why Tapi is worth changing how they work for.  Get them using Tapi. A signature is only the start. You’ll make sure new trades get set up, get value early, and keep using Tapi when the novelty wears off. You’re their person: the number they call when something’s not right.  Write the playbook, so every market is quicker than the last.    You’ll be measured on market coverage — the share of trade categories with enough active trades using Tapi — plus how many of your trades are still active at 90 days, how fast they say yes, and the quality of the network you build.  What you’ll bring  You’ve sold to tradies, and you were good at it. Hardware, building supplies, repping a brand, telco, fuel cards, equipment hire, software — the industry matters less than the buyer. You’ve sat across from an owner-operator and got a yes. And you found them yourself. Nobody handed you a list.  Straight up: this isn’t a job about knowing everyone. Beers or coffees help. Being liked helps. Neither is the job. The job is getting the right trades onto Tapi and helping them make it part of how they work.  You’ll run your own pipeline without being asked twice, hold a straight conversation about money without folding when someone pushes, and still be going hard in month nine when the easy yeses are gone. Been on the tools yourself? Useful. Not required, and no substitute for closing.  We hustle with class and we back ourselves. Persistent, never a pest — a tradie who says no today should still take your call next month.  How we work  We have five values. They’re not just statements — they’re what this job actually asks of y

title: Customer Success Manager
description: Euronext Corporate Solutions (ECS Sweden AB) är ett SaaS-bolag inom governance och compliance och en del av Europas största börs, Euronext. Som en del av Euronext, Europas ledande marknadsinfrastruktur, stödjer vi över 4 000 organisationer i mer än 25 länder. Vår integrerade svit av mjukvara och rådgivningstjänster – från Investor Relations & Communication till Compliance och Governance – är utvecklad av experter inom kapitalmarknader och används av emittenter, rådgivare och institutioner runt om i Europa.  I Sverige är Admincontrol, en ledande leverantör av digitala lösningar för styrelsearbete (Board Portal) och säkra datarum (Virtual Data Room), en del av ECS. Admincontrol förvärvades 2025 av Euronext, vilket skapar en bredare svensk portfölj inom bolagsstyrning och regelefterlevnad – från styrelseportal och datarum till IR-portaler, visselblåsartjänster och insiderhantering. Vi bygger nu en gemensam kommersiell organisation för den svenska marknaden.   Om rollen    Är du en person som drivs av att skapa värde för kunder, bygga starka relationer och utveckla affärer? Vill du arbeta i ett bolag med höga ambitioner, stark tillväxt och marknadsledande produkter? Då kan rollen som Customer Success Manager vara rätt för dig. Nu söker vi en Customer Success Manager som vill hjälpa våra kunder att lyckas, utveckla långsiktiga partnerskap och bidra till vår fortsatta tillväxtresa.  Som Customer Success Manager ansvarar du för att hjälpa våra kunder att få maximalt värde av våra tjänster. Du driver onboarding av nya kunder, utvecklar långsiktiga kundrelationer och identifierar affärsmöjligheter inom din kundportfölj. På sikt kommer du även att bygga djup produktkunskap och fungera som ett stöd för kollegor inom exempelvis försäljning, Key Account Management och marknadsföring.   Dina ansvarsområden      Ansvara för onboarding av nya kunder   Bygga starka och långsiktiga kundrelationer   Arbeta proaktivt med kundnöjdhet och retention   Identifiera och driva upsell-möjligheter   Utbilda och vägleda kunder i våra produkter   Bidra med kundinsikter och produktfeedback internt      Vi söker dig som      Har några års erfarenhet inom Customer Success, Key Account Management eller liknande roll   Gärna har arbetat inom SaaS, finans eller abonnemangsbaserade affärsmodeller   Är van att förklara system och produkter för både kunder och kollegor   Har ett affärsdriv och kan visa goda resultat från tidigare roller   Arbetar strukturerat och datadrivet   Talar och skriver flytande svenska och engelska      Varför oss?    Vi erbjuder en roll med stort eget ansvar i ett bolag med höga ambitioner och stark tillväxt. Samtidigt värnar vi om en kultur där vi hjälper varandra, har högt i tak och tror på balans mellan prestation och välmående. Tjänsten är placerad på vårt kontor i centrala Stockholm med en hybrid arbetsmodell där vi arbetar från kontoret tre till fyra dagar i veckan.   Join Euronext – Shape capital markets for future generations   Euronext

title: Customer Success Manager (CSM)
description: Vil du være med på å forme fremtidens digitale akvakulturnæring?   AKVA group utvikler teknologi som bidrar til en mer effektiv og bærekraftig havbruksnæring. Nå søker vi en Customer Success Manager som vil spille en nøkkelrolle i å sikre at kundene våre lykkes med å ta i bruk og skape verdi gjennom våre digitale løsninger, med særlig fokus på vår løsning Observe.  Som Customer Success Manager blir du bindeleddet mellom kundene våre og fagmiljøene innen produkt, support, salg og utvikling. Du følger kundene gjennom hele reisen, fra implementering og opplæring til langsiktig kundeutvikling og kommersiell oppfølging.  Stillingen har base ved vårt kontor i Tromsø og innebærer jevnlig reiseaktivitet til kunder og oppdrettere i Nord-Norge.   Dette vil du jobbe med     Bygge og utvikle sterke, langsiktige kunderelasjoner  Sikre vellykket onboarding, implementering og oppfølging av nye kunder  Bidra til høy brukeradopsjon og dokumentert kundeverdi  Være tett på kundenes operative hverdag gjennom kundemøter, workshops og besøk ute på lokalitet  Gjennomføre opplæring, rådgivning og demonstrasjoner av våre løsninger  Bidra i salgsprosesser og identifisere nye muligheter hos eksisterende kunder  Jobbe aktivt med kundeutvikling, mersalg og kryssalg i samarbeid med salgsteamet     Hvem ser vi etter?   Vi ser etter deg som kombinerer bransjeforståelse med interesse for teknologi og digitale løsninger. Du bygger tillit, trives i dialog med kunder og motiveres av å se at løsningene du jobber med skaper konkret verdi.   Vi Tror Du Har     Høyere utdanning innen akvakultur, biologi, teknologi/IT, økonomi eller tilsvarende (relevant arbeidserfaring kan kompensere for manglende formell utdanning)  Erfaring fra havbruk, akvakultur eller tilgrensende næringer  God kommersiell forståelse og interesse for forretningsutvikling  Interesse for og forståelse av digitale verktøy og teknologiske løsninger  Gode kommunikasjonsevner på norsk og engelsk  Førerkort og fleksibilitet til å reise i forbindelse med kundebesøk     Det Er En Fordel Om Du Har     Erfaring med kundeoppfølging, rådgivning, salg, implementering eller Customer Success  Erfaring med kurs, opplæring, workshops eller presentasjoner     Personlige egenskaper    For å Lykkes i Rollen Tror Vi At Du     Er relasjonssterk og bygger tillit hos kunder og samarbeidspartnere  Har en nysgjerrig og løsningsorientert tilnærming til kundens utfordringer  Jobber strukturert og følger opp med høy gjennomføringsevne  Har kommersiell teft og evner å identifisere utviklingsmuligheter  Trives med ansvar, selvstendig arbeid og kundekontakt ute i felt     Hvorfor AKVA group?   Hos oss får du en sentral rolle i skjæringspunktet mellom teknologi og havbruk. Du blir en del av et sterkt fagmiljø og får muligheten til å bidra til at digitale løsninger skaper reell verdi for kundene våre. Rollen gir stor frihet, varierte arbeidsdager og tett samarbeid med både kunder og interne fagmiljøer.
