title: Key Account Manager sökes till Martin & Servera i Stockholm
description: Kan du sälja med omtanke?  Vi på Martin & Servera levererar mat, dryck och tjänster till restauranger och storkök, över hela Sverige. Som marknadsledare driver vi utvecklingen framåt och jobbar varje dag hårt för att göra varje dag lite godare, alltid på ett sätt som skapar en mer hållbar bransch. Och som Key Account Manager är du en viktig del av helheten. I ditt säljarbete bygger du goda relationer med våra kunder, utifrån deras behov och din passion för mat och dryck. Med omtanke om kunderna och kunskap om deras vardag, stärker och breddar du deras affärer, på kort och lång sikt. Du blir också en del av en stark intern gemenskap där vi jobbar tillsammans, stöttar varandra och har roligt ihop. Vi söker nu en Key Account Manager till vårt team i Stockholm.   Ett hållbarhetsarbete i framkant.    För oss är hållbarhet inte bara ett fint ord utan en självklar del av precis hela vår verksamhet. Hos oss blir du en viktig del av det arbete som vi tillsammans gör varje dag för att bidra till en hållbar framtid.   Stabilt och långsiktigt.    Vi har en stark och långsiktig ägare i form av familjeägda Axel Johnson, vilket skapar både trygghet och stora utvecklingsmöjligheter.   En varierande vardag.    Du skapar goda relationer, räknar på affärer, driver försäljning och bidrar till lönsam tillväxt. Att stötta och utveckla våra kunders verksamhet, ha koll på trender och koppla ihop våra kunder med våra specialistbolag, är en naturlig del av jobbet. Hos oss får du en händelserik och varierande vardag där din kompetens är viktig.   Vi erbjuder dig.    Hos oss får du ett spännande jobb med goda förmåner som till exempel ett generöst friskvårdsbidrag, sjukvårdande bidrag och lunchsubvention. Vi utmanar oss själva och värdesätter prestationer på samma sätt som vi värnar om en bra balans mellan jobb och privatliv. Vi erbjuder möjlighet till distansarbete två dagar i veckan. För oss är det viktigt med en trygg och säker arbetsmiljö, därför utför vi slumpmässiga drog- och alkoholtester på våra arbetsplatser.   För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har     Ett stort intresse för människor och är duktig på att skapa goda relationer.  Ett genuint intresse för mat och dryck är ett stort plus.  En eftergymnasial utbildning och erfarenhet av att jobba i CRM är meriterande.  Erfarenhet från tidigare arbete inom försäljning och/eller restaurangbranschen  Ett boende i Stockholm med omnejd.  B-körkort är ett krav för rollen.     Hur går rekryteringen till?    Vi jobbar aktivt för mångfald och ser olikheter mellan människor som en styrka. Med målet att spegla våra kunder och samhället vi verkar i, söker vi människor i alla åldrar och med olika bakgrunder. I alla våra rekryteringar använder vi oss av personlighetstest. Det är för att kunna jämföra kandidater på ett så rättvist sätt som möjligt. Vi gör också bakgrundskontroller. Läs mer om rekryteringsprocessen på vår hemsida.   Sista ansökningsdag : 20 september 2026   Tillträde : Enligt överenskommelse   Anställningsf

title: Key Account Manager
description: Om selskapet   Sensio er et norsk selskap innen velferdsteknologi som løser dagens og morgendagens utfordringer innen eldreomsorg, for beboere, pasienter, helsepersonell og samfunnet. Vi utvikler sensorer, systemer og plattformer som radikalt forbedrer kvaliteten og effektiviteten i helse og omsorg, og leder bransjen mot å omfavne teknologi for å gi #MoreTimeForCare.     Siden starten i 2009 har Sensio vokst til rundt 240 ansatte og en omsetning på mer enn en halv milliard globalt. I 2024 fikk Sensio inn ny hovedeier i Nordic Capital, en av Europas ledende vekstinvestorer med omfattende erfaring fra skalering av helseteknologi.     Sensio har hovedkontor i Oslo, med kontorer også på tvers av Norge, Sverige, Danmark og Tyskland, samt et distribuert team i Storbritannia. Selskapet har ambisjoner om å bli markedsledende innen velferdsteknologi i Europa, og jobber med Nordic Capital i ryggen for å akselerere transformasjonen av eldreomsorgen mot en helt ny måte å jobbe på: Digitalt Først.      Om rollen   Som Key Account Manager får du et tydelig kommersielt ansvar for å videreutvikle Sensios eksisterende kundeforhold. Du får ansvar for en egen portefølje av kommuner og private helseaktører som allerede har rammeavtale med Sensio. Din oppgave blir å identifisere uutnyttet potensial, utvikle nye muligheter og omsette dette til salg og videre vekst.        I denne rollen legger du tiden din der potensialet er størst. For å gjøre de riktige prioriteringene må du kjenne kundene dine godt, forstå virksomheten deres og se hvor Sensios løsninger kan skape mer verdi. Målene dine tar utgangspunkt i potensialet hos den enkelte kunde. Du avdekker nye behov og bygger forretningscase som gjør det tydelig for kunden hvorfor de skal utvide samarbeidet med Sensio. Du får dermed stor frihet til å styre egen portefølje og drive salgsarbeidet fremover.     Rollen er i utvikling, og du får være med på å forme hvordan Sensio jobber med vekst i eksisterende kundeporteføljer. Du samarbeider tett med Account Executive, som henter inn nye kunder til porteføljen din, og med Customer Success, som sikrer at kundene får reell verdi av løsningene i praksis. Sammen dekker dere hele kundereisen, fra nye kunder til videre utvikling av kundeforholdet. Rollen innebærer en del reisevirksomhet, for å møte kundene dine ansikt til ansikt. Som en del av salgsteamet rapporterer du til salgsdirektør.      Ansvarsområder    Utvikle og følge opp en portefølje av eksisterende kunder, med mål om økt bruk og kommersiell vekst  Avdekke nye behov hos kunden, og bygge forretningscase for å realisere disse  Forhandle avtaler, priser og vilkår innenfor eksisterende rammeavtaler og følge opp over tid  Samarbeide tett med Account Executive og Customer Success for å sikre gode overganger og helhetlig oppfølging av kunden  Holde oversikt over bruk og potensial i porteføljen gjennom data og innsikt, og rapportere på fremdrift  Representere Sensio på messer og konferanser, og bidra til å styrke selskape

title: Key Account Manager
description: Own Waikato's Key Client Portfolio. Build Relationships. Drive Long-Term Growth.   We're looking for an experienced relationship-focused professional to take ownership of our Waikato key client portfolio while supporting a select number of strategic clients across New Zealand.  Based in Hamilton, you'll be responsible for some of our most important client relationships, ensuring commitments are delivered, communication is proactive, and opportunities for long-term partnerships are identified. You'll have the autonomy to manage your portfolio, the support of experienced operational teams, and the opportunity to contribute to the continued growth of both the Waikato business and the wider organisation. Commercial awareness and a customer-focused mindset.  The ability to coordinate multiple priorities and build alignment across teams.  Experience working with service contracts, compliance environments or operational service businesses.  Strong planning, organisation and follow-through.  A proactive, solutions-focused approach.

title: Senior Account Manager
description: About the Role   We're looking for a Senior Account Manager to join the Launch Agency operations team.  This role owns a portfolio of retainer and ad hoc clients end to end. You'll run the relationships, hold the delivery accountable, and make sure every client gets what they're paying for, on time and to scope. It sits at the point where client expectations meet internal execution, and it's the role that keeps those two things aligned.  You'll report into the Operations Manager and work across strategy, media buying, content, web development, and SEO.      About Launch Agency   Launch Agency is a creative-first performance agency operating across Australia and New Zealand. We've driven over $1 billion in directly attributed revenue for our clients.  Creative-first means what it says. We don't treat creative as the thing that gets made after the media plan is signed. Creative is the variable that moves performance, so it leads the work and everything else is built around it.  We combine:   Paid media (Meta + Google)  Creative production (content, video, design)  Web development (Webflow + Shopify)  Strategic advisory (fractional C-suite)   We work directly with business owners to help them grow through better acquisition, positioning, and execution.      What You'll Be Doing    Owning a portfolio of retainer and ad hoc clients end to end, from onboarding through to ongoing delivery and growth  Running weekly and fortnightly WIPs and client check-ins, with clear agendas, documented outcomes, and follow-ups that actually get closed  Making sure every project lands to scope, on time, and within budget, and escalating early when any of those three are at risk  Spotting account risk before it becomes churn, and activating and running recovery plans on at-risk accounts  Leading client onboarding against our onboarding plan so new accounts start properly rather than drifting  Owning Monday.com accuracy across your portfolio, including task definition, scoping, assignment, and workflow status  Reviewing Harvest time tracking and cost allocation so we know what each account actually costs to service  Coordinating with strategy, media buyers, content, web, and SEO to align priorities and keep delivery moving  Directing the Operations Coordinator on administrative execution and workflow tracking  Working with sales and strategy to identify and initiate upsell opportunities across your accounts  Partnering with the Operations Manager to build and embed better processes across the agency       What We're Looking For    5+ years in client services, account management, or project management, ideally in an agency or fast-paced client-facing environment  Proven ability to run multiple accounts and retainers at once without dropping quality or deadlines  Strong project management skills with hands-on experience in Monday.com, Harvest, or similar  A working understanding of performance marketing, including lead generation, conversion, CPL, and ROAS  Commercial

title: Account manager
description: Egloo è una società tecnologica indipendente di Milano. Lavoriamo con brand di alto profilo su progetti web e digital experience, e con aziende industriali e PMI strutturate su software su misura, integrazioni ERP/MES e soluzioni AI. Progettiamo e realizziamo internamente le soluzioni che proponiamo, mantenendo un rapporto diretto tra cliente e team lungo tutto il progetto.  Lavoriamo con team piccoli, guidati da persone senior, con un approccio diretto e una forte attenzione alla qualità del lavoro e all'apprendimento continuo.      La posizione:   L’Account Manager che cerchiamo ha un mandato doppio: far crescere la relazione con i clienti che già lavorano con noi e trasformarla in nuove opportunità di business. Sarai la persona che, progetto dopo progetto, diventerà il punto di riferimento del cliente: ne segui le aspettative durante la delivery, ne intercetti i bisogni e costruisci le condizioni per far crescere il rapporto nel tempo.  Lavorerai a stretto contatto con i founder e con i team di delivery, riportando direttamente al Managing Director, su tutto il portafoglio, dai brand alle aziende industriali. title: Konevuokraamon esihenkilö
description: Haemme Rovaniemen toimipisteellemme    Vuokraamon esihenkilöä    vastaamaan vuokraamon toiminnasta kokonaisvaltaisesti.    Ramirent Finland Oy on Suomen suurin palveluyritys, joka tarjoaa konevuokrauksen rinnalla laaja-alaisesti palveluita rakennusalan ja teollisuuden asiakkailleen. Palvelemme asiakkaitamme maanlaajuisesti yli 500 luotettavasta ammattilaisesta koostuvan henkilöstön voimin. Ramirent kuuluu Loxam-konserniin, joka on yksi maailman suurimmista konevuokraamoista. Haluamme panostaa toimintamme ensiluokkaiseen asiakaskokemukseen sekä pitkiin asiakassuhteisiin, mikä onnistuu osaavien ja innostuneiden työntekijöiden avulla. Toimimme työnantajana vastuullisesti, teemme töitä turvallisessa työympäristössä ja huolehdimme henkilöstön ammatillisesta kehityksestä, terveydestä sekä hyvinvoinnista. Ramirentin toimintaperiaatteisiin kuuluu niin laadukkaan palvelun kuin tuotteiden tarjoaminen, mikä tarkoittaa hyvin huollettua kalustoa ja asiantuntevaa henkilöstöä.    Etsimme hyvillä esihenkilötaidoilla ja asiakaspalveluasenteella varustettua jämäkkää ja energistä tekijää. Esihenkilönä vastaat mm. toimipisteen asiakaspalvelusta, kalustosta, tuloksesta, työturvallisuudesta sekä tavoitteiden asettamisesta henkilökunnalle. Isona osana työstäsi osallistut tiimisi rinnalla päivittäiseen työhön. Dine opgaver     Eje og levere den daglige drift i din region med fokus på performance, kvalitet og effektivitet  Samarbejde med Planners, Office Leads, Maintenance Leads og Cleaning Supervisors for at sikre optimal ressourceudnyttelse  Analysere performance data og implementere forbedringer, der øger produktivitet og servicekvalitet  Sikre ensartede processer og implementere operationelle “blueprints” på tværs af lokationer  Lede, coache og udvikle teams for at sikre høj trivsel og performance  Håndtere og eskalere komplekse sager og sikre professionel klagehåndtering inden for budget og retningslinjer  Drive kontinuerlige forbedringer og implementere best practices i driften  Sikre effektiv planlægning og bemanding i samarbejde med relevante stakeholders     Profilen vi søger   Du vil trives i denne rolle, hvis du er en hands-on leder, der motiveres af drift, mennesker og konkrete resultater – og som formår at skabe struktur og fremdrift i en kompleks hverdag.  Vi leder efter en kollega, der kan byde ind med:    Solid erfaring med ledelse i en operationel hverdag  Stærk forståelse for drift, performance management og serviceleverance  Dokumenteret evne til at lede, coache og motivere teams  Erfaring med håndtering af klager og svære dialoger  En struktureret og løsningsorienteret tilgang med fokus på effektivitet  En samarbejdende og proaktiv tilgang til at få tingene gjort  Det er en bonus, hvis du har erfaring med at lede på tværs af flere lokationer eller geografier     Sådan får du succes     Eje og levere på operationelle KPI’er såsom kundetilfredshed, effektivitet og kvalitet  Samarbejde med interne teams for at sikre høj produktivitet og minimal nedetid  Implementere og forankre effektive processer og systemer på tværs af regionen  Drive forandringer og sikre forankring af nye værktøjer og arbejdsgange  Bidrage til forbedringer i kundefeedback, engagement scores og driftsresultater  Sikre høj kvalitet i leverancer – herunder rengøringsscores, rettidig opgaveløsning og korrekt fakturering     Derfor vil du gerne arbejde hos Awaze   Vi tilbyder en alsidig stilling i et stærkt fagligt og socialt miljø, som du får mulighed for at præge og være med til at forme. title: Partner Success Specialist
description: Vi söker inte någon som bara vill förvalta kundrelationer. Vi söker en kommersiell partnerutvecklare som vill få våra partners att växa.     Vi bygger en helt ny funktion med ett tydligt fokus: att systematiskt hjälpa våra 2000+ nordiska partners att bli mer framgångsrika med AutoConcept. Vi söker dig som är kommersiell, strukturerad och gillar att få saker att hända - en av de första i vår nya avdelning, med möjlighet att forma hur vi arbetar med Partner Success framåt.      Om AutoConcept   På AutoConcept utvecklar vi skräddarsydda försäkrings- och garantilösningar för fordonsbranschen i Sverige, Norge, Danmark och Finland.     Våra partners är en central del av vår affär. När våra partners lyckas bättre, lyckas vi bättre. Därför handlar Partner Success om mer än att bara ha nöjda kunder – vi vill hjälpa våra partners att bli mer aktiva, sälja mer och få större värde av samarbetet med oss.      Om rollen   Som Partner Success Specialist innebär det att du trivs med att arbeta med många partners parallellt och kunna prioritera, kommunicera effektivt, använda data och skapa resultat i skala.     Ditt uppdrag är att få våra partners att lyckas bättre med AutoConcept. Du kommer att arbeta med hela partnerresan; från onboarding och utbildning till löpande support, utveckling och retention.     Du kommer bland annat att:   Onboarda, utbilda och coacha partners i våra produkter, arbetssätt och verktyg.  Vara löpande kontakt och support, samt identifiera möjligheter att öka aktivitet och försäljning hos våra partners.  Arbeta aktivt med retention, churn och win-back.  Samarbeta nära våra säljare och andra interna funktioner.  Du arbetar mot tydliga mål kopplade till partneraktivitet, försäljning och retention.       Vem är du?   Du är en person som får saker att hända hos partnern.  Vi tror att du:   Har erfarenhet från försäljning, partnerskap, Customer Success, kundservice, CRM, utbildning, onboarding eller liknande.  Är kommersiell med ett tydligt business-first mindset och motiveras av att skapa mätbara resultat för både partnern och AutoConcept.  Är strukturerad och datadriven, trivs med att hantera många partners och aktiviteter parallellt (gärna erfarenhet av CRM, t.ex. Hubspot).  Har lätt för att skapa förtroende och kommunicera tydligt, även digitalt.  Är självgående och tar ansvar för att saker blir gjorda.  Har svenska (eller norska) på professionell nivå samt god engelska; ytterligare språk kan vara meriterande.  Har B-körkort.      Vi ser gärna att du har några års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet. Erfarenhet från automotive eller bilbranschen är meriterande, men inget krav.      Det här erbjuder vi   På AutoConcept har vi en öppen och prestigelös kultur där vi hjälps åt och har nära till beslut. Hos oss får du möjligheten att komma in tidigt i en ny funktion och vara med och bygga något som kommer att spela en viktig roll i vår fortsatta tillväxt.     Vi erbjuder bland annat:   Marknadsmässiga anställningsvillkor  25 dagars semester + 3 f

description: IKH Group on teknisen alan tuotteiden maahantuonnin ja kaupan vahva valtakunnallinen toimija, joka työllistää noin 440 ammattilaista. Kyseessä on keskeinen asiantuntijarooli käynnissä olevassa ERP-uudistuksessa, jossa pääset vaikuttamaan ratkaisuihin käyttöönotosta niiden pitkäjänteiseen kehittämiseen ja jatkuvaan ylläpitoon. title: Implementation Consultant
description: Etsimme   Admicomille   uutta  Implementation Consultantia  osaksi Customer Delivery -tiimiämme. Jos nautit asiakastyöstä, ihmisten kouluttamisesta ja siitä hetkestä, kun uusi järjestelmä alkaa oikeasti toimia osana asiakkaan arkea, tässä voisi olla sinun seuraava roolisi!      Implementation Consultant   Implementation Consultantina pääset mukaan asiakkaan Admicom-matkan tärkeään vaiheeseen: siihen, kun uusi ohjelmisto otetaan käyttöön ja  asiakkaat oppivat hyödyntämään sitä omassa työssään .     Jokainen käyttöönotto alkaa asiakkaaseen ja heidän liiketoimintaansa tutustumisesta. Haluamme ymmärtää, mitä asiakas tavoittelee ja miten ratkaisumme voi parhaiten tukea heidän tekemistään. Samalla kehitämme käyttöönottojamme kohti entistä sujuvampia ja toimivampia malleja, joita voidaan hyödyntää laajasti erilaisten asiakkaiden kanssa.  Tässä roolissa pääsetkin paitsi viemään käyttöönottoja onnistuneesti maaliin, myös vaikuttamaan siihen, miten niitä Admicomilla tulevaisuudessa tehdään.      Vastuullasi on käyttöönottoprojekti alusta loppuun. Suunnittelet ja aikataulutat käyttöönoton, konfiguroit ohjelmistoympäristöä ja ratkot matkan varrella vastaan tulevia kysymyksiä.  Pidät kokonaisuuden hallussa ja huolehdit, että projekti etenee sovitusti ja aikataulussa.  Työn alla on yleensä useampi käyttöönotto samanaikaisesti, joten pääset työskentelemään erilaisten asiakkaiden ja tilanteiden parissa.      Kouluttaminen ja asiakkaiden ohjaaminen ovat keskeinen osa Implementation Consultantin työtä.  Autat erilaisia käyttäjiä ottamaan uudet ratkaisut haltuun ja teet uusien asioiden oppimisesta mahdollisimman sujuvaa ja ymmärrettävää. Koulutuksia järjestetään niin etänä kuin paikan päällä, ja mukana voi olla hyvin erilaisia käyttäjiä ja osaamistasoja. Parhaimmillaan pääset näkemään konkreettisesti sen hetken, kun uusi järjestelmä alkaa hahmottua käyttäjälle ja asiat loksahtavat paikoilleen.     Käyttöönottoja ei tehdä yksin. Ympärilläsi on Customer Delivery -tiimi, ja projektien aikana teet yhteistyötä esimerkiksi Customer Successin, tuoteorganisaation ja muiden Admicomin asiantuntijoiden kanssa.      Mitä tarvitset tehtävässä onnistumiseen?   Tähän tehtävään ei ole vain yhtä oikeaa taustaa. Voit olla urasi alkuvaiheessa tai jo kokeneempi osaaja.  Taustasi voi löytyä esimerkiksi ohjelmistojen ja ERP-järjestelmien, taloushallinnon tai palkanlaskennan parista tai rakennusalalta ja sen prosesseista.  Kaikkea ei tarvitse osata: olennaista on, että tunnet jo vähintään yhtä näistä maailmoista ja olet innostunut oppimaan lisää.     Ennen kaikkea toivomme, että  nautit asiakastyöstä ja kouluttamisesta . Tässä tehtävässä vietät paljon aikaa asiakkaiden kanssa, joten saat mielellään energiaa ihmisten kohtaamisesta, uuden opettamisesta ja siitä, että pääset auttamaan asiakasta onnistumaan.      Lisäksi toivomme, että:    opit uusia järjestelmiä nopeasti ja olet aidosti kiinnostunut ohjelmistoista ja niiden mahdollisuuksista  otat luontevasti omistajuutta omista asiakasp

title: Spontaneous Application
description:
AI-powered command for modern defence.

At Comand AI, we build the command software modern forces need. AI-native from day one and designed to work with what forces already use.

Prevail reads mission data and terrain, surfaces predicted threats, and hands forces real-time courses of action while feeding lessons learned back into doctrine. It turns data overload into a decision advantage instead of a liability.

The team brings together engineers who've shipped at Palantir and OpenAI. Prevail is built for people who can't afford to lose.

We raised a €32 million Series A to scale the mission.

We Don't Have Your Role Open Yet, Talk to Us Anyway

Comand AI is growing fast across engineering and business development, and we don't always have the right seat open the moment a strong profile shows up. If you do exceptional work and want to be at the edge of AI and real military operations, reach out now. We'll find where you fit.

Who We're Looking For

Engineering & Product

Forward deployed engineering, computer vision, applied ML research, full-stack and backend software engineering. Think geospatial data and ML/LLM workflows, most of it deployed on-prem. Direct user contact comes standard.

Business Development & Deployment

Business strategists and deployment strategists who build trust with military units and own delivery end to end.

Strong profiles in adjacent functions are worth a conversation too.

What Makes a Strong Comand AI Profile

title: Business Strategist - France
description:
Comand AI's mission is to deliver the next-generation of software to the European defense.

From the very identification of the capacities that need building to their actual delivery within the hands of our forces, achieving our objective means finding the narrow ways through complex legacy environments, dense ecosystems, concrete partnership engagements.

We are looking for a Business Strategist to build Comand AI’s presence from the ground up. You will identify the right entry points, build trusted relationships across the defense ecosystem, and create the path from first operational engagement to pilot and contract. Working closely with product and forward deployed teams, you’ll turn operational proof into commercial traction and establish Comand AI as a trusted partner in the market.

What this looks like in practice:

  • Build Comand AI’s presence in your market: identify the right units, partners, champions, and procurement pathways, then own the journey from first engagement through experimentation, pilot, and contract

  • Identify and shape strategic opportunities before formal procurement, positioning Comand AI where operational needs emerge

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships across the defense ecosystem, from operational units to industrial partners and government stakeholders

  • Navigate long, politically sensitive B2G sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, security clearances, RFIs, RFPs, and public procurement rules

  • Translate Prevail’s technical capabilities into language that resonates with procurement officers, general staffs, and program leads

title: Software Engineer
description:
Comand AI's mission is to build next-generation C2 software with real users in real deployments in the field. We are fully indexed on the success of every single user, which means the software you ship runs inside live defense operations, not a benchmark.

You'd be joining the engineering team working directly with the leadership. You take a problem, explore it, come back with proposals, and iterate; nobody hands you a fully specified ticket. Most of the team genuinely values that exposure. It isn't a dealbreaker if you're very strong but less drawn to it, but expect real user contact to be part of the job.

What this looks like in practice:

  • Own end-to-end features on Prevail, our operational planning platform, from scoping through shipping

  • Work on real geospatial problems: everything in the product lives on a map, so you'll move data between backend and frontend through tile servers and lean on PostGIS for geo queries that need to be genuinely smart

  • Build and harden ML/LLM workflow orchestration: most product workflows carry an LLM or ML step, so you'll design for retries, queueing, and long-running jobs with LangGraph and LangChain

  • Design for on-prem and appliance deployment: our default target isn't cloud-native, it's hardware plus software shipped as an appliance, so you're thinking about resource constraints instead of adding another Lambda

title: Solution Architect H/F
description:
Une révolution en marche

Chez Thiga, nous sommes convaincus que l’adoption du Cloud et de la GenAI ne se limite pas à “déployer sur Kubernetes” ou à “brancher un LLM”. Elle exige de repenser l’architecture, l’exploitation et la sécurité : des plateformes cloud natives, observables, résilientes, et capables d’industrialiser des systèmes à grande échelle.

Notre vision

Nous croyons que l’IA et le Cloud vont redéfinir :
L’Architecture Logicielle : passage d’applications “cloud-ready” à des plateformes cloud-native pilotées par l’événementiel et des briques GenAI (agents, retrieval, automatisations)
Cloud : émergence d’expériences basées sur des plateformes cloud, soutenues par des backends sécurisés (tooling, IAM, audit) et des architectures orientées “self-service” et “on-demand” pour offrir du multi-tenant, de l’event-driven, de l’API-first 
Le Product Engineering : intégration native de capabilities Cloud et GenAI dans les produits, avec des exigences non négociables de SLO, sécurité, conformité et coût
 
Une opportunité unique
 
Nous sommes Market Maker. Nous montons une Task Force R&D pour passer du “POC” à la “Production-Grade App on Cloud”.

title: People Ops Manager
description:
Flex is building the AI-native private bank for business owners.

We’re re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners.

Since launching publicly in September 2023, Flex has scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue, with a clear path to profitability by late 2026. We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership.

They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a ~$1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a $100B+ company by delivering a product that is fundamentally better—not incrementally improved.

Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt.

title: Founder, Instructure Foundry
description:
At Instructure, we believe in the power of people to grow and succeed throughout their lives. Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers.
We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome. And that's where you come in:

Foundry is a standalone division inside Instructure, built to generate new revenue with AI-built products. As a Pod Founder, you’ll start a company around a problem worth a business, prove customers will pay for the answer in weeks, and build and sell the product yourself. This is a player-coach who builds and sells. You’ll be paired with a Builder, backed by a supporting operating team, and given a token budget to build agentically. If you’ve ever wanted to be a founder but didn’t want to raise money and assemble distribution from scratch, this is that. The role reports to the President, New Markets.

What you will do

  • Find and validate the problem. Bring founder-level conviction about a specific problem worth building a business around. Get in front of real customers in the first weeks, score the problem and the solution honestly, and earn the gate to build. Bring your own thesis, or take one of ours.

  • Build the product. Author the specs, the product context, and the customer findings. Work hands-on with your Builder, and in the code yourself when it’s the fastest path. You set what gets built and why.

  • Sell it. Land the first pilot, prove customers will pay, and get to general availability and the first paying customers beyond the pilot. Revenue is the scoreboard.

  • Run the business. Own your pod’s profit and loss, hit the stage-gates, and make the call when the evidence says change course.

What you’ll need to know/have

  • A builder’s instinct and a commercial mind in the same person — a design and engineering sensibility paired with a feel for what customers will actually pay for.

  • Evidence you’ve shipped something real and put it in front of customers, ideally something you started or owned, not just contributed to.

  • The judgment to work across product, sales, marketing, and support without waiting for a function to do it for you.

  • A bias for the customer over the org chart.

  • The range to build and sell well enough that a two-person team is genuinely enough.

  • Prior startup or zero-to-one experience helps; a track record of finishing helps more.

What we expect

  • Speed over polish. You validate with real customers in weeks, not quarters.

title: Chief of Staff / Business Ops
description:
Global supply chains move 80% of world trade and almost none of it accounts for its climate impact. Searoutes builds the data infrastructure that lets freight forwarders, shippers, and carriers measure and cut their CO2 footprint.   • Impact you can see. With ~20 people, your work doesn't get lost in a hierarchy. What you fix, ships. What you build, gets used.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

  • Leadership operating system Run the agenda, follow-ups, and accountability loop for leadership meetings. The person who makes sure decisions turn into action, not just notes.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
We are building the world's decision infrastructure: the strategic twin of every industrial organization. Our customers map reality, with its levers and constraints, into a model, and we run large-scale combinatorial optimization over the critical decisions in their value chain. We help Europe stay strong and the German Mittelstand make good decisions between market shifts, orders, machines and people.

Founded by Dana (CEO) and Erik (CTO) from RWTH research, backed by a €2.8M round led by Vorwerk Ventures, with customers live on our optimization models.

Your mission

Hi, I'm Erik, CTO of Circonomit. This ad is specific on purpose: you should be able to tell from it whether this is your job.

Most optimization software fails in the same place. Not in the solver, but in the gap between what a company actually does and what the model assumes. Somebody has to sit with the people who plan today, understand how they really decide, and turn that into something a machine can compute.

That is this role, and you do it hands on. You take the customer's planning problem apart, you build the model yourself, in code, on their data, and you stay with it until their management trusts the result enough to act on it. Then you bring back the part that should stop being project work and become product.

Most of this happens at your desk in Cologne, with days at the customer's site when the decisive conversations happen. You are the shortest path between our product and reality. What does not survive at a customer does not work.

We will not sugarcoat it: the data arrives messy, the first model is rarely the right one, and some weeks a customer deadline sets the priority.

What you'll own

  • The customer's decision problem. Sit with the people who plan today, understand capacities, costs, lead times and the constraints nobody wrote down, and turn it into a model whose answer a plant

BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.  The Operations Practice (OPS) Area is one of BCG's largest functional practices. We help our clients create competitive advantage by enhancing their performance and building strategic capabilities. BCG’s expertise in Operations covers the following areas - supply chain management, procurement, manufacturing, service operations, cost efficiency, operational transformation, research & product development, program and project management, all with a strong digital and analytics overlay.  Within Operations,  Enterprise   Operations and Customer Service  focuses on optimizing  Customer Service and Order-to-Cash (O2C)  processes across industries. We help clients transform how they serve customers — improving efficiency, enhancing satisfaction, and driving sustainable value. Our projects address key questions such as:  How can we reduce customer effort and increase digital adoption? How can we leverage AI and analytics to transform service delivery? How can we create scalable, people-centric operations that deliver measurable results?   As part of our team, you will work with leading organizations to design and implement transformative service operations, develop innovative operating models, and shape the future of customer engagement.  What You'll Do    Lead and deliver high-impact consulting projects in Customer Service and Order-to-Cash operations, from design to implementation.  Develop and execute strategies to improve service performance, optimize operating models, and drive digital and AI-enabled transformation.  Manage client relationships at senior levels, present recommendations to C-level stakeholders, and ensure alignment with strategic objectives.  Guide and coach BCG and client teams, fostering collaboration and developing capabilities throughout the project lifecycle.  Contribute to business development, including proposal creation and client presentations, and support the growth of the Service & Support Operations topic. title: Manor Club Manager
description: Why Join Us?   At Rosewood Doha, we create an environment where passion meets purpose – and where careers have meaning.  Guided by our philosophy of Relationship Hospitality and our culture of Make the Place, we believe in enriching lives, starting with yours. We empower you to bring your true self, grow with confidence, curate the extraordinary and leave your legacy.  You’ll be part of a diverse, inclusive and supportive community that invests in your development, celebrates achievements and inspires you to Discover Your Calling.  Together, we push boundaries, explore the uncharted and shape the future of luxury lifestyle experiences.      About Rosewood Doha:   Rosewood Doha is a landmark destination inspired by Qatar’s coral reefs, bringing together ultra-luxury hospitality, residential living, culinary experiences, holistic wellness, differentiated retail and events within one integrated ecosystem. The property includes a 155-key hotel, 162 serviced apartments and 276 private residences, alongside a diverse collection of restaurants and lounges, expansive event spaces and curated lifestyle experiences. Our destination also houses Asaya, Qatar’s first members-only social wellness club, complemented by Rosewood’s signature Manor Club for Club Room and Suite guests.  Since opening in July of 2025, Rosewood Doha has been recognized with multiple international and regional accolades, including distinctions from the Michelin Guide, Forbes Travel Guide and Qatar Tourism - reflecting the scale, ambition and standards of excellence behind the destination. As part of the global Rosewood Hotels & Resorts portfolio, the property represents a new generation of luxury that goes beyond traditional hospitality into lifestyle, community and experience-driven destinations.      Our Associate Experience:   We believe exceptional work deserves exceptional care. At Rosewood Doha, we offer a thoughtfully designed associate experience that supports your wellbeing, growth and life beyond work. This includes:   A competitive salary and benefits package  High-quality associate accommodation in prime locations in the heart of Lusail and the Pearl  A birthday day off (because your milestones matter!)  Personalized development plans and continuous learning opportunities to support your career journey   These benefits reflect our commitment to creating an environment where you thrive – professionally and personally – while building a meaningful career with us.      Your Role:    Essential Duties and Responsibilities    Managing smooth operation of Manor Club and Apartment Lounge with highest level of services.  Maintaining healthy working environment to Manor’ associates and Lounge associates.  Review performances of each team member and planning for carrier improvement  Minimizing operational expenses  Ensures the punctuality and appearance of all Manor Club/Apartment Lounge team members, making sure that they wear the correct uniform and maintain a high standard

title: Onboarding Operations Specialist - APAC
description: About Remote   Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote.  With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role.  We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.  If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!  What this role can offer you  Step into a pivotal role at Remote, where you’ll be contributing to shaping the future of global employment.  As a Specialist in our Onboarding Operations team within EOR Operations, you’ll have the unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact by enhancing the onboarding journey for our clients new employees across the globe. You’ll thrive in a collaborative, agile environment where your insights and dedication to excellence will drive real change.  You will be reporting to the  Manager, Onboarding Operations.    What You Bring     Extensive Operations Experience: You have a strong background in operational roles, with a solid understanding of people operations (experience in employment and legal contracting is key).  Contract Knowledge: Proficiency in handling employment contracts and similar legally binding documents, particularly within the HR or people management space.  Adaptability: You excel in fast-paced, cross-functional settings, ideally within startups or high-growth companies, and are energised by evolving challenges.  Team-Oriented Mindset: A true collaborator who values team success and demonstrates a strong sense of ownership. You work well independently and seek support proactively when needed.  Exceptional Communication Skills: High proficiency in written and spoken English at business level, with a keen eye for detail and clarity in documentation and communication, ensuring information is conveyed accurately and professionally across diverse audiences. Additional languages considered a plus.  Tech-Savvy and Adaptable: Skilled in using various collaboration tools for effective asynchronous work, with the agility to learn and adjust to new and evolving systems.  Independent and Collaborative: Able to work autonomously and seamlessly within an international, fast-paced, remote team, balancing multiple priorities. Open to flexible hours to support global needs as required. title: Sales Strategy and Operations Manager
description: Who We Are   Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.  We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.  You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries.   About The Role   As a member of our JAPAC Sales Strategy and Operations team, you will have an integral role in driving the insights, operations, and strategy that enables our JAPAC Sales Region to run better, faster, and smarter as we expand throughout the region. Sales Strategy and Operations is an excellent platform to learn how a business really runs.  You will be joining the Sales Strategy and Operations team as a high impact contributor, gaining exposure to a wide variety of challenges, processes, and data that makes the engine of this Sales organization hum. As a Manager on the Sales strategy and operations team in JAPAC, you will lead cross-functional initiatives from ideation to analytics to recommendations to drive impact across the sales organization.  We are committed to a thriving in-office culture. This role requires that you be on-site at our office in Tokyo, Japan office 5 days a week. Strategic planning: work with business stakeholders to develop, implement, and operationalize the sales plan for the JAPAC region. Systems and operations: identifying and implementing improvements in current workflows and processes that can help improve efficiency and visibility - this might be in Salesforce.com or other tools.   Critical business partner: act as an extension of the existing Sales Strategy and Operations team to provide day to day business support for the JAPAC team on various items such as data, system processes and approval flows. title: Payment Services Manager
description: Papaya Global is a rapidly growing, award-winning B2B tech unicorn with an ambitious mission to revolutionize the payroll & payments industry. With over $400M raised from multiple tier-one investors, our innovative technology provides a comprehensive solution for managing global workforces, encompassing everything from hiring and onboarding to managing and paying employees in over 160 countries.      Papaya is expanding its Payments Implementation team and are looking for an experienced implementation specialist. Our business is currently going through significant growth, and we require an individual with prior experience of onboarding customers within Payments and preferably Payroll Payments.      You Will:    Be responsible for the E2E payments process from onboarding to ongoing. This will involve regular interaction with customers and providing SME guidance where necessary on payroll and authority payments across different countries.  Work with Papaya’s Due Diligence/KYC team to help approve all new customers.  Conduct ‘penny tests’ for all new customer employees prior to go-live.  Provide training to customers on how to use the Payments component of the Papaya platform.  Be the first port of call for payment related queries and concerns  Investigating and responding to payment queries from internal and external parties  Monitoring of payments execution and resolving any issues  Working with 3rd party payment providers to resolve queries  Ensuring payments/reports are loaded on to the system correctly and timely  Provide and maintain exceptionally high levels of customer service  Work collaboratively with the rest of the payments and customer service teams as we continue to scale       Requirements:    Bachelor’s degree – preferably in a STEM subject  Excellent project management skills – qualifications preferred.  3+ years of experience in onboarding/implementation within a Payments division or company.  Experience of Payroll Payments would be a significant advantage.  Excellent communications skills – written and verbal  Proactive and creative in problem-solving, showing responsible approach and ownership  Proven hands-on experience applying AI tools in payment services beyond basic usage, including process automation, discrepancy detection, reporting, and strengthening controls to ensure accuracy, compliance, and timely execution  Ability to multitask and work under pressure  Proficient in tools like Salesforce, Microsoft office etc.  Experience working in a scale-up business would be beneficial

title: Manager - Oslo | BCG Platinion
description: Who We Are  Do you want to turn the challenges of digitalization into the solutions of the future? Join BCG Platinion in tackling the core IT issues of leading global companies!  Deploy customized platforms, architectures, strategies, and organizations to leverage the digital potential of our customers and drive true innovation, with state-of-the-art tools such as cloud computing, AI, blockchain, microservices, and containerization. Add your individual strengths to our unique team, always there to support you. Together with Boston Consulting Group and our clients, we turn digital visions into reality.  What You'll Do  As a Manager at BCG Platinion in the Nordics, you are responsible for the execution and management of our national and international client projects. We collaborate with colleagues from BCG Platinion and/or the Boston Consulting Group on site and directly with the client company. The Manager role incorporates structuring the project and performing the required resource planning.  Besides the functional navigation of the project members, you will also be involved operationally in the project business. Together with our clients, you will develop convincing IT strategies, concepts and solutions, applying technical know-how and extensive experience in structuring IT projects, just as analytical and conceptual skills. We independently support our clients, present our results to their decision makers, and agree on the next steps.  What You'll Bring   You can help us make a difference if you     bring a completed a degree in computer science, (business) informatics, or a related area with above-average grades  have at least eight years of substantial experience in IT consulting and the lead design and management of IT strategy and implementation projects  already captured project-related management experience as the lead of teams with more than five people  know how to plan IT initiatives and build solid business cases  optimally steer decisions towards the goal and master escalating situations with an eye to solutions - even in complex organizational structures  have successfully acquired consulting projects  bring hands-on experience with LLMs and other generative AI tools and know how to apply them across work tasks  are excellent at understanding and communicating complex topics in English    Who You'll Work With   Shape the world of tomorrow     Independently contribute to build close client relationships - and as their trusted advisor, you are the first to whom they turn  Acquire new projects and challenges for our company and yourself  Be in charge of planning, leading, and assuring quality for strategic IT projects - we work with passion for our clients' long-term success  Get to use your comprehensive knowledge of technology and industry understanding to provide both internal and external stakeholders with the orientation they need in critical project phases and challenging situations  Think across projects and connect

title: Agentic AI in Contact Center
description: Role Purpose:    The Product & Technical Expert (PTE) leads and manages the product and technical tasks of the Agentic AI in Contact Center project across its three components — the virtual AI bot / conversational IVR, the agent-assist, and interaction analytics. The role spans requirements and vendor selection through solution design, integration, AI governance, and delivery oversight, while building lasting in-house capability through knowledge transfer to a nominated internal candidate.   Key Responsibilities:      Manage and refine the business and technical requirements across the three components (virtual AI bot / conversational IVR, the agent-assist, and interaction analytics), and maintain the requirements and compliance matrices   Build and maintain the use-cases and intent-prioritization backlog (Tier 1 automated, Tier 2 AI-assisted, Tier 3 human), translating call-driver data into an automation roadmap   Define KPIs and success/acceptance criteria   Support RFP issuance, run the technical evaluation of bidders, lead proofs-of-concept (including Saudi-dialect quality testing), and make sourcing recommendations   Manage the implementation partner technically — scope, statement of work, deliverables, and quality   Manage the conversational and agentic design: open intent capture, dialog flows, prompts, tone/persona, escalation triggers, and warm-handoff behavior   Manage the design of RAG grounding approach, knowledge-base structure, and guardrail configuration   Define the target architecture and external/internal integration design across core banking (T24), CRM (MS Dynamics), Cortex, e-channels,OTP, and the Cisco IVR/ACD and speech-recording stack   Specify APIs, real-time context retrieval, latency targets, and the model-hosting approach   Advise on model selection (LLM/SLM and routing), RAG, hallucination mitigation, confidence thresholds, and prompt/version management   Establish the AI governance and guardrail framework aligned to SAMA and PDPL — human-in-the-loop for sensitive flows, audit trail, data residency, and PII redaction   Work with Compliance, Risk, Legal, and Information Security to secure the necessary approvals   Manage SIT, UAT, and phased go-live; manage risks, issues, and dependencies   Stand up the analytics / AI-ops monitoring and reporting, and run the post-go-live   Coach and up-skill the nominated internal candidate (prospective AI-Ops Lead) and the wider team; produce runbooks and operational handover

title: Account Manager- DC
description:
Headquarters:  Remote (USA)
 

  PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE: PD) is the global leader in AI-first digital operations. By automatically detecting, diagnosing, and remediating issues, the PagerDuty Platform orchestrates AI agents and automated workflows with context from over 750 integrations. Trusted by approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100 and nearly half of the Fortune 500, PagerDuty is the industry standard for organizations scaling resilient, autonomous operations. Notable customers include Chipotle, Cloudflare, Docusign, Fox, Nvidia, Salesforce, Spotify, Zoom and more. We are growing rapidly and hiring top talent with leading AI skills across engineering, sales, product, marketing, and beyond as we build the leading digital operations platform. 
     PagerDuty is seeking an Account Manager to join our diverse, customer-focused team! As an Account Manager, you will serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of existing SaaS customers, partnering closely with cross-functional teams to deliver exceptional customer outcomes. You will maintain and grow customer relationships, drive product adoption, manage renewals, and identify strategic expansion opportunities that deliver measurable business value. This is an exciting opportunity to blend customer success and sales expertise to help customers realize the full potential of PagerDuty’s platform while driving revenue growth.

 Maintain strong product knowledge and deliver consultative guidance to drive configuration optimization and feature adoption. 
 
  BASIC QUALIFICATIONS  
 
 7+ years of combined customer-facing experience, including Account Management, Customer Success, or Renewals. 
 4+ years of proven success managing renewals and growth within a SaaS environment. 
 Experience using Salesforce (SFDC) and analytics tools such as Gainsight, Tableau, or Looker. 
 Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. 
 
  PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS  
 
 Demonstrated ability to leverage data analytics and health metrics to manage and retain customer accounts. 
 Prior enterprise sales expertise leveraging MEDDPICC & Value Selling. 
 Experience working with enter

title: Advertising Operations Manager
description:
Headquarters:  San Francisco Bay Area or New York (Remote)
 

  Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does:  play video games.  Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.   Ad Operations and Sales Analytics support Discord's ads business, partnering with Sales, Product, Engineering, Data Science, and other cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality campaign executions, impactful data insights, and go-to-market strategy across our advertising products. 
 As an Ad Operations Manager, you will play a crucial part in scaling our Ads business. You'll improve the efficiency and scale of campaign execution while contributing to deep-dive analyses that drive business growth and inform go-to-market strategy. You'll provide valuable feedback to Product and Engineering teams, directly impacting Discord's advertising capabilities while removing friction from customers' experience with our platform. 
  What You'll Be Doing  
 
 Ensuring ad campaigns are implemented and launched on time and to specification — including campaign parameters such as dates, targeting, tracking, impression/reach goals, geographies, and budget — working closely with Account Executives and Account Managers to align setups with client objectives 
 Providing hands-on technical support to key customers and Ad Sales partners, and owning the processes and escalation path (in partnership with Engineering) for issues related to platform integration and use 
 Partnering with Account Managers and technical teams to optimize campaign outcomes and maximize client ROI, including troubleshooting and A/B testing of messaging, creative, and targeting 
 Synthesizing campaign performance insights for internal stakeholders and clients — performance, trends, ROI, and actionable recommendations 
 Building and scaling automations and tooling (including AI/LLM-based workflows) that reduce manual effort and increase leverage across the team 
 Serving as the operational engine for multiple revenue-driving functions across the Discord Business Organization 
 
  What you should have  
 
 3–5+ years of experience in digital advertising, ad operations, or related roles 
 Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g., LLM-based workflows, scripting/automation) to drive measurable efficiency gains in a professional environment 
 Comfort working with data and light scripting — SQL required; Python or similar strongly preferred — to build or maintain internal tooling and reporting pipelines 
 Demonstrated knowledge of a broad variety of ad technologies, campaign operation methodologies, and ad tracking/measurement solutions 
 Experience partnering with Engineering and/or Product on technical escalations, platform integrations, or API-level troubleshoo

title: Senior Product Designer (B2B SaaS Startup)
description:
Our Mission

Join us in reshaping global trade in a fast-growing startup!
We are traide AI – a VC-backed, B2B deep tech startup based in Berlin, using AI to solve one of the most overlooked yet critical challenges in international trade: compliance. Our software automates product classification, reduces regulatory errors, and helps customers save up to 83% of their time on a process that is critical to get right. 
Trusted by leading brands like BMW, RIMOWA, OBI, Edeka, we've achieved 3x growth over the past 12 months – and we're just getting started.


Your tasks

  • Own the full loop. Take a user problem from rough idea to shipped interface: partner or write the brief, design the flow, prototype it, partner with engineering, ship it with as few handoffs as possible.
  • Use AI as a force multiplier. Explore and prototype with AI tools, Figma, or code, whatever gets there fastest. Your taste is the editorial layer: you know when AI-generated UI is wrong even when it looks right, and you fix it.
  • Solve from first principles. Reason about the right interaction for the user problem instead of reaching for a component library.
  • Sweat the final 10%. Craft the details others miss, the ones that make a compliance product feel trustworthy.
  • Work in small, focused pods. No layers, no waiting. You'll work closely with two or three others who share the same model.
  • Be accountable to outcomes. Know the metric your team is moving. Measure your week by what changed for users, not by screens delivered.
  • Stretch beyond design. Read the API spec, engage users directly, build in code when it's faster than Figma.

title: Chemical Laboratory Assistant / Lab Technician (f/m/d) Analytics & Synthesis
description:
Your mission

Join aevoloop, a deep-tech startup in Leipzig, where we are pioneering the next generation of circular plastics. We are looking for a hands-on Chemical Technical Assistant (CTA) or Lab Technician who takes pride in their lab work. In this role, your primary focus will be on the precise "measuring" (analytics) of our materials, while reliably supporting the team with "making" (synthesis).

  • Analytics & Characterization: You are the analytical core of our lab. You routinely perform instrumental and wet-chemical analyses to precisely characterisze our next-generation materials (e.g., NMR, IR spectroscopy, DSC, titrations).

  • Synthesis Execution: You support syntheses (specifically polycondensations) on a bench and pilot scale, reliably and accurately executing reactions according to established standard operating procedures (SOPs).

  • Daily Lab Routine & Excellence: You ensure smooth lab operations. This includes preparing and maintaining glassware, sample preparation, material drying, and general lab organization.

  • Precision & Documentation: You ensure our measurement data is rock-solid. This includes regular calibration of analytical instruments, maintaining detailed lab journals, and assisting in drafting clear SOPs.

  • Safety & Organization: You maintain a safe, high-standard working environment (GLP) and ensure analytical equipment is always ready for the next run.


Your profile

title: Condition Monitoring Engineer
description:
AssetWatch serves global manufacturers by powering manufacturing uptime through the delivery of an unparalleled condition monitoring experience, with a passion to care about the assets our customers care for every day. We are a devoted and capable team that includes world-renowned engineers and distinguished business leaders united by a common goal – To build the future of predictive maintenance. As we enter the next phase of rapid growth, we are seeking people to help lead the journey.

The primary function of the Condition Monitoring Engineer is supporting the company’s unique value proposition by generating high quality and actionable data and information for its industrial customers. This role works closely with product development, installation and customer support teams, as well as customers’ reliability engineers. In this role, you will:

  • Collect and analyze vibration and temperature data at client sites, customizing data processing to the client’s asset and determining if maintenance is needed
  • Perform vibration data collection, data analysis, software modeling and programming, and engineering evaluations
  • Evaluate machinery health and condition, through detailed analysis of vibration data
  • Develop software modeling and programs to maintain and expand vibration data analysis library to improve ability to process data
  • Provide high-quality, actionable information to clients (e.g. setting appropriate alarm levels within the analytical tools to alert customers of pending failures).
  • Accompany hardware installation team and recommend placement of machine condition sensing units.
  • Lead and grow AssetWatch predictive maintenance (PdM) tool develop program
  • Expand AssetWatch expertise in machine condition monitoring, beyond vibration analysis, to include ultrasonic analysis, oil/fluid analysis
  • Work closely with the product development team to create high-valued hardware and software solutions and expanded product offerings

Qualifications:

  • Minimum of five years of relevant experience with vibration data collection and analysis, ideally using FFT analyzers and predictive/preventative maintenance software. (Must demonstrate technical competence.)
  • Valid ISO Category II, or higher, vibration certification preferred. Continued certification expected.
  • Strong understanding of electro-mechanical fundamentals, including AC induction and DC motors
  • Strong mechanical background with industrial equipment - centrifugal and reciprocating compressors, turbines, blowers, pumps, gearboxes, hydraulics, pneumatics, etc.
  • Proficient with the operation of one or more analyzers measuring vibration spectra and time waveforms.
  • Proficient with developing optimum corrective actions based on findings of acquired field vibration analysis data, observations and discussions with key plant personnel.

title: Support Engineer
description:
Who We Are

Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too.

We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s machine learning open source and hosted tools. That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety, digitizing floor plans, preserving coral reef populations, guiding drone flight, and much more.

Roboflow is supported by great customers and investors, having raised over 63 million from Y Combinator, Google Ventures, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors.

Roboflowers are passionate builders who value ownership, accountability, and a bias toward action. We're curious, hands-on with new tech, and prefer showing our work over talking about it. Many of us have a founder mindset and thrive in our high-autonomy environment.

Who You Are

You may be a Support lifer - familiar with all that entails, or you may be a Developer who prefers a more interrupt driven approach, or you are in the technical part of a Field organisation and would like a bit more anchoring to base. We crave variety in experience, but you do like knowing the answer to questions - if you don’t know, you find out and you let others know so they don’t have to work it out for themselves.

Variety energises you, process informs you, pressure focuses you, teammates encourage you and knowledge releases you.

Accountable to the team for the reliable execution of Support’s deliverables, empowered to continually look at ways to improve the environment of Support. No question is too difficult to ask.

Empathetic to customer needs and the importance of communicating in remote relationships, you are considerate of team needs and how the experience of one engineer contributes to the whole.

Many Roboflowers have used our tools before joining. One of the best ways to stand out amongst other applicants is to write about something you have built with Roboflow or contribute to one of our open source projects.

We are hiring Support Engineers to instill confidence in our customers that they are using our solutions in the best-fit mode for their needs and Support is a safe pair of hands, if things go wrong. You will have direct input on the evolution of this role, the function of Support and the future of Roboflow.

Support at Roboflow is consultative in scope, collaborative in nature, exciting in execution and always evolving to meet the needs of our customers and the team. If you love to get your hands dirty and enjoy finding the root cause, let’s have a chat.

Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers.
We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome. And that's where you come in:

Foundry is a new division inside Instructure, built to generate new revenue with AI-built products. We operate as a portfolio of small pods, each charged with one product bet, under tight weekly governance. They operate independently, with dedicated resources, separate from the core business on purpose: different pace, different governance, and different rewards.

Our goal is to generate meaningful revenue within 12 to 18 months, so this isn’t an innovation lab. We’re building scaled businesses that customers pay for and retain well, and we’re measuring ourselves on revenue, not activity.

A pod is two people: a Founder and a Builder, both hands on, close to the customer. The bet is deliberate: we invest in agent-developer tooling and tokens, not in headcount. An operating team of growth marketing, revenue operations, sales overlay, and G&A supports every pod, so founders stay on building products.

Every pod inherits an underlying platform with common design, development, and deployment harnesses, so no pod rebuilds the plumbing. Each pod runs through key phases with regular checkpoints where a governing board reviews progress or recommends a pivot or kill.

You’re the operational engine behind New Markets’ newest product bets. The role reports directly to the President, New Markets, with a matrixed dotted line to Instructure’s Go-to-Market Strategy and Operations leadership.

title: グループ人事統括部 採用育成部：新卒採用マネージャー候補 （RLDD）
description: Job Description   楽天・事業について  楽天グループはイノベーションを通じて、人々と社会を“エンパワーメント”することを経営の基本理念としています。  インターネット・ショッピングモール「楽天市場」をはじめ、旅行予約サイト「楽天トラベル」などのECサービス、「楽天銀行」などの金融サービス、プロスポーツなど、70以上の多様なサービスを提供しています。  部署・サービスについて  楽天グループ株式会社における新卒採用のうち、エンジニア以外のすべてのポジションの採用を担当している部署です。国内にとどまらず、海外を含め世界中から優秀な学生を採用することをミッションとしています。楽天での新卒採用は規模感も大きく、新卒採用自体が人材獲得戦略の中核に位置付けられていることから経営トップとの接点も多く、やりがいのある仕事です。  ＜楽天の人事で経験出来る事＞  多様な環境、かつ大規模な人事業務経験を積むことができる  ・急成長を遂げる楽天において、拡大する楽天経済圏と、急速に進化を続けるインターネット産業におけるヘッドクォーターの人事部において、多角的な視野、視点を育むことが出来る環境です。  ・完成されたフローを遂行するだけではなく、毎年の市場動向や会社の戦略的優先事項を踏まえて、さまざまな新しい試みや改善を推進することが求められています。規模の大きい企業内で、スピード感と大規模な採用活動を企画・推進し、楽天グループの更なる発展に貢献できます。  グローバル環境  日本のみならず、海外のグループ会社の人事と連携し、グローバルな人事戦略をリードしていただきます。多岐にわたるステークホルダーをマネジメントしながら、大規模プロジェクトを推進いただきます。  豊富なキャリアパス  グループ人事統括部内は、給与、研修、採用、HRBPと様々な人事機能をもつ課で構成されています。その為様々なPJTを通じ他部署とのコミュニケーションも盛んであり、他部署の業務を知る機会があります。グループ人事統括部内で様々なHRとしてのキャリアを積んでいただくことも可能です。  ポジション：  募集背景  組織強化による増員募集  業務内容  年間数百名規模の総合職の新卒採用を行っている新卒採用グループにおいて、採用戦略の立案から実行、組織マネジメント、進捗管理と報告までを幅広くお任せします。  ＜新卒採用活動のプロセス管理とリクルーターマネジメント＞  ・全体進捗の管理と課題に応じた施策の推進  ・各リクルーターの活動管理  ＜採用戦略の立案と実行＞  ・中長期的な採用戦略の企画  ・目標・KPI設定と進捗管理（来期の採用目標と具体的なKPIを策定し、進捗をリアルタイムで管理。データ分析に基づき、最適なPDCAサイクルを回します。大規模採用における複雑な進捗を正確に把握し、戦略的にコントロールします。）  ・年間施策の企画・実行（採用ブランディング強化、選考プロセスの改善など）  ・予算管理と現状分析  ・採用ブランディング戦略の立案、実行  ※将来的には、採用育成部内でのキャリアローテーションも視野に入れており、採用のプロフェッショナルとしてだけでなく、人事領域でキャリアを広げるチャンスがあります。  働く環境  配属先は十数名のチームメンバーで構成されています。  必須要件：  ・年間百名以上の採用を行っている企業でのリクルーター経験  ・部下のマネジメント経験（人数は問わず）  歓迎要件：  ・ビジネスでの英語使用経験  ・プロセス設計・計数管理のご経験  その他：  勤務地に関する補足  楽天クリムゾンハウス（東京）  #コーポレート職 #corporate #人事 #総務 #広報 #HR #GA #CorporateCommunications #オペレーションディビジョン #operationdiv

title: Applied Operations Research Engineer
description:
We are building the world's decision infrastructure: the strategic twin of every industrial organization for complex combinatorial problems. We unlocked what wasn't possible before: mapping reality with its levers and constraints into a computer, then running n-dimensional optimization on critical value-chain decisions. We help Europe stay strong and the German Mittelstand make good decisions between market shifts, orders, machines and people.

Founded by Dana (CEO) and Erik (CTO) from RWTH research, backed by a €2.8M round led by Vorwerk Ventures, with customers live on our optimization models.

We move fast. We care. No patience for problems left unsolved.

Your mission

Hi, I'm Erik, CTO of Circonomit. This ad is specific on purpose: you should be able to tell from it whether this is your job.

We build decision infrastructure for industrial companies: our customers model their production, with its capacities, costs and constraints, and we compute the answer to "what should we do?" before the decision is made. Our engine turns that model into one artifact that both evaluates like a spreadsheet and optimizes like a solver. It sits between two worlds: the mathematics that makes the answer correct, and the product that has to make it usable by people who are not mathematicians.

That bridge is your mission. You work with our math and OR team to translate real customer problems into models, and you develop the engine that runs them.

We will not sugarcoat it: combinatorial search is unpredictable, customer data arrives messy, and some weeks a deadline sets the priority.

What you'll own

  • Customer models, end to end. Turn a planning problem, with its capacities, costs, lead times and shift plans, into a model whose answer a plant manager acts on. That includes the data it runs on: ERP and Excel exports, and catching the numbers that cannot be right before the c

Als Mid-Market Account Executive (m/w/d) wirst du Teil eines dynamischen, ambitionierten und internationalen Teams von Account Executives, das auf Zusammenarbeit, täglichen Wissensaustausch und die kontinuierliche Optimierung von Vertriebsprozessen setzt. title: Finance Manager
description:
Finance Manager

Hybrid (UK-based) | Full-Time

Flexibility on how often you come into the office, as long as you're able to travel to the London office when required.

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (Risk.net). Our network handles over $50 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 40+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We're looking for a Finance Manager to own the operational management of our finance function — accurate, timely management accounts, statutory accounts oversight, and the processes and controls that keep our finances reliable as we scale. You'll run month-end close, own balance sheet reconciliation and cash flow, lead the team responsible for AR/AP, payroll, VAT, and HMRC processes, and bring the analytical rigour that helps us make good financial decisions as we grow.

You'll also manage external relationships (auditors, solicitors, bankers), support external investment and funding activity, and run accounts across multiple business entities, including regulated entities in different geographies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Month-end close and reporting

title: Senior Relationship Manager
description: About LeoVest Partners AG      LeoVest Partners AG is a Swiss independent EAM – Multi Family Office headquartered in Zurich with an office in Geneva. The firm manages CHF 2 billion AUM and employs 29 professionals combining 765 years+ of experience. We are one of the largest independent EAMs in Switzerland (top 5% AUM) and are solely owned by the 11 co-founders.     Guided by a democratic governance model, all strategic decisions are made collectively by the partners, ensuring independence, transparency, stability and continuity. We align our long-term focus for our clients’ benefit.     LeoVest operates under the supervision of AOOS, is licensed by FINMA and a member of the Swiss Association of Asset Managers. We focus on servicing HNWIs and UHNWIs based in Switzerland, UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Finland and several European countries, Canada, South Africa and Israel.        Our vision “Wealth Management Simplified”      In an age where clients have access to abundant market information, our duty is to guide them through complexity, the storms, and provide clear advice and solutions. Beyond traditional asset management, LeoVest delivers dedicated, discreet and high-quality services.     We offer two proven investment philosophies. Our Active Investing approach is a contrarian, value-based strategy built on rigorous fundamental analysis, seeking undervalued opportunities through a disciplined building block framework and long-term investment horizon. Our Passive Investing approach follows a systematic four-factor model, combining Growth, Value, Momentum and Size factors to deliver diversified and cost-efficient market exposure.      Why do experienced Relationship Managers join LeoVest?      Every person has their own reasons.  Some are looking for greater entrepreneurial freedom.  Others want to become true partners rather than employees.  Many are looking for a firm with modern infrastructure, an outstanding team and a culture of partnership where decisions are made together.     If these questions are on your mind, I recommend reading the recent finews.ch interview about LeoVest - Link to the article:  LeoVest wächst in zweieinhalb Jahren auf 2 Milliarden Franken   It provides a good overview of who we are, what we stand for and where we are heading.  If this resonates with you, I would be happy to have a confidential conversation.      Stephan Matti      CEO & Co-Founder   LeoVest Partners AG

Ensure regular contacts with all stakeholders of the corporate groups such as owner, purchasing, expansion, marketing and clinical. Negotiate on C-Level, including Purchasing and Clinical team in order to fix winning collaboration models framed in contracts.   Be the single point of contact for all customer requests and coordinate the follow up with all the internal departments.   Build up best practices in working with these large organizations and increase our conversion rate over time through applying lessons learnt but also through testing new ideas.   Develop and unlock growth potential of our customers, increasing sales for both short term and long term, and ultimatively increase the company market share. He/she works to increase a company’s revenues by penetrating the Straumann Group portfolio within the agreed customer base, and successfully drive assigned growth projects. title: Customer Experience Manager
description: Looking for a workplace for the future?  At Telenor, you own your career. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to make the most of your dreams and expertise while contributing to technological innovations that are barely even imagined today. Innovations that we know will change the map for how we communicate and live our connected lives in the future. Are you looking for a workplace where you can make a difference in what matters most – relationships between people? Then you are welcome to Telenor.  We are now looking for a Customer Experience Manager to join our Customer Excellence & Change team within Telenor Business. We work closely with Sales, Commercial, Operations, Product and IT to create simple, seamless, and customer-focused experiences.  As a Customer Experience Manager, you will own and develop the Customer Experience strategy and roadmap for Telenor Business.
