title: Customer Development Manager, Sourcebynet
location: Aabenraa, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
description: Customer Development Manager    Karriererolle med fokus på forretningsudvikling og kommerciel vækst      Sourcebynet ser ind i en spændende udviklingsfase. Med en ny CEO, en klar vækstagenda og betydelige muligheder på markedet ønsker man at styrke virksomheden med en nyoprettet stilling som Customer Development Manager. En rolle for dig, der motiveres af at være tæt på kunder, drive komplekse projekter og samtidig bidrage aktivt til den videre forretningsudvikling.       Forretningsudvikling, kommerciel projektledelse og kunderelationer   Du vil i rollen have fokus på at videreudvikle samarbejdet med en stor eksisterende kunde på det tyske marked, hvor der ligger et betydeligt vækstpotentiale. Samtidig vil du bidrage til markedsudviklingen i blandt andet Polen, Frankrig og andre europæiske markeder.     Du fungerer som bindeled mellem kunder og Sourcebynets internationale organisation, hvor du sikrer fremdrift fra det første kundebrief gennem produktudvikling og sourcing til den endelige implementering.     Derudover får du en vigtig rolle i den mere strategiske og analytiske del af forretningen. Du vil blandt andet arbejde med markeds- og kundeanalyser, opportunity mapping, go-to-market-planer, business cases og vurdering af kommercielt potentiale. På baggrund af data og markedsindsigt identificerer du nye muligheder og omsætter dem til konkrete anbefalinger, strategiske initiativer og handlingsplaner. Dermed bliver du en vigtig sparringspartner for både General Manager Nordic og CEO i spørgsmål relateret til vækst og forretningsudvikling på tværs af værdikæden.       Proaktiv, analytisk styrke og kommercielt drive    Du har en relevant videregående uddannelse, formentlig inden for commercial development, strategi eller lignende, suppleret med minimum 2–6 års relevant erfaring inden for forretningsudvikling, key account management, product management, category management eller kommerciel projektledelse.     Du trives med at arbejde tæt med kunder, drive projekter på tværs af funktioner i værdikæden og omsætte kundebehov, data og markedsindsigt til konkrete initiativer.     Du arbejder analytisk og struktureret og er samtidig proaktiv og nysgerrig. Du motiveres af at være i en international organisation, hvor du skal navigere på tværs af funktioner, kulturer og interessenter og formår at skabe fremdrift gennem relationer og samarbejde.      Stillingen indebærer 30–40 rejsedage årligt. Du taler og skriver flydende dansk og engelsk og er bosiddende, så du kan være synlig på kontoret i Aabenraa tre dage om ugen.      Ansøg   Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Research Consultant Majbrit Kock Andersen på 2628 3821. title: CVM Manager - Europe
description: About Zegna   The global leader in luxury menswear, ZEGNA was founded in the Italian Alps in 1910. Part of the Ermenegildo Zegna Group, the brand remains true to the values of its visionary Founder, Ermenegildo Zegna, who believed in creating world-class fabrics in harmony with both nature and local communities - a philosophy embodied by Oasi Zegna, the home of our values. The inspiration behind the brand’s values, Oasi Zegna, continues to guide everything we do at ZEGNA - from supporting our people to fostering a culture of growth, where craftsmanship and innovation are core elements of our learning processes and long-term growth strategy.   YOUR MISSION IN THIS ROLE   As CVM Manager - Europe you are responsible for planning, developing and executing the European Client Value Management (CVM) roadmap, with the objective of driving client loyalty, retention, reactivation and acquisition through a data-driven and client-centric approach.  Reporting to the Head of Client Engagement & CVM - Europe, the role translates customer data and insights into actionable commercial strategies, driving clienteling excellence and strengthening a consistent client engagement culture across the European retail network. Analyze customer data, CRM KPIs and market trends to identify opportunities and translate insights into actionable commercial strategies.  Lead customer segmentation and contact strategies, overseeing activation, retention and reactivation initiatives to maximize customer lifetime value.  Drive a consistent clienteling culture across Europe, partnering with Retail, Area Managers and HQ to strengthen one-to-one client engagement and share best practices.  Design and deliver training and coaching on CVM tools, clienteling and customer insights, driving adoption and continuous improvement across retail teams.  Build strong cross-functional partnerships and act as a key point of reference for CVM, ensuring alignment between strategic objectives and operational execution.     Who You Are     Strong analytical and strategic mindset, with the ability to connect customer insights, data and analytics to business opportunities and actionable commercial strategies.  Strong understanding of CRM, CVM, customer segmentation, customer insights with proven experience in CRM performance analysis and KPI management.  Excellent communication, presentation and influencing skills, with strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration capabilities.  Ability to manage multiple initiatives and priorities and translate strategic initiatives into operational execution.  Proven team leadership and people development skills.  6-7 years of relevant professional experience in CRM, Customer Marketing, Customer Analytics, CVM or related fields. title: CRM Manager | Ecommerce & DTC
description: CRM Manager | Ecommerce & DTC | German-speaking    Remote in Germany | One week per month in Vienna    €60,000–€70,000      What if you could take ownership of CRM across six consumer brands, with the freedom to build the capability as the business grows?     Acquire is the exclusive search partner to a rapidly growing European DTC business. Its ecommerce operation currently generates approximately €9 million, with plans to reach €20 million over the next two to three years.     CRM will play a central role in that growth. The foundations are in place, including Klaviyo and a migration from Magento to commercetools, but there is significant scope to improve how the business acquires, retains and develops its customers.      The role   This is a hands-on position combining strategic ownership with practical execution. You will:   Build and optimise automated customer journeys  Develop customer segmentation and personalisation  Improve first-to-second purchase conversion  Increase retention, repeat purchase and reactivation  Manage email campaign planning and delivery  Use customer and commercial data to identify opportunities  Support the introduction of a new loyalty programme  Measure CRM revenue and commercial performance  Work across multiple brands, markets and ecommerce teams      You will have the freedom to shape the CRM roadmap while remaining close enough to the detail to build campaigns, automations and segments yourself.      About you   You will ideally bring:   Native or near-native German and professional English  Three to five years of meaningful CRM experience  Experience within ecommerce, DTC or a consumer-led digital business  Hands-on experience building lifecycle campaigns, automations and segments  A strong understanding of retention, repeat purchase and customer lifetime value  The ability to connect CRM activity with revenue and wider commercial performance  Confidence working directly within a CRM platform      Klaviyo experience would be particularly useful, although comparable platform experience will be considered. Subscription, loyalty or pet-sector experience would be helpful but is not essential.     This will suit someone who wants more than responsibility for campaign delivery. As the business grows, the intention is to build a broader CRM function around this role, creating a genuine opportunity to progress into team leadership.     You can be based remotely in Germany, provided you can spend one working week per month at the company’s Vienna office

title: CRM Strategy Manager RIF 100052
description: Descrizione azienda   Per conto di una primaria realtà internazionale operante nel settore dei servizi finanziari e digitali, siamo alla ricerca di un/una  CRM Strategy Manager.   La risorsa sarà responsabile della definizione, dello sviluppo e dell’implementazione della strategia CRM a livello locale, con l’obiettivo di massimizzare il coinvolgimento dei clienti, la fidelizzazione e il valore del cliente nel lungo periodo.  La posizione prevede una stretta collaborazione con il senior management, gli stakeholder locali e i team centrali con sede presso l’Headquarter.      Posizione       Definire e implementare, in collaborazione con il senior management, la strategia CRM a livello locale, con l’obiettivo di massimizzare il customer engagement, la retention e il valore del cliente nel lungo periodo.  Gestire la governance delle performance di business del CRM, garantendo una pianificazione strutturata, il monitoraggio delle performance e una reportistica chiara dei principali KPI relativi alla clientela e alle performance commerciali.  Tradurre gli insight relativi ai clienti e al business in raccomandazioni concrete e attuabili, contribuendo alle iniziative di crescita della customer base, all’evoluzione delle strategie lungo il ciclo di vita del cliente e al miglioramento delle performance commerciali.  Costruire solide relazioni sia con gli stakeholder locali sia con i team centrali, assicurando l’allineamento sulle priorità, sulla roadmap e sugli obiettivi di business.  Assumere un ruolo operativo e hands-on sulle piattaforme CRM, guidando l’esecuzione delle campagne CRM e delle iniziative legate al ciclo di vita del cliente attraverso attività di segmentazione, targeting, campaign management e monitoraggio delle performance.       Requisiti    Almeno 5 anni di esperienza in un ruolo analogo.  Laurea magistrale in Economia o discipline affini, preferibilmente con orientamento quantitativo.  Solida conoscenza delle strategie CRM, dei principali canali di customer engagement, dei KPI e delle best practice.  Esperienza comprovata nell’utilizzo di piattaforme CRM e strumenti di analytics.  Esperienza nel settore dei Servizi Finanziari, e-commerce o business digitali costituisce un plus.  Ottime capacità di comunicazione.  Capacità di utilizzare strumenti di data analysis e soluzioni basate sull’Intelligenza Artificiale per ottimizzare il customer engagement e le performance CRM.  Ottima conoscenza professionale della lingua inglese.  Approccio agile, flessibile e orientato al cambiamento. title: Service- og personalechef - Kalundborg
description: Service- og personalechef  Har du en stærk lederprofil, interesse i personalepleje og -administration, og kan du løfte ansvaret for alle HR-relaterede opgaver i varehuset?  Som service- og personalechef i føtex indgår du i varehusets ledelse og refererer til varehuschefen.  Du har overblik og er en dygtig leder, der kan tænke bredt og strategisk, og som gennem udvikling af og uddelegering til dine medarbejdere kan skabe resultater og gode indkøbsoplevelser for vores kunder. Du har et stort overblik, der gør, at du kan sikre, at procedurer og retningslinjer bliver overholdt.   Bliv en del af sammenholdet i føtex    Hos føtex deler vi en vinderånd og en stolthed over at gøre det hele lidt mere lækkert. Vi er sammen om at give kunderne en ekstra god service og tilbyde de bedste varer i en indbydende butik med højt til loftet. Vi er dog ikke større end, at alle kender alle, så du kan se frem til at blive en del af et stort sammenhold og få en masse nye kolleger.   Dine opgaver og ansvarsområder      du skal sikre, at der bliver udfærdiget ansættelseskontrakter til alle medarbejdere  du har overordnet ansvar for elever og praktikanter i varehuset  du er overordnet lønansvarlig  du supporterer de øvrige ledere huset i anvendelsen af vores rekrutteringssystem  du er bemandingsansvarlig for serviceenheden  du er personaleansvarlig for medarbejdere i serviceenheden, så du skal fastholde og udvikle enhedens medarbejdere, rekruttere nye medarbejdere og afholde afdelingsmøder    Nøglen til denne stilling er stærk ledelse og godt overblik. For det er gennem god planlægning, strategisk tankegang og fokus på medarbejdernes trivsel og udvikling, du leverer de gode resultater.   Skab en karriere i en af Danmarks største varehuskæder    Vi ved, at når vores medarbejdere bliver dygtigere, så bliver føtex det også. Derfor bidrager vi hellere end gerne til din faglige udvikling, og hvis du mangler enkelte kompetencer eller har specifikke udviklingsønsker, tilbyder vi en lang række interne kurser som supplement til den daglige sparring.  Kan du løfte opgaven som service- og personalechef i føtex, så send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt gennem linket her på siden.   Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.    I 1960 åbnede Herman Salling den første føtex i Guldsmedgade i Aarhus og startede med det samme en indkøbsrevolution, der stadig er i gang. I dag er vi godt 15.000 kolleger, der brænder for at levere service; hurtigt, høfligt, trygt og troværdigt. Du kan komme med på holdet i et af vores over 90 varehuse eller 11 føtex food convenience-butikker. Vores historie er din vækst.

title: Service Manager
description: AzimutIBenetti è il più grande gruppo di yachting privato al mondo, leader nelle imbarcazioni da diporto di lusso.  Nelle nostre creazioni, stile e qualità si intrecciano per creare emozioni uniche. Riscopriamo ogni giorno la bellezza del "savoir faire" italiano, dove nessun dettaglio è lasciato al caso e la persona è al centro dell'intero processo produttivo.  Far parte del Gruppo significa condividere la storia, i valori e la tradizione del Made In Italy. title: Servicechef
description: Är du redo för nästa utmaning?    Får du energi av omväxling och snabbt tempo i en föränderlig miljö? Välkommen med din ansökan!    Ditt nya jobb   Som servicechef på Bravida har du ett helhetsansvar över vår serviceverksamhet, vilket innebär både ekonomi- och personalansvar. I dina arbetsgifter ingår:    Att utveckla och bevara kundrelationer  Att ansvara för avtal och ekonomiska resultat, teknisk kvalitet och dokumentation i uppdrag  Att organisera, leda och engagera medarbetare  Att arbeta med kalkyl och prognosarbete  Arbete med bland annat inköp, resursplanering och kvalitets- och arbetsmiljöarbete  Att vara delaktig i Bravidas förbättringsarbeten och utveckla serviceverksamheten     Som servicechef på Bravida får du frihet under ansvar. Vi tror på din förmåga att överträffa kundernas förväntningar genom din kunskap, ditt driv och ditt intresse.   Ditt nya team   På Bravida Visby är vi cirka 80 medarbetare inom entreprenad och service. Vi är ett gott gäng som jobbar tätt tillsammans och som värdesätter att ha roligt på jobbet!   Vi söker dig som   Vi söker dig som sätter människan i centrum! Du vet att de bästa resultaten skapas när människor trivs, utvecklas och lyckas tillsammans. title: Kunnossapidonn työnjohtaja
description: Haluatko esihenkilörooliin, jossa yksikään päivä ei ole samanlainen?  Salmen Metallilla työnjohtajana toimit kunnossapidon arjen keskiössä ja vaikutat suoraan asiakkaiden tuotannon sujuvuuteen, turvallisuuteen ja tehokkuuteen.      Tässä tehtävässä  yhdistyvät ihmisten johtaminen, kunnossapitotöiden koordinointi, projektien läpivienti sekä toiminnan jatkuva kehittäminen. Pääset työskentelemään monipuolisten kunnossapito- ja projektitehtävien parissa eri teollisuusympäristöissä ja näet konkreettisesti oman työsi vaikutukset asiakkaiden arjessa.  Salmen Metallilla kunnossapito on paljon enemmän kuin vikojen korjaamista. Olet mukana suunnittelemassa, priorisoimassa ja kehittämässä toimintaa yhdessä asiakkaiden, oman tiimin ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa. Saat vastuuta ja mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa siihen, miten työt tehdään nyt ja tulevaisuudessa.      Työnjohtajana johdat  noin 8–10 hengen osaavaa tiimiä, johon kuuluu kunnossapitoasentajia ja levyseppähitsaajia. Vastaat kunnossapitotöiden, asennusten ja projektien sujuvasta toteutuksesta sekä siitä, että työ etenee turvallisesti, laadukkaasti ja aikataulussa. Päivät koostuvat henkilöstön johtamisesta, resurssien suunnittelusta, asiakkaiden kanssa työskentelystä, käytännön ongelmanratkaisusta sekä erilaisten projektien koordinoinnista. Satunnaiset työmatkat Kuopion ulkopuolelle tuovat tehtävään mukavaa vaihtelua.      Tarjoamme sinulle  vastuullisen ja monipuolisen esihenkilötehtävän vakavaraisessa ja kasvavassa yrityksessä, jossa pääset vaikuttamaan toiminnan kehittämiseen. Saat tueksesi osaavan ja sitoutuneen tiimin sekä työyhteisön, jossa arvostetaan käytännönläheistä tekemistä, yhteistyötä ja halua kehittää toimintaa jatkuvasti. Työsuhde solmitaan joko Eilakaislan kautta tai suoraan Salmen Metallin palvelukseen.      Odotamme sinulta  kokemusta teollisuuden kunnossapidon työnjohdosta sekä kykyä suunnitella, aikatauluttaa ja priorisoida töitä järjestelmällisesti. Menestyt tehtävässä, jos johdat tiimiäsi rauhallisella ja ratkaisukeskeisellä otteella, viihdyt vaihtelevissa tilanteissa ja nautit siitä, että pääset työskentelemään sekä ihmisten että teknisten kokonaisuuksien parissa. Soveltuva tekninen koulutus, kuten insinöörin tai teknikon tutkinto, tukee tehtävässä onnistumista. Työskentely tapahtuu pääosin suomeksi, ja englannin kielen perustaidot riittävät kansainvälisten asiakkaiden ja yhteistyökumppaneiden kanssa toimimiseen.      Jos etsit tehtävää, jossa pääset yhdistämään esihenkilötyön, projektit, kunnossapidon asiantuntemuksen ja toiminnan kehittämisen, tämä voi olla juuri sinulle oikea seuraava askel urallasi. Haastattelemme ehdokkaita jo hakuajan aikana, joten jätä hakemuksesi palkkatoiveineen mahdollisimman pian. Paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Tra le  principali soft skill  che un  ICT Operations Manager  possiede vi sono:     Capacità  organizzative e di gestione del tempo ;     Capacità di  interpretare le richieste  altrui;     Capacità di  identificare l’ordine delle priorità ;     Capacità di  gestione del cambiamento ;     Capacità di  analisi ;     Spiccate doti  comunicative ;     Doti  relazionali  tramite le quali rendere l’ambiente di lavoro collaborativo;     Predisposizione alla  leadership collaborativa ;       Flessibilità .     ​    L’annuncio è rivolto a candidati di entrambi i sessi, nel rispetto delle normative vigenti in materia di pari opportunità e non discriminazione (L. 903/77 e D.Lgs. 198/2006). title: [쿠팡이츠서비스] Business Automation Program Manager (Business & Operations)
description: 회사 소개   쿠팡이츠서비스(Coupang Eats Services)는 Delivery service에 대한 차별화 전략을 세우고, 쿠팡이츠의 고객, 상점주, 그리고 배달파트너들에게 한층 더 강화된 서비스와 지원을 제공하고 있습니다. 쿠팡이츠서비스는 원하는 음식을 언제 어디서든 빠르고 안전하게 배달함으로써 고객에게 놀라운 고객 경험을 선사하고, 상점주에게는 주문부터 배달, 고객응대까지 제공하는 원스톱 서비스를 통해 안정적인 판매 기회를 확보할수 있는 시스템을 운영하고 있습니다. 여러 분야의 전문가로 구성된 쿠팡이츠서비스는 하나의 팀으로서 고객과 상점주, 배달파트너가 원하는 가치를 고민하고 연구하며, 새로운 혁신과 패러다임 변화를 이끌어가고 있습니다.      업무내용    쿠팡이츠 배달 서비스 전반의 Customer Experience(CX) 품질을 실시간으로 모니터링하고, 고객 경험에 영향을 미치는 이슈를 조기에 감지·대응할 수 있는 운영 체계를 구축합니다.  주문 퍼널(App 진입 → 검색 → 장바구니 → 결제 → 주문 완료) 전반의 핵심 지표를 관리하며, 이상 징후를 탐지하기 위한 모니터링 프레임워크 및 Detection Logic을 설계합니다.  인시던트 발생 시 SOP(Standard Operating Procedure) 준수 여부를 모니터링하고, 표준화된 대응 프로세스를 고도화합니다.  SOP가 정의되지 않은 신규 이슈 발생 시 Strategy, Product, Engineering, Operations, Merchant 등 주요 Stakeholder 및 Leadership Team과 협업하여 대응 체계를 수립하고 신속하게 에스컬레이션합니다.  자동 Alert 시스템, 운영 대시보드(Control Panel), 비즈니스 자동화 솔루션을 기획 및 구축하여 운영 효율성과 문제 탐지 정확도를 향상시킵니다.  실시간 데이터 기반으로 서비스 이상 징후를 분석하고, 전사 영향도 및 Root Cause를 파악하여 개선 과제를 도출합니다.  고객 경험 개선, 비용 효율화(Cost Efficiency), 고객 리텐션 향상을 위한 운영 전략 및 서비스 로드맵을 수립합니다.  AI 기반 운영 도구 및 Workflow Automation을 활용하여 운영 프로세스를 지속적으로 개선하고 확장합니다.  VP 및 Director 레벨을 포함한 전사 리더십과 협업하며 주요 운영 지표, 인시던트, 프로젝트 성과를 공유하고 의사결정을 지원합니다.  한국 및 일본 시장을 포함한 글로벌 운영 환경에서 Cross-functional 프로젝트를 리딩합니다.       자격 요건    총 10년 이상의 경력을 보유하신 분  Program Management, Product Management, Business Operations, Strategy, Process Improvement, Service Operations 분야 중 하나 이상의 경험을 보유하신 분  데이터 기반으로 문제를 정의하고 해결 방안을 도출한 경험이 있는 분  서비스 모니터링 체계, 운영 프로세스 또는 Incident Management 프로세스를 구축하거나 개선한 경험이 있는 분  다양한 이해관계자(Product, Engineering, Strategy, Operations 등)와 협업하며 프로젝트를 성공적으로 리드한 경험이 있는 분  복잡한 문제를 구조화하고 우선순위를 설정하여 실행할 수 있는 역량을 보유하신 분  Senior Leadership(VP, Director급) 대상 커뮤니케이션 및 의사결정 지원 경험이 있는 분  비즈니스 수준의 영어 커뮤니케이션이 가능한 분       우대 사항    배달, 커머스, 모빌리티, 플랫폼 서비스 등 대규모 운영 환경에서의 경험을 보유하신 분  Customer Experience(CX) 개선 또는 Customer Journey Optimization 경험이 있는 분  Incident Management, Emergency Response Team(ERT), Site Reliability, Service Operations 관련 경험이 있는 분  KPI 모니터링, 이상 징후 탐지, Alerting System 구축 경험이 있는 분  SQL, Python 등을 활용한 데이터 분석 경험을 보유하신 분  Airflow, Workflow Automation, API 연동, ETL Pipeline 등 비즈니스 자동화 구축 경험이 있는 분  Tableau, Looker, Power BI 등 Dashboard 및 Monitoring System 구축 경험이 있는 분  AI 기반 운영 자동화 또는 AI Tool 활용 경험이 있는 분  일본어 커뮤니케이션이 가능하신 분  빠르게 변화하는 환경에서 높은 수준의 Ownership을 가지고 문제를 해결한 경험이 있는 분       근무지    선릉 HJ 타워       전형 절차 및 안내 사항     전형절차 서류전형 - 전화면접 - 화상면접 – 최종 합격  전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.  전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.

title: Operations Manager
description: About The Opportunity     Join a stable and well-established organisation in a hands-on Operations Manager role, taking ownership of day-to-day operations across a large-scale, high-volume environment.  Lead a team of supervisors and operational staff, with responsibility for performance, service delivery, people management and daily operational requirements.  Oversee fleet availability and allocation, working closely with internal maintenance and support teams to ensure resources are available and operational requirements are met.  Monitor operational KPIs and performance data, identifying trends, implementing improvements and ensuring service, safety and compliance targets are consistently achieved.  Manage real-time operational challenges, from staffing and scheduling through to incidents, customer queries and unexpected changes, ensuring issues are resolved quickly and effectively. Strong leadership skills, with the confidence to manage performance, make decisions and take control in a fast-paced environment.  A highly organised and process-driven approach, with the ability to plan, prioritise competing demands and keep operations running smoothly.  Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with confidence interpreting KPIs, identifying trends and using data to drive improved operational outcomes.  Resilience and composure under pressure, combined with a hands-on approach and the ability to communicate effectively with a broad range of stakeholders.     What’s on Offer     A genuine opportunity to take ownership of a significant operational environment and make a tangible impact on performance.  A broad leadership role combining people management, fleet coordination, KPI management, process improvement and daily operational decision-making.  A stable organisation with long-term operational commitments and a strong focus on service delivery.  Genuine career progression opportunities for a high-performing leader, with a focus on developing internal talent and future leadership capability.     Next Steps? title: Quality & Customer Excellence Manager

title: Customer Success Specialist H/F
description: Qui sont-ils ?  🚀 Accompagner les entrepreneurs pour qu’ils réussissent.   Aujourd'hui je vais te raconter une histoire, celle de Dougs,   Nous recherchons le plus sympathique des talents pour rejoindre l’aventure Dougs et révolutionner la compta à nos côtés. L’offre est basée à Bron.  Notre mission, accompagner les entrepreneurs pour qu’ils réussissent. Comment ? Par une approche innovante et révolutionnaire de la comptabilité via une application développée en interne.  C’est parce que nous travaillons tous au service de cette mission, que nous avons le plaisir d’accompagner aujourd’hui + de 40 000 entrepreneurs.  C’est pourquoi, pour suivre lacroissance et le développement de l’entreprise, nous souhaitons voir encore plus grand et renforcer notre équipe Customer Success, afin de répondre aux besoins des clients toujours plus rapidement.   Customer Success Specialist wanted   Nous recherchons un(e) Customer Success Specialist qui prendra à coeur l’expérience de nos clients, et qui travaillera à l’améliorer au quotidien.  Descriptif du poste   🚀 Ton futur poste    La journée type d’un Customer Success Specialist   Spoiler alert : il n’y en a pas ! description: Er du teknisk nysgerrig, serviceminded og god til at løse problemer?     easyTable søger en dansktalende Customer Support & Onboarding Specialist til vores kontor på Østerbro i København. title: Move In Specialist - Fixed Term
description: Ryman Healthcare  Auckland City, Auckland  Healthcare  Fixed term full-time - NZ, On-site  Listed 5 days ago  Share Tweet Post   Description   About the Company  Ryman Healthcare is a leading provider of retirement living and care, with over 7,700 employees across New Zealand and Australia. We are dedicated to delivering exceptional care each day, ensuring our residents feel supported and confident in their living arrangements. Our approach emphasizes teamwork and a commitment to maintaining high standards, as we believe that every aspect of our service should be good enough for our own family members. We are currently undergoing a transformative phase, focusing on enhancing our commercial outcomes and improving our operational efficiency in the retirement living and aged care sectors.   About The Role   We are seeking a Move In Specialist to join our team in Auckland on a 12-month fixed-term contract. This role is critical in supporting residents and their families during a significant transition from contract to move-in. You will ensure that they feel informed, reassured, and confident throughout the process.  As the central point of contact for residents, families, and village teams, you will help reduce uncertainty, manage expectations, and proactively resolve issues before they become barriers. This position is highly relationship-driven and requires empathy, sound judgment, and the ability to navigate various perspectives and priorities.  We prefer candidates with experience in the retirement village industry, as well as those from backgrounds in healthcare admissions, banking onboarding, real estate, or hospitality who can adapt their skills to a resident-focused environment. You will work across multiple Auckland villages and visit future residents in their homes, so a high level of professionalism and relationship management is essential. A company vehicle will be provided for travel throughout the region.  Success in this role will stem from your ability to quickly build trust, manage sensitive conversations with confidence, and influence outcomes among diverse stakeholders. While adherence to processes and organization is important, these are tools that enable you to provide a seamless and positive experience for our residents.  Key Responsibilities    Build trusted relationships and guide residents through the move-in journey. title: アルムナイ専門SaaS×コンサル｜カスタマーサクセス／コンサルタント
description: ▍募集背景   アルムナイ専門サービス「オフィシャル・アルムナイ」を通じて、企業とアルムナイを繋ぐネットワークを構築し、そこから生まれる価値創出に伴走するカスタマーサクセス/コンサルタントを、事業拡大に伴い募集いたします。      ▍ハッカズークが創る、新しいHRの未来     「退職で終わらない、企業と個人の新しい関係を実現し、退職による“損失”のない社会をつくる」    私たちは、日本における「企業アルムナイ（退職者）」領域のパイオニアとして、国内No.1の専用SaaS『Official-Alumni.com』とコンサルティングサービスを提供しています。各業界のリーディングカンパニーが私たちのパートナーです。  2026年からは、採用業務支援のレイン社との合併を経て、企業の人的資本経営を包括支援する「BBB（Buy＝採用、Build＝育成、Borrow＝外部人材活用）のプラットフォームになる」という新Visionを掲げ、加速度的な成長を推進しています。      ▍なぜ今「アルムナイ」が最高に面白いのか？     ｜「日本の人事史に名を刻む」歴史の転換点に、当事者として立ち会う    長年、日本の雇用慣行において退職者は「裏切り者」と見なされ、関係が断絶されるのが一般的でした。しかし、深刻な労働人口減少とキャリアの多様化、および人的資本経営の潮流により、退職者は「重要な社外のパートナー（資産）」へと再定義されつつあります。「退職＝損失」というこれまでの当たり前を根本から覆し、「別れを資産に変える」という新たな社会常識を日本中にインストールする——このパラダイムシフトの最前線を走るのが、ハッカズークです。       ｜「採用」の枠を遥かに超える、無限の市場性と本質的な価値    アルムナイネットワークがもたらす価値は、単なる「出戻り採用（Buy）」にとどまりません。業務委託（Borrow）としてのプロフェッショナル協業、新規事業のビジネスアライアンス、人材育成（Build）としてのアルムナイメンターや社外講師、それらの先に自社ブランドのファン・ユーザー化など、その可能性は無限です。  私たちが切り拓いているアルムナイ市場は、従来のHR（人材紹介や求人広告などの単発スポット取引）とは一線を画す、企業と個人が対等に、ライフタイムで価値を創出し続ける「新しいHRインフラ」です。だからこそ、提案の幅に制限はありません。     ｜   正解がないブルーオーシャンで、自ら「勝ち筋」を定義する    アルムナイ市場には、他社を模倣できるような既成の「コンサルティングの型」がありません。日本を代表するエンタープライズ企業の経営層や人事部長と対等に向き合い、「この企業とアルムナイの最適なリレーションとは何か」をゼロベースで共に描き、実行します。  自身がクライアントと創り出した企画がメディアに大きく取り上げられ、そのまま日本の新しい常識になっていく。パイオニアであるハッカズークだからこそ、唯一無二のダイナミックな経験を積むことができます。      ▍具体的な業務内容/ミッション   クライアント（主に大手エンタープライズ企業の人事部門や経営層）と伴走し、アルムナイネットワークを活用した企画立案・プロジェクト推進をお任せします。  すでに決まった制度設計の枠組みを当てはめるのではなく、ゼロベースでお客さまと一緒に「アルムナイと企業の新しい関係」を創り出していくポジションです。     ｜具体的な業務    アルムナイ施策の戦略・戦術設計および実行支援    ミッションは、顧客企業が目指すべき「あるべき姿」を共に描き、その実現に向けて価値を広げていくためのパートナーとして伴走することです。主に、以下を想定しております。  ・アルムナイの取り組みの目的の整理やKPI/KGIの設定  ・現状の課題分析やアルムナイネットワークによる成果創出に向けた施策の提案  ・ユーザー（アルムナイ）分析/ヒアリングをもとにした改善案の提案       アルムナイコミュニティの立ち上げ・運用    「すべての人（アルムナイ）にとって、居る理由がある場所をつくる」という想いのもと、アルムナイとの関係性を構築しながらコミュニティ運営をしていくことが、私たちのミッションです。  ・ユーザー（アルムナイ）へのインタビュー  ・コンテンツ作成チームと連携したアルムナイ向け配信コンテンツ企画  ・イベント運営チームと連携した交流会やアルムナイ向けイベントの企画     その他、個社の目的別にカスタマイズした施策の提案を行なっています。新しい領域かつ答えがないため、「これをやったら必ず上手く行く」というシンプルなものではありません。そこが難しくもあり、面白いところでもあります。単なる運用コンサルティングに留まらず、ネットワークの新たな価値を創るため顧客最適で提案をカスタマイズしていけることが醍醐味です。  また、このフェーズだからこそ、手を挙げれば誰でも、クライアント支援にとどまらず、プロダクトや事業づくり、サービス開発にも関わることができます。スタートアップならではの環境をご自身のオンリーワンのキャリア形成に活用したい方、大歓迎です。      ▍ポジションの魅力   コンサルタントの介在価値が非常に高く、自らが手掛けた企画が社会的なニュースとして取り上げられるなど、世の中に大きなインパクトを与えることができます。決まった成功体験（勝ち筋）をなぞるのではなく、あなた自身のアイデアで成功事例を創り出せる環境です。     事例1：「アルムナイメンター制度」  アルムナイネットワークにいる人材を活用し、キャリア自律の観点から退職者を巻き込んだメンター制度の構築を支援。日経新聞に大きく取り上げられました。  実際の記事はこちら     事例2：「カムバックイベント」企画  結婚や出産で退職された女性社員の方々に向けた、お子さん連れOKのカムバックイベントを企画・実施。こちらもメディアの密着取材が入るなど、大きな反響を呼んでいます。  実際の記事はこちら      ▍対象となる方   ｜必須要件  以下2つのご経験を”いずれも”お持ちの方  ・法人に対するソリューション型の営業経験（提案営業経験）  ・提案したことを形にするための、課題解決に向けたプロジェクトの推進・ディレクション経験（社内外のステークホルダーを巻き込んだ経験）  ※人事・HR業界の経験や、人事コンサルティングの経験は【不問】です！     ｜歓迎要件  ・大手企業（エンタープライズ領域）に対するアカウントマネジメント経験  ・無形商材を用いた企画提案の経験  ・イベント企画やコンテンツ制作などのディレクション経験     ｜求める人物像  ・既成の枠組み（決まったコンサル手法）を当てはめるだけでなく、ゼロベースで自ら考えることができる方  ・クライアントの成功に向けて、枠に囚われず「なんでもやる」スタンスを持てる方  ・IPOを目指す過渡期のフェーズにおいて、整っていない環境（カオス）を楽しみ、自ら道を作っていける方      ▍諸条件   詳細はこちら

title: Commissioning Manager

description: Company Description  Data-Centric Engineering Sdn Bhd is a Malaysia-based engineering company focused on delivering high-quality, data-driven solutions for industrial and infrastructure projects. Day-to-day tasks include developing commissioning plans, procedures, and schedules; supervising site commissioning teams; conducting functional and performance tests; and ensuring that all systems are installed and operating according to design specifications, safety regulations, and client requirements. The Commissioning Manager will collaborate with design, construction, and operations teams to resolve technical issues, manage documentation, and support audits and inspections. This role also involves reporting progress, identifying risks, and implementing corrective actions to ensure timely and successful project completion. Excellent project coordination and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to work with multidisciplinary teams and external contractors.  Ability to analyze technical issues, troubleshoot system performance, and recommend practical solutions under time and resource constraints.  Strong communication skills in English (written and verbal); proficiency in Bahasa Malaysia is an advantage.  Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, or related discipline) or equivalent professional experience.  Previous experience in a managerial or supervisory role in commissioning or project execution is highly beneficial.  Willingness to work on-site, adhere to safety requirements, and occasionally travel to project locations if required.

title: Principal, Renewal Operations & Strategy
description: Nexthink is the leader in digital employee experience management software. The company provides IT leaders with unprecedented insight allowing them to see, diagnose and fix issues at scale impacting employees anywhere, with any application or network, before employees notice the issue. As the first solution to allow IT to progress from reactive problem solving to proactive optimization, Nexthink enables its more than 1,200 customers to provide better digital experiences to more than 15 million employees. Dual headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland and Boston, Massachusetts, Nexthink has 9 offices worldwide.          Job Description    We're looking for a  Principal, Renewal Operations & Strategy  — a senior individual contributor who will own the health, performance, and integrity of our entire renewal portfolio. This is not a people-management role; it's a high-impact expert track position for someone who wants to shape how a fast-growing B2B SaaS company renews, retains, and grows its customer base at scale.    You'll sit at the intersection of  Analytics, Governance & Policy, and Sales Process  — the person every team turns to when they need to understand what's happening across renewals, why it's happening, and what to do about it. Design forecasting, cohort models and early-warning indicators to flag at-risk accounts before they become losses. title: Project Manager IT/Digitalisering
description: Nammo er en sentral aktør i utviklingen av Europas forsvarskapasitet og spiller en stadig viktigere rolle i oppbyggingen av forsyningssikkerhet og produksjonskapasitet for allierte nasjoner. For å møte denne utviklingen etablerer Nammo Raufoss AS nå en dedikert programorganisasjon med ansvar for å sikre en enhetlig og profesjonell gjennomføring av større investerings- og utviklingsprogrammer. Programorganisasjonen skal etablere felles metodikk, styringsmodeller, prosesser og ressurser for programgjennomføring, samt bidra til læring, kompetansebygging og effektiv ressursutnyttelse på tvers av virksomheten.     Linje 4 er det første og mest omfattende programmet som planlegges gjennomført innenfor denne strukturen. Programmet representerer en investering i milliardklassen og skal etablere ny produksjonskapasitet, styrke operasjonell robusthet og legge grunnlaget for videre vekst og utvikling av virksomheten.     Programorganisasjonen etableres med et langsiktig perspektiv og skal danne grunnlaget for gjennomføringen av fremtidige investerings- og utviklingsprogrammer i Nammo. Rollen vil derfor ikke bare bidra til realiseringen av Linje 4, men også bli en del av et miljø som skal videreføres og utvikles i takt med selskapets videre vekst og investeringsagenda.     For å sikre vellykket gjennomføring av IT- og digitaliseringsleveranser søker vi en erfaren Project Manager IT/Digitalisering som kan lede digitalisering som en integrert del av etableringen av fremtidens produksjonskapasitet og industrielle plattform.      Om rollen   Project Manager IT og digitalisering har det overordnede ansvaret for planlegging, koordinering og gjennomføring av IT- og digitaliseringsleveranser knyttet til programmet. Rollen vil i første fase ha sitt hovedfokus på Linje 4, samtidig som den blir en del av Nammos langsiktige satsing på digitalisering og bidrar til utviklingen av fremtidige investerings- og utviklingsprogrammer.  Rollen skal etablere og lede IT- og digitaliseringsleveranser som en integrert arbeidsstrøm i programmet og sikre at disse gjennomføres i tråd med programmets mål, milepæler og styringsmodell. Stillingen vil være organisert i digitaliseringsfunksjonen, men arbeide tett integrert i programorganisasjonen og fungere som bindeledd mellom prosjektledelse, produksjon, IT, digitalisering og eksterne leverandører.     Prosjektleder IT og digitalisering rapporterer til direktør for digitalisering.      Ansvar    Hovedområder         Etablere og eie IT- og digitaliseringsleveranser som en integrert del av Linje 4-programmet  Oversette programmets behov til tydelig scope, planer og leve

title: Customer Success Manager (H/F)
description: Nos convictions sur l'évolution de la GRC La GRC d'aujourd'hui fonctionne comme il y a vingt ans : captures d'écran en guise de preuves, revues annuelles, contrôles vérifiés a posteriori. Pendant ce temps, les SI se déploient plusieurs fois par jour, l'IA générative redessine les surfaces d'attaque chaque trimestre, et NIS2, DORA, AI Act, CRA empilent des exigences que personne ne peut tenir manuellement.  Nous pensons que le métier doit basculer vers ce que la communauté appelle  GRC Engineering , une discipline formalisée dans le manifeste collectif grc.engineering : appliquer à la gouvernance, au risque et à la conformité la même rigueur d'ingénierie que celle qui a transformé le développement logiciel (Agile, DevOps, DevSecOps, CI/CD). Concrètement : inverser le flux (partir des systèmes réels, pas des référentiels descendants),  automatiser tôt et souvent  plutôt que de subir le travail manuel répétitif,  raisonner par la preuve et la donnée  plutôt que par la peur et l'à-peu-près,  viser des résultats mesurables sur le risque  plutôt qu'une conformité de façade, et passer d'un contrôle périodique en surface à une  assurance continue en profondeur.   Mindlapse construit la plateforme qui rend ce changement opérationnel pour les grands comptes français et européens : un produit AI-native où l'IA, les agents et l'automatisation sont des primitives de conception, et où la conformité devient une propriété mesurée en continu sur les systèmes réels du client. Pourquoi ce poste, et pourquoi maintenant Nos premiers grands comptes sont déployés. Un produit AI-native ne se vend pas une fois : il se prouve chaque trimestre, dans l'usage réel des équipes Cyber, conformité et métiers. La valeur qu'un client perçoit à 12 mois dépend autant de la qualité du delivery et de l'adoption que du produit lui-même.  Jusqu'ici, ce rôle est tenu par les trois fondateurs (Hervé, Julien, Christophe, anciens Openminded et Accenture). Nous cherchons la personne à qui le confier.  On ne cherche pas un CSM au sens classique, qui suit des tickets et déroule un script, ni un account manager qui pousse de l'upsell, ni un chef de projet qui déroule un planning. On cherche les trois à la fois, dans un seul cerveau : quelqu'un qui porte la relation avec nos clients, qui répond de la qualité de ce qu'on leur livre, et qui fait que le produit soit réellement utilisé. Un profil de confiance, au plus proche des clients, avec une vraie expérience de la GRC, et qui partage la conviction ci-dessus.  À 3 ans, tu auras piloté la relation avec des RSSI et des directions conformité du CAC 40 / SBF 120 sur un sujet que peu de gens maîtrisent, et tu auras posé les bases du customer success d'un éditeur qui a l'ambition de redéfinir la GRC en Europe. Ce que tu feras au quotidienRelation client (~30%)   Être l'interlocuteur de référence de nos clients grands comptes après la signature : RSSI, équipes GRC, conformité, DSI, achats.    Piloter la gouvernance de la relation : comités

title: Fältserviceledare

title: Solution Consultant - Asset Management & Investment Workflows (m/f/d) (Zurich, London, Berlin, Hybrid)
description: About Optiml    Optiml is transforming real estate with Real Estate Decision Intelligence (REDI), an AI-powered decision technology that helps decarbonize buildings while optimizing asset and portfolio financial performance.   Our platform helps investors, owners, and asset managers make clearer capital allocation and decarbonisation decisions by translating complex regulatory, financial, and technical constraints into actionable renovation and investment plans.   Founded as an ETH Zurich spin-off, Optiml launched its first product in April 2024 and is now scaling across Europe and the US, with teams based in Zurich, London, and across Germany. The company is backed by leading US and European investors, including Innovation Endeavors (the fund of former Google CEO Eric Schmidt), Planet A Ventures, KOMPAS, BitStone Capital, and The Bau Ventures. Following an oversubscribed €8M Seed round, we are accelerating product development and go-to-market execution. Your focus is not deep technical implementation; it is helping asset managers, fund managers, transaction managers, and related investment-side users understand how to use Optiml in their role, how to interpret outputs, and how to turn the software into better portfolio, asset, and transaction decisions.   You will act as a core post-sale contact for investment-side users, leading onboarding, training, workflow enablement, and early value realization. You will independently onboard and train users, guide them through role-specific workflows, answer practical application questions, and help customers become confident in using Optiml for financial and investment-related use cases.   This is a highly client-facing role at the intersection of Delivery, Customer Success, Product, and Commercial. A key part of the role is to capture recurring workflow friction, user questions, and feature needs, and feed them back into Product and Delivery so the product and onboarding model improve continuously. Independently train users on how to use the platform in their specific workflows, not only on product functionality.   Translate Optiml into role-specific use cases such as asset strategy, business planning, Capex prioritization, portfolio steering, transaction support, and investment committee preparation.   Help users understand what inputs matter, how to work with assumptions, and how to interpret outputs credibly.      2️⃣ Workflow application & customer guidance      Act as a trusted day-to-day advisor for client users after sale, especially for financial and investment-related use cases. title: Change Manager
description: Change Manager    Southern Cross Wellington Hospital      Southern Cross Wellington Hospital is a private elective surgical hospital. This role has a strong project focus, so you'll be comfortable rolling up your sleeves and helping drive initiatives forward from planning through to implementation. You'll enjoy working with a wide range of stakeholders to navigate change in a complex operational environment.  We are B2Spin, and we are dedicated to delivering the best Free-to-Play Social Casino and gaming experiences by creating captivating, engaging, and unique products that are accessible to everyone. We have built a team of talented professionals from all over the globe, who are working to continually improve the experiences of our players. We are not looking to just be part of the industry, but to revolutionize it.     The Role   We run the creative function for retention at a multi-brand iGaming company. That means high-volume, high-frequency output — emails, push notifications, in-app messages, onsite banners — produced for segmented player audiences across multiple brands, all at the same time. This is a marketing creative leadership role, not a product or UX design role. You will lead a team of Digital Designers producing retention marketing assets across four brands and multiple CRM channels — not app or product interfaces.  The Design Team Lead owns the quality and consistency of that output. Not by reviewing everything personally, but by building the systems, standards, and team capability that make good work the default. This is as much an ops-and-systems role as it is a creative leadership role. If you're energized by turning "we eyeball it every time" into "we have a standard for that," this is the job.         What You Will Own    Brand systems that actually get used   Our brands are fragmented today. You'll build the documented visual systems — templates, component libraries, per-brand rules, practical "do this, not that" guidance — that designers reach for rather than work around. When the system is good, consistency stops being something we police and becomes the default.     Repeatable production at scale   Multiple designers producing work across four brands and CRM channels need modular templates, clear briefing standards, and clean versioning. You'll build and maintain those foundations. Just as importantly, you'll convert the feedback you keep repeating into checklists and onboarding material — so nobody gives the same note twice.     AI that produces on-brand results, not surprises   We already use AI heavily; the results aren't predictable enough. You'll put structure around it: per-brand prompt libraries, locked reference styles, clear review checkpoints, and training on how to take a raw AI output and finish it to a genuinely on-brand standard.     Quality that can be measured   You'll define what "on-brand and high quality" means for each brand, track simple signals like first-pass approval rate and rework volume, and catch delivery or quality risks before they hit send dates. You'll also keep improving how the team works — processes, tools, handovers — without waiting to be asked.     A team that feels clear and supported   Regular 1:1s, honest consistent feedback, and being the person designers come to when they're stuck. You'll monitor workload

title: (Senior) Data Analyst – Business Intelligence (BI) (m/w/d)
company: Mittwald CM Service GmbH & Co. KG
description:
Dein Purpose:

Ohne dich treffen wir Entscheidungen im Bauchgefühl. Mit dir bei entstehen ein Zahlenfundament und eine Perspektive, die beides können: erklären, was war und aufzeigen, was möglich ist. Du hast in der Vergangenheit nicht nur mit Daten gearbeitet, sondern bereits Strukturen aufgebaut, Prozesse etabliert und einen BI-Bereich wirklich geprägt? Dann bring deinen Erfahrungsschatz bei uns ein!

Für diese Themen brennst du:

Den Wald sehen, nicht nur die Bäume.

Du liebst es, Zusammenhänge zu erkennen, die andere übersehen. Komplexe Datenlagen schrecken dich nicht ab – du machst sie navigierbar und verständlich. Gleichzeitig weißt du, welche strategisch relevant sind und welche nicht.

Aus wenig viel machen.

Perfekte Datenlage? Die gibt es selten. Du weißt, wie du mit dem arbeitest, was da ist, machst Annahmen transparent und sprichst dennoch klaren Handlungsempfehlungen aus.

Übersetzen statt berichten.

Zahlen allein verändern nichts. Du bringst sie zum Sprechen und schaffst eine Basis für fundierte Entscheidungen. Du hast ein gutes Gespür, welche Daten Geschäftsführung, Finanzen und Product Management brauchen und weißt genau, wie du Komplexität so aufbereitest, dass sie Entscheidungen beschleunigt statt verzögert.

Gestalten, nicht warten.

Du siehst, was fehlt, und fängst an - ohne vollständige Roadmap, ohne perfekte Grundlage. Du hast bereits in einem anderen Kontext BI Strukturen aufgebaut und weißt wo die Fallstricke liegen – dieses Wissen möchtest du bei uns einbringen.

So bringst du deine Skills ein:

  • Dich erwartet eine grüne Wiese: Du baust den BI-Bereich auf – Strukturen, Prozesse, Tooling – und entwickelst ihn iterativ weiter

  • Du beschleunigst Entscheidungen durch verlässliche Analysen, Prognosen

(Fully remote, async-first, DevTools SaaS, 40h/week, time zones: UTC-3 to UTC+3)

The best developers don't wait for a customer to tell them something's broken.

They catch it first, in the pull request, in staging, or in the checkout flow at 3am, before a single user notices. That instinct is Checkly's whole reason to exist. We give developers and their agents the tools to own reliability the way they own their code: monitoring defined as code, powered by OpenTelemetry and Playwright, versioned and reviewed like everything else they ship. From pull request to post-mortem, in one place.

Thousands of them, from modern AI companies like Mistral and resolve.ai to large engineering orgs like LinkedIn, Citi, and 1Password, build with us. Now we need a PM who wants to take that further, in a market being rewritten in real time.

Here's the thing about 2026: AI agents and coding assistants are shipping more software, faster, than any team could review by hand, and more of it is breaking in ways nobody has seen before. LLM-backed features fail probabilistically. Agents take actions no runbook anticipated. "Is my app healthy?" is becoming an unanswerable question for a whole generation of AI-native software. Nobody has really figured out what reliability means for this kind of software yet. That's the problem you'd own.

As a Product Manager, you will be responsible for empowering developers and designers to solve customer problems. You will work directly with our SVP Product Engineering

description:
Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!

We are seeking a dynamic and pragmatic Scrum Master to join our diverse global team. As a Scrum Master, you will play a crucial role in supporting our Agile transformation. About Teramind

Teramind is a global leader in workforce intelligence, insider risk management, and data loss prevention. Used by thousands of companies across 60+ countries, our platform gives organizations the visibility to protect their people, their data, and their operations. We sit at the intersection of three converging markets - Insider Risk, DLP, and Workforce Analytics - and we are one of the few players that spans all three on a unified behavioral data layer.

The Teramind Endpoint Agent is one of the key differentiators of our platform. It runs on hundreds of thousands of endpoints across Windows, macOS, and Linux, capturing the behavioral signal that powers our detection, DLP enforcement, analytics, and AI. The depth and quality of what the Agent sees is a primary reason customers choose Teramind over the alternatives - and the product leader who owns it plays a pivotal role in the company's success.

About the Role

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the Teramind Endpoint Agent, and the AI Usage Control capabilities built on top of it, end to end. You will be the single accountable product leader for the roadmap, priorities, and outcomes of the Agent organization - approximately half of Teramind engineering, working across operating systems, low-level platform components, and the server-side telemetry pipeline. This is a pivotal role. The Agent is one of the strongest competitive moats Teramind has, and the next chapter of the product strategy depends on what we build into it. You are coming in to bring product rigor, customer insight, prioritization discipline, and technical judgment to a team that is capable of shipping world-class endpoint technology. AI Usage Control is one of the most important things you will build here. Companies have spent twenty years governing what employees do with sensitive data, and they now have a second workforce: AI agents reading files, calling tools, and executing commands on the same machines, with none of the accountability. Nobody has worked out what supervising them looks like, and much of it never touches the network, so the endpoint is the only place you can see it. You will own that end to end. You will sit alongside other product managers, reporting to the VP of Product. Together, you own Teramind's product surface area.

What's it all about?

The balance of power in the energy industry needs to change. The intermittency of renewable supply and the constant demands of the grid mean that we still rely on less efficient, more expensive and unsustainable fossil fuels to keep the lights on. At Gridfuse, our mission is to shift this balance through technology. To shift the balance of inputs, so that renewables become the world's main source of electricity.  

At Gridfuse, we develop the software that controls real renewable energy assets and turns them into a coordinated Virtual Power Plant (VPP) that can respond intelligently to energy markets and grid conditions.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build the systems that connects our platform to these assets and turn energy-market and grid requirements into real-world actions. Your code will influence when batteries charge or discharge, how renewable assets respond, and how reliably these assets can participate in the electricity system. 

You will own and evolve core parts of the Control services, working closely with other software engineers and our renewable-energy experts.

Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

The Role
 
Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSEs) work directly with customers to quickly understand their greatest problems and design and implement solutions to use data against them. You’ll have the opportunity to gain rare insight into and contribute to some of the world’s most important industries and institutions.

As an FDSE, your responsibilities look similar to those of a startup CTO: you’ll work in small teams with minimal supervision and own end-to-end execution of high stakes projects. Your day might span discussing architecture with fellow engineers, wrangling massive-scale data, coding a custom web app, speaking with customer executives, or establishing strategy for your team.

Whether you aspire to be an entrepreneur or an engineering leader, we believe Palantir is the best place — with the best colleagues — to learn how.   • Multiple production-ready AI/LLM systems that you’ve shipped to real users and taken responsibility for - no prototypes
  • Demonstrable product ownership: from a vague problem to a finished product
  • Strong Python skills and a solid foundation in software engin

title: Prozessingenieur

MicroHarvest ist ein schnell wachsendes scale-up in Hamburg, das mithilfe von Mikroorganismen, durch ein nachhaltiges Verfahren, besseres, gesünderes und schmackhafteres Protein produzieren wird. Du entscheidest mit dem CFO, welche fünfzehn Kennzahlen sein Unternehmen künftig steuern.

Montag: Kick-off bei einem Maschinenbauer mit 400 Mitarbeitenden. Auf dem Tisch liegen DATEV, ein ERP, ein CRM, eine Zeiterfassung — und die Frage, warum die Geschäftsführung sechs Wochen nach Monatsende noch keine belastbare Deckungsbeitragsrechnung hat. Freitag: eine priorisierte Liste von Use Cases, eine Roadmap in Wellen, die ersten Kennzahlendefinitionen abgestimmt.

In anderen Tech-Unternehmen heißt dieselbe Arbeit Deployment Strategist, Value Engineer oder Client Value Partner.

ValueWorks ist eine Decision-Intelligence-Plattform für Geschäftsführungen, CFOs und Private-Equity-Investoren im deutschsprachigen Raum. Wir verbinden die Daten aus den Systemen, die unsere Kunden ohnehin haben, in einem semantischen Layer zu einem konsistenten Bild des Unternehmens — und machen daraus Steuerung: Reporting, Diagnose, Planung, OKR. Vier bis acht Wochen bis zum ersten Dashboard.

Gegründet wurde ValueWorks von einem Team aus McKinsey, Bain und SAP — mit entsprechend viel Erfahrung darin, wie Unternehmen tatsächlich gesteuert werden und woran Steuerung in der Praxis scheitert.

Aufgaben

Kick-off und Zielbild: Du moderierst den Kick-off-Workshop — Geschäftsmodell, Systemlandschaft über zehn Prozessbereiche, Pain Points der Führungsmannschaft.

Use Cases ableiten und priorisieren: Aus der Systemlandschaft entwickelst du, was für diesen Kunden möglich und wertvoll ist — von der P&L-Restrukturierung über Pipeline-Forecasts bis zur Churn-Prognose aus CRM-, Support- und Produktdaten. Priorisierung nach Wichtigkeit und Umsetzbarkeit, daraus schneidest du die Umsetzungswellen.

Kennzahlen definieren: Du bringst Finance und Fachbereich zu einer gemeinsamen Definition von „Auftragseingang" oder „DSO" und übersetzt sie so, dass sie im semantischen Layer eindeutig umsetzbar ist. Der anspruchsvollste und wertvollste Teil der Arbeit.

title: Brand & Communications Lead  (all genders) B2B SaaS for KMU
description:
Small and medium businesses are the backbone of the German economy, and a painful share of their time and cash disappears into compliance. Bookkeeping, VAT returns, annual accounts. Mandatory, joyless, overpriced.

We are building the infrastructure that changes it. Since none of this work is optional, it is closer to infrastructure than to software, and our reason to do it is to lower the cost of doing business in Germany.

Eight months took us from 100 to more than 700 customers, and we are still small. That shapes every role here: a whole area to own, more to build than there are people, and scope that expands with you. English is our working language, the team is international, the market is German.

Tasks

We are looking for a very particular kind of person.

Somebody who can move a brand forward in words, in images and emotionally, all three at once. How we come across is one thing, not three, and it falls apart the moment the copy, the visuals and the feeling get decided separately by people pulling in different directions.

Here is why it matters more here than in most companies. Our subject is bookkeeping, finance and annual accounts. Objectively one of the least exciting things a business owner deals with, and an industry that looks and sounds exactly like that. Our entire bet is that we do not feel like that industry: approachable, likeable, close to the customer, never intimidating. title: Principal AI & Agent Systems Engineer (gn) @ Fusion Energy Venture, Munich
description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.

About the Venture

We are building a new path to fusion energy. Every major leap in human civilisation has followed a breakthrough in energy, from fire to steam to electricity, and we believe fusion is the next one. Our bet is that it will not come from building bigger machines. It will come from controlling matter with enough precision that fusion becomes a manufacturable technology, atoms aligned exactly enough that fusion happens under controlled conditions, on a chip. This is a semiconductor-scale path to clean power, and our stance is precision over brute force. We start in physics and simulation, then build the physical proof. 

About the Role

Reaching a chip-scale approach means working through physics and simulation at a depth that is hard to reach by conventional means, and to do that we need a new class of scientific intelligence. You will work directly with the founders to design that system from the ground up: an AI-driven research platform that can read papers, connect ideas across disciplines, orchestrate simulations, evaluate hypotheses and learn from results. This is not a chatbot or prompt engineering role, and we are not building a foundation model or competing with OpenAI, Anthropic or Google. We believe these systems will need richer representations than today's token-prediction models, so you will help explore new architectures for scientific reasoning, memory, hypothesis generation and autonomous discovery. The better that system works, the faster we get to the physical proof.

title: Customer Success Manager
description: About the Role   Userpilot gives product teams a fully customizable experience layer that sits on top of their UI, enabling them to deliver contextual, personalized flows triggered by user behavior, journey stage, and segment. It's a technically versatile platform, and making it work for a high volume of customers efficiently is the challenge this role is built around.  You'll manage a large book of smaller EMEA accounts, working through a scaled, tech-touch model rather than high-touch 1:1 engagement. That means you'll rely heavily on data, automation, and programmatic outreach to drive retention outcomes - your leverage comes from well-designed playbooks and knowing when to intervene, not from calendar coverage. Our Implementation team handles installation, integrations, and initial setup; your job is to keep customers activated, engaged, and renewed at scale.      What You'll Own    Gross retention across a high-volume EMEA book of business  Executing and iterating on scaled engagement playbooks - onboarding sequences, health-triggered outreach, group webinars, and in-app guidance rather than bespoke account strategy  Monitoring health signals and usage data across your book to identify at-risk accounts and prioritize intervention efficiently  Running lightweight account reviews and check-ins with higher-value accounts in your segment, where 1:1 time is warranted  Coordinating with AEs on expansion signals within your book. They own the commercial motion, you surface the opportunities  Escalating product feedback and customer needs to internal teams in a structured, aggregated way  Contributing to the development of self-serve resources, templates, and playbooks that improve outcomes across the full customer base       What We're Looking For    Required    2+ years in a Customer Success, Account Management, or digital CS role at a B2B SaaS company  Experience managing a high-volume book. You know how to segment, triage, and prioritize across dozens or hundreds of accounts without losing signal on the ones that matter  Comfortable building and executing scaled engagement motions: automated sequences, group sessions, templated outreach - not just 1:1 calls  Data-driven by default: you use health scores, usage trends, and CRM data to drive prioritization, not instinct  Strong written communication - at scale, async, and written touchpoints do a lot of the work  Genuine comfort using AI tools in your workflow - for drafting outreach, synthesizing customer data, identifying risk patterns, and scaling your output. This isn't a nice-to-have; it's how this team operates    Bonus    Experience with product analytics, user engagement, or in-app tooling platforms  Fluency in additional European languages - given the breadth of the EMEA book, this is a meaningful advantage  Familiarity with APIs, JavaScript, or web fundamentals  UI/UX sensibility       Benefits    Competitive base salary + performance-based bonus  Private medical insurance  Hybrid str

title: Onboarding & Technical Support Manager | Legal AI Startup
description: Kleine und mittelständische Kanzleien machen über 90 % des deutschen Rechtsmarkts aus – doch beim Thema KI sind sie auf sich allein gestellt: keine Innovation-Teams, keine Legal Engineers, keine Zeit für monatelange Tool-Evaluierungen. Für sie bauen wir Silvernova: den KI-Associate, der in der Akte des Anwalts denkt und Anwälten täglich bis zu 4 Stunden Arbeitszeit spart. So sind wir in 15 Monaten  von 0 auf 400+ Anwaltskanzleien  und  über 1 Mio. € ARR  gewachsen – nahe Break-even, mit einem Team von 13 Leuten. Hinter uns stehen hochkarätige VCs und Business Angels, darunter Partner renommierter Kanzleien wie YPOG, CMS und Neon. Unser nächster Schritt:  Kanzleienzahl und ARR verzehnfachen.     Und hier kommst du ins Spiel.  Du übernimmst unseren Support und das technische Onboarding in eigener Verantwortung – von der Einrichtung neuer Kanzleien über jede Supportanfrage bis zum System dahinter. Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für unsere Kunden bei allen technischen und produktbezogenen Fragen – und die Person im Team, die am besten weiß, was unsere Kunden bewegt.   Dabei arbeitest du nicht nur Anfragen ab, sondern machst den Support Woche für Woche besser: Hilfe-Center, Playbooks, KI-gestützte Antworten. Dein Ziel ist, dass dieselbe Frage kein zweites Mal gestellt werden muss – so wächst deine Rolle mit uns, statt in Tickets unterzugehen. Und wenn das Kundenwachstum irgendwann eine zweite Support-Kraft braucht, kommt sie in dein System – und du übernimmst die Verantwortung dafür.   Du arbeitest gerne strukturiert und verlässlich, hast Freude am direkten Draht zu Menschen und willst einen Bereich wirklich zu deinem machen? Dann lass uns sprechen.  Aufgaben     Support in deiner Verantwortung:  Du beantwortest die Supportanfragen unserer Kunden – per E-Mail, Telefon und Videocall. Schnell, freundlich, verbindlich. Du priorisierst selbst, behältst den Überblick und bleibst dran, bis jedes Anliegen gelöst ist. Deine Stärke: verstehen, was passiert ist, und es dem Kunden verständlich erklären.    Technisches Onboarding & Integrationen:  Du richtest neue Kanzleien ein und bringst sie live – inklusive der Anbindung an ihre Kanzleisoftware. Die ersten Einrichtungen pro System machst du hands-on, dokumentierst dabei ein Playbook – und ab dann läuft es nach Checkliste, immer schneller und reibungsloser.    Support-System ausbauen:  Du erkennst Muster in den Anfragen, baust unser Hilfe-Center aus und entwickelst mit uns KI-gestützte Antworten und Automatisierungen. Dein Erfolgsmaßstab: Der Aufwand pro Kunde sinkt, während die Kundenzahl wächst.    Wissen weitergeben:  Deine Erkenntnisse aus dem Kundenkontakt fließen direkt in unsere Academy, unser Agentensystem und die Produktentwicklung – du arbeitest eng mit unseren Legal Engineers zusammen und siehst deine Vorschläge im nächsten Release wieder.    Qualifikation  Wichtiger als dein bisheriger Werdegang ist uns, wie du arbeitest: strukturiert, verlässlich, mit echter Freude am Kundenkontakt.      Abg

Als Support Manager geef jij leiding aan een team van ongeveer 10 supportmedewerkers en werk je samen met de andere support managers aan de vraag die iedereen nu bezighoudt: hoe zetten we AI zo waardevol mogelijk in om onze processen en dienstverlening naar een hoger niveau te tillen? En minstens zo belangrijk: hoe coach je je team door die verandering heen?      Wat ga je doen als Support Manager?      Samen met de Regional Support Manager NL/BE en de andere support managers werk je aan het doorontwikkelen van de afdeling en onze dienstverlening naar klanten. Jij focust op de supportmedewerkers in Nederland en België, en werkt daarnaast met support managers uit andere landen aan het uniformeren van processen en dienstverlening in alle 7 landen waar TOPdesk supportteams heeft.     Je geeft leiding via individuele coaching en teamoverleg. Je monitort de SLA's en andere KPI's, analyseert trends en identificeert waar nodig verbeterpunten. Loopt de dienstverlening bij een klant niet zoals verwacht? Dan ga jij samen met de accountmanager het gesprek aan. En je geeft mede vorm aan de brede doorontwikkeling van de afdeling: van cultuur en sfeer tot het klaarstomen van je team voor een wereld met AI, en het opzetten van een partnerstrategie waarin support als tweede of derde lijn voor onze partners fungeert.      Waar kom je terecht?      Je werkt vanuit ons kantoor in Delft, met af en toe een bezoek aan Antwerpen. Je maakt onderdeel uit van het Customer domein en rapporteert aan de Regional Support Manager NL/BE. Samen met 2 andere support managers stuur je in totaal 25 ervaren supportmedewerkers aan, in Nederland en een aantal in België.     Inhoudelijk is het team heel sterk en de klant staat er al volop centraal, daar hoef je dus niets aan te veranderen. Bij onze support afdeling werkt een ervaren en inhoudelijk heel sterk team. In alles wat wij doen, staat de klant centraal. Maar tegelijkertijd staat onze afdeling voor een grote uitdaging. Want wat betekent AI voor de baan van onze support medewerkers? Wij geloven dat de banen niet weg gaan, maar inhoudeiljk zullen veranderen. Als manager help jij mee in het vormgeven van deze verandering. Dit doe je samen met support managers in Nederland, en andere landen. Daarnaast werk je samen met 3 support managers uit andere landen aan een gezamenlijke aanpak.           Functi

title: Service Delivery Manager Infra Lokale Overheid
description: Voor PQR in Utrecht en klantlocaties in heel Nederland zoeken wij een Service Delivery Manager Infra - 32–40 uur | Utrecht | hybride       Functie   Als Service Delivery Manager bij PQR ben jij de verbindende schakel tussen onze klanten binnen de lokale overheid en de technische organisatie van PQR. Jij zorgt ervoor dat onze Managed Services niet alleen voldoen aan de gemaakte afspraken, maar daadwerkelijk bijdragen aan een stabiele, veilige en toekomstbestendige IT-omgeving.     Je werkt met gemeenten die midden in hun digitale transformatie zitten. Cloud, security, moderne werkplekken, continuïteit en steeds strengere wet- en regelgeving maken hun IT-landschap complex. Jij brengt daarin overzicht, regie en vooral: rust.       De regisseur van onze dienstverlening    Als Service Delivery Manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit en continuïteit van onze dienstverlening bij meerdere klanten binnen de lokale overheid.     Je kent je klanten, begrijpt wat er binnen hun organisatie speelt en weet dit te vertalen naar de dienstverlening van PQR. Daarbij kijk je verder dan SLA's, incidenten en rapportages. Je bespreekt ontwikkelingen, signaleert risico's en verbeterkansen en zorgt ervoor dat onze dienstverlening blijft aansluiten bij de doelen van de klant.     Je schakelt dagelijks tussen klant, engineers, consultants, servicedesk, Managed Services, projectteams en andere specialisten binnen PQR.  Je hoeft daarbij niet zelf de techniek in te duiken, maar je begrijpt IT goed genoeg om de juiste vragen te stellen, prioriteiten te bepalen en technische onderwerpen naar de klant te vertalen.       Werken voor de lokale overheid    Gemeenten worden steeds afhankelijker van IT. Digitale dienstverlening moet beschikbaar zijn, medewerkers moeten veilig en flexibel kunnen werken en tegelijkertijd moeten gemeenten voldoen aan hoge eisen rondom informatiebeveiliging, privacy en continuïteit.  PQR ondersteunt gemeenten onder andere met moderne werkplekken, cloud- en datacenteroplossingen, networking, security en Managed Services.     Als Service Delivery Manager begrijp je deze omgeving. Je weet dat dienstverlening binnen een gemeente andere belangen en dynamiek kent dan binnen een puur commerciële organisatie. Stakeholdermanagement, bestuurlijke gevoeligheid, security, voorspelbaarheid en het nakomen van afspraken zijn hier essentieel.      Wat ga je doen?    Je bent het primaire aanspreekpunt voor een aantal klanten binnen de lokale overheid.  Je bewaakt de kwaliteit, continuïteit en performance van de afgesproken IT-dienstverlening.  Je stuurt op SLA's, KPI's, klanttevredenheid en gemaakte afspraken.  Je organiseert en leidt periodieke service- en voortgangsoverleggen.  Je analyseert rapportages, incidenten, changes en structurele verbeterpunten.  Je vertaalt ontwikkelingen en behoeften bij klanten naar acties binnen PQR.  Je coördineert escalaties en zorgt dat de juiste mensen binnen PQR worden aangehaakt.  Je werkt nauw samen met technische team

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. title: Client Lead
description: Har du solid erfaring fra consulting og et genuint ønske om å bygge sterke, langsiktige kunderelasjoner?    Axaz er et AI-first-selskap som ligger i front når det gjelder å realisere store forretningsmessige gevinster fra moderne teknologi. Vi løser komplekse behov med denne tilnærmingen, og skaper konkret verdi for ledende selskaper. For å ta en tydelig posisjon i markedet, har vi samtidig et sterkt fokus på å bygge en solid kultur, et godt samhold og gode muligheter for både faglig og personlig utvikling.  Siden starten i 2021 har vi vokst til over 70 ansatte, og på kundelisten vår står kjente selskaper som Arctic Securities, Bohus, Compass Group, Dolphin Drilling, Ecura, Nille, Norli, Orkla og Techstep.    Vi søker nå en erfaren person som vil ta eierskap til et utvalg kunderelasjoner     Client Lead – Helhetlig eierskap til våre største kunder   Som Client Lead jobber du tett på både de som jobber med leveranser og de som jobber med salg. Din hovedoppgave er å sørge for at store og viktige kunder får reell verdi av løsningene og tjenestene våre, samtidig som du skaper vekst for Axaz. Du får det fulle eierskapet til disse kunderelasjonene og har ansvaret for at vi lykkes på tvers av alle tjenestene vi leverer.  Du inngår i en tydelig rolle- og ansvarsfordeling rundt kunden: Du eier den strategiske relasjonen og har det overordnede ansvaret for kunden, mens det er andre roller som har ansvaret for tjenesteleveransene og den tekniske retningen. Dette er ikke en tradisjonell salgsrolle – her er du en rådgiver og en entreprenør som identifiserer muligheter ut fra kundens reelle behov og bygger verdi for kunden over tid.   Hverdagen din vil typisk fordele seg på disse områdene:     Kunderelasjoner: Bygge langsiktige og tillitsbaserte relasjoner med sentrale personer hos kundene våre og være en “go to” person når det er viktige saker som skjer  Strategisk rådgivning: Være en proaktiv sparringspartner for kundens ledelse, og dele innsikt, råd og kompetanse som gjør at kunden utvikler seg i riktig retning  Leveransestyring: Ha overordnet ansvar for flere pågående leveranser, og sikre at våre tjenester treffer kundenes faktiske behov og forventning om verdiskaping  Kvalitet og trygghet: Være en trygghet for både kunde og våre leveranseteam – gå handson inn i leveransene når kritiske situasjoner krever det, og på se at vi bruker og videreutvikler våre standarder og beste praksiser  Strategisk salg: Identifisere muligheter for mersalg gjennom strategiske dialoger og roadmapsesjoner, og lede større salgsprosesser  Eskalering og problemløsning: Fungere som hovedkontaktpunkt for kunden og håndtere utfordringer som oppstår, samtidig som du skjermer leveranseteamene fra støy     Hvem er du?   Vi ser etter en erfaren, profesjonell og trygg rådgiver som forstår kundenes forretningsbehov. Du trives i skjæringspunktet mellom salg, leveranse og strategisk rådgivning, og du evner å bygge tillit hos beslutningstakere på C-nivå.   Ønskede kvalifikasjoner:     Ca.

title: Kundservicechef
description: Vill du leda och utveckla kundservice i toppklass? Du finns tillgänglig som stöd i deras dagliga arbete och de utmaningar som de ställs inför, och du är en närvarande ledare med fokus på coaching, utveckling och kvalitet i varje kundmöte. Rollen kräver också att du skaffar dig god insikt i de digitala kommunikationsverktyg som används inom gruppen.  Som kundservicechef ingår du i Kundcenters ledningsgrupp där du tillsammans med dina chefskollegor ansvarar för att vidareutveckla arbetssätt och processer för en skalbar och bättre kundupplevelse. Målet för LF Finans är att kunna leverera snabb, professionell och lösningsorienterad service till alla kunder vi möter i första linjen.  Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer vara bland annat:    Coacha, leda och utveckla kundserviceteamet om cirka 20 medarbetare.  Styra, optimera och utveckla gruppens kommunikationsverktyg med stort fokus på Telia Ace, säkra meddelanden och e-post.  Vara delaktig i kundcenters ledningsgrupp där du tillsammans med kollegor utvecklar kundcenter.  Vidareutveckla arbetssätt och processer för en skalbar, modern och kundorienterad upplevelse.  Följa upp, analysera och utveckla gruppens nyckeltal (mål och KPI:er) för höjd kvalitet, tillgänglighet och effektivitet.    Följande kommer göra dig framgångsrik i denna tjänst:    Erfarenhet av personalansvar, gärna inom kundservice eller liknande verksamhet.  Du är en trygg och inspirerande ledare med god kommunikativ förmåga.  Stark kundfokus och ett affärsmässigt tänk.  Erfarenhet av att arbeta med KPI:er och förändringsarbete.  Intresse för AI och dess möjligheter inom kundservice.  Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.    Som person är du en trygg och närvarande ledare som motiveras av att se dina medarbetare växa. Du är en lagspelare och tar med dig en positiv inställning till utmaningar, vilket tillsammans med din förmåga att engagera ditt team och din omgivning skapar en trivsam och utvecklande arbetsmiljö. Du har ett starkt affärsfokus och trivs med att arbeta datadrivet för att nå uppsatta mål.  Du är strukturerad, analytisk och lösningsorienterad, van att arbeta med nyckeltal och förändringsarbete, och ser potentialen i hur nya arbetssätt, teknik och AI kan bidra till en ännu bättre kundserviceupplevelse.  Vi erbjuder:    En nyckelroll i ett växande och affärsorienterat finansbolag.  Möjlighet att påverka och utveckla kundservicefunktionen och kundcenter.  En dynamisk arbetsmiljö med engagerade kollegor. title: Delivery Lead
description: Frenda är ett svenskt produktbolag i stark tillväxt, och nu tar vi nästa steg i vår expansionsresa. Rollen befinner sig i skärningspunkten mellan kund, verksamhet, produkt och teknik och kräver en person som kan skapa struktur, bygga relationer och få flera olika intressenter att arbeta mot gemensamma mål.     Du kommer initialt att arbeta nära och avlasta våra befintliga Leveransledare, för att successivt lära känna Frendas kunder, produkter, arbetssätt och leveransmodell och stegvis ta ett större eget ansvar. Parallellt blir du involverad i ett av våra pågående kundprojekt redan under projektfasen, för att bygga kunskap och relationer inför den kommande övergången till förvaltning.      I rollen kommer du att:    Successivt ta ansvar för och avlasta inom befintliga kundleveranser  Säkerställa sömlösa övergångar från projekt till leverans och förvaltning  Säkerställa en högkvalitativ kundrelation genom löpande kontakt och aktivt relationsarbete  Leda och koordinera interna kundteam  Etablera och utveckla en nära och professionell kunddialog  Prioritera och följa upp aktiviteter, åtaganden och leveranser  Arbeta proaktivt med kundnöjdhet, leveranskvalitet och vidareutveckling       Vi tror att du:    Har några års bredare arbetslivserfarenhet och känner dig trygg i att hantera kunder, kollegor och olika typer av intressenter  Har erfarenhet från exempelvis IT-förvaltning, service delivery, customer success eller projektledning med efterföljande förvaltningsansvar  Är social och relationsskapande, och har lätt för att skapa förtroende  Är strukturerad och kan hålla ordning, prioritera och följa upp när många frågor pågår parallellt  Är diplomatisk och lyhörd, och kan hantera olika perspektiv utan att tappa riktning eller tydlighet  Är bekväm i en IT-miljö, utan att nödvändigtvis vara den mest tekniska personen i rummet       Varför Frenda?    Bolag på tillväxtresa med trygg, långsiktig ägare  Konkurrenskraftiga förmåner, pensionslösningar och försäkringar  Hybrid arbetsmodell med kontor vid Hötorget       Vill du arbeta med något som faktiskt spelar roll? description: We're looking for a  Senior Delivery Manager – Software Services  to join our team in Copenhagen in a hybrid working mode. In this role, you will lead complex transformation programs for key clients in the manufacturing and industrial sector. You will drive multiple workstreams, coordinate global and local delivery teams and ensure on-time, on-budget program execution. This role offers an opportunity to influence business outcomes, build long-term strategic partnerships and collaborate with leading experts in design, development and emerging technologies while shaping critical client initiatives.
