title: Engineering Manager, Managed Services
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Engineering Manager, Managed Services based in Finland.   This is an opportunity for a technically strong Engineering Manager to lead a distributed team responsible for operating and continuously improving modern cloud infrastructure. You will oversee managed services for customer environments built on technologies such as Kubernetes and OpenStack, balancing operational excellence with engineering quality. The role combines people leadership, technical decision-making, service delivery, and customer collaboration. You will help establish effective engineering and operations processes while ensuring teams remain focused on priorities, milestones, and service commitments. The environment is highly remote and international, with collaboration across engineering, product, operations, and customer teams worldwide. It is an ideal role for someone passionate about Linux, cloud technologies, open source, and building high-performing distributed engineering teams.  Accountabilities    Lead and develop a growing engineering team, improving both development velocity and operational quality.  Manage the day-to-day delivery of managed services across customer environments, ensuring reliable and consistent service.  Establish disciplined engineering and operations processes that support scalability, maintainability, and continuous improvement.  Monitor team health indicators and take action to improve team effectiveness, collaboration, and performance.  Maintain clear focus on priorities, milestones, deliverables, and customer commitments.  Represent the managed services team with customers, internal stakeholders, product engineering teams, and external partners.  Ensure service-level agreements are consistently met across customer deployments around the world.  Drive ongoing improvements to products, processes, and operational practices based on customer and engineering feedback.  Collaborate closely with engineering, product, and operations teams to resolve complex issues and deliver reliable distributed systems.     Requirements     Bachelor’s degree or equivalent education in a technology-related field, or comparable professional experience.  Proven professional experience in software engineering using technologies such as Python, Go, C, C++, Java, or similar, and/or experience managing technical operations teams.  Demonstrated professional experience with OpenStack.  Strong understanding of testing methodologies, maintainable code, and software quality practices.  Experience with Linux system administration; Ubuntu or Debian experience is a plus.  Solid understanding of cloud architectures, topologies, and technologies.  Technical aptitude for understanding and managing complex distributed systems.  Experience working with agile software development methodologies. title: Service Delivery Manager m/f/d
description: Job description:      Worldwide and 24/7, air traffic controllers rely on our software and services to keep airport operations safe, stable, and efficient. As a Service Delivery Manager, you ensure the agreed service outcomes for our Air Traffic Control (ATC) solutions — from operational governance and service reporting to incident coordination, change control, and continual improvement. You act as the central interface between customers, internal delivery teams, and third-party partners, translating operational needs into measurable service levels and driving improvements that increase availability, performance, and customer satisfaction in a mission- and safety-critical environment.   Be part of this challenge and join our team in our office in Graz to work on the following tasks:       Roles and Responsibilities:     Own end-to-end service delivery for safety-critical software/services, ensuring customer satisfaction and compliance with contractual and regulatory requirements (including change, bugfix & maintenance deliveries)   Define and manage SLAs/OLAs/UCs, including service scope, KPIs, measurement methods, and reporting cadence   Lead operational governance with customers and internal teams: service reviews, performance reporting, action tracking, and escalation management   Coordinate Incident & Major Incident Management to restore service quickly, ensure clear communications, and drive post-incident reviews with actionable follow-ups   Drive Problem Management to identify root causes, reduce recurring incidents, and improve service stability   Oversee Change Enablement: risk/impact assessment, authorization, communication, and implementation with minimal disruption (including delivery planning and coordination)   Manage service financials: budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and transparency on consumption/cost drivers   Ensure service quality and continual improvement by maintaining CSI backlogs, prioritizing improvements, and tracking realized benefits   Manage supplier and vendor performance against underpinning contracts and coordinate third parties for integrated service delivery   Maintain service documentation: service descriptions, runbooks, escalation paths, operational procedures, and compliance evidence   Support pre-sales and transitions: contribute to service design, quotations, change requests, and smooth onboarding into operations        Skills Required:     Degree in IT, Engineering, Business, or comparable practical experience   5+ years in IT Service Management / Service Delivery, ideally in mission- or safety-critical environments (e.g., aviation, transport, healthcare, industrial)   Strong working knowledge of ITIL practices (esp. Service Level, Incident/Major Incident, Problem, Change Enablement, Continual Improvement)   ITIL 4 certification (Foundation minimum; Managing Professional / Strategist desirable)   Proven experience with service governance, stakeholder management, and executive-leve

title: Service Delivery Manager (m/w/d)
description: Wer in einem modernen und zukunftssicheren IT-Unternehmen die eigenen Fähigkeiten einbringen möchte, ist bei NTS genau richtig. Wer außerdem gerne Verantwortung übernimmt und Teamgeist mitbringt, passt genau in die Welt von NTS! Excel, Microsoft Power BI) hilft dir, die Zusammenhänge von kleinsten Abweichungen und großen Auswirkungen im IT-Service nachzuvollziehen  Im Bereich der IT-Infrastruktur weißt du gute Grundkenntnisse vor  Du hast bereits reichlich Erfahrung in der Erstellung und Durchführung von Präsentationen gesammelt    Unser Angebot    Die Mitarbeit in einem motivierten und hochqualifizierten Team  Ein positives und offenes Arbeitsklima  Wertschätzende Führungskräfte und Kolleg:innen  Ausgezeichnete interne wie externe Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten  Legendäre Firmen- und Abteilungsevents  RELAX - Gesundheitsförderung mit vielfältigen Angeboten von Shiatsu bis hin zu Coaching  Modernstes IT-Equipment und zahlreiche Benefits  Für die ausgeschriebene Position wird ein Bruttojahresgehalt ab EUR 55.000,- geboten. title: Managed Service Consultant（Delivery)【MS-MSD】
description: 募集要項 Job Description       Managed Service Consultant（Delivery)【MS-MSD】     職務内容 Roles and Responsibilities 【部門紹介】  Managed Service Consulting部門は、PwCコンサルティングが提供する新たなサービスのひとつとして、2024年7月に新しく設立されました。  地政学等の不確実な社会情勢の変化に対応するため、企業にはアジリティのある経営基盤の構築が求められています。PwCのManaged Service Consulting部門では、PwCコンサルティングが抱えるIndustry Solution部門、PwCグループの専門家を組みあわせ、経営基盤構築に必要なケイパビリティを戦略から実行まで包括的に補完するソリューションを提供し、クライアントの価値創造や高度化シフトの実現を強力に支援します。Managed Service Consulting部門は、ビジネスや組織をこれから大きくしていく段階です。戦力となってくれるメンバーを募集しています。  【担当業界】  業界を問いません。 製造、情報通信、メディア、流通・小売、公共、医薬、金融といった幅広い業界に対してサービスを提供します。  【業務内容】  Managed Service Consulting部門は、Managed Services Sales(MSS)とManaged Services Delivery (MSD)の2つのチームで構成され、合わせて4つのポジションでメンバーを募集しています。記載のリンク先より各ポジションの募集要項をご確認頂き、各募集要項よりご応募ください。  ※こちらはDeliveryのJDとなります  ＜Managed Services Delivery(MSD)＞  契約締結した案件の業務移行準備～業務移行～業務執行および管理を担当  ■Process Delivery Manager  ■Process Transition Consultant    登録資格 Qualification   【必須要件】  大卒以上  ネイティブレベルの日本語力  【スキル・経験】  ＜想定ポジション：マネージャー以上＞  ■望ましいスキル・経験・人物像  ・企業変革に関するコンサルティング提案・営業経験、またそれらの必要な説明資料・提案資料の作成経験  ・プロジェクトにおけるリードやマネジメントの経験  ・プロジェクトマネジメントに関する経験(スケジュール、タスク、ファイナンス、契約、メンバーの管理等)  ・コンサルティングファームでのマネージャー以上の職務経験もしくは事業会社での管理職以上の職務経験  ■歓迎するスキル・経験・人物像  ・関連する組織・人を巻き込んで物事を推進する経験  ・Managed Serviceに関わる経験  ・ビジネスレベルの英語力  ＜想定ポジション：スタッフ＞  ■望ましいスキル・経験・人物像  ・課題解決やソリューション提案の業務経験  ・クライアントを含めメンバーと連携してチームとして柔軟に協業できるコミュニケーション能力  ・クライアントの課題解決にやりがいと責任感を持って取り組める方  ・好奇心を持って、新しいものに取り組み、より良いやり方を追及できる方  ■歓迎するスキル・経験・人物像  ・プロジェクトマネジメントに関する経験(スケジュール、タスク、ファイナンス、契約、メンバーの管理等)  ・ビジネスレベルの英語力    勤務地 Work Location   東京

title: 【虎ノ門】ITサービスマネージャー（Globalコネクテッド・デジタルサービス領域）
description: 【企業名】 株式会社 本田技術研究所  【職種名】 【虎ノ門】ITサービスマネージャー（グローバルコネクテッド・デジタルサービス領域）  【仕事内容(概要)】 【虎ノ門】ITサービスマネージャー（グローバルコネクテッド・デジタルサービス領域）  【具体的な仕事内容】 ■業務概要 HondaのコネクテッドサービスおよびデジタルサービスにおけるITサービスマネージャーとして、サービスの安定提供および継続的な改善をリードしていただきます。  ■具体的な想定業務 ・コネクテッドサービスの運用設計およびITサービスマネジメント（ITSM）の推進 ・インシデント管理、問題管理、変更管理のプロセス設計および運用改善 ・サービスレベル（SLA／SLO）の定義・管理および品質向上施策の推進 ・サービス運用における課題の可視化および継続的改善（CI：Continual Improvement）の実行 ・グローバル展開における運用体制の構築および標準化・最適化  ■期待する役割 単なる運用対応にとどまらず、インシデント管理や問題管理、変更管理などのITサービスマネジメントを通じて、サービス品質・顧客満足度の向上を実現し、事業価値の最大化に貢献していただきます。 また、開発・SRE・QAなどの各チームと連携しながら、サービス提供の全体最適を担う中核的な役割を期待しています。  ■本ポジションの魅力 ・数百万台規模のコネクテッドサービスを支える、グローバルかつ大規模なサービス運営に携わることができます。 ・単なる運用ではなく、サービス品質や顧客体験を向上させるための改善活動を主体的に推進できます。 ・DevOpsや自動化、最新技術を活用した運用高度化など、新しい取り組みにも関わることができます。  ■キャリアパス ITサービスマネージャーとして、コネクテッドサービスの運用設計・サービスマネジメント・継続的改善の経験を積んでいただきます。 title: Customer Service Manager
description: A hands-on Customer Service role for you who enjoy daily operations, teamwork and continuous improvement.      At Kiilto, Customer Service plays an important role in creating a smooth and reliable customer experience. We are now looking for an experienced Customer Service or Supply Chain professional who enjoys working close to the daily business, leading the Scandinavian Customer Service team and helping improve common ways of working across the region.      Role overview   In this role, you will lead Customer Service operations for the Scandinavian region, covering Kiilto’s markets in Denmark, Norway and Sweden. You will work closely with a small, experienced team and support high-quality service throughout the order-to-cash process.     The position combines coordination, daily operational work and continuous improvement. You will help set priorities, follow up on KPIs and support the team in meeting agreed service levels. You will also be involved in improving processes, systems and ways of working.     You will be part of an international Logistics and Warehousing team and collaborate with colleagues in Logistics, Supply Chain, Finance and the Business Areas. The role is focused on the Scandinavian region, while also contributing to selected regional and global improvement initiatives where relevant.      Your key responsibilities    Support and develop the Scandinavian Customer Service team in daily operations.  Ensure effective day-to-day Customer Service operations, including sales order management, claims handling and customer requests.  Set priorities, follow up on KPIs and support agreed service levels.  Improve and harmonize Customer Service processes and ways of working across the Scandinavian markets.  Support organizational and cultural change initiatives to enable effective cross-border collaboration.  Analyze Customer Service performance and implement corrective actions and improvements where needed.  Collaborate closely with Logistics, Warehousing, other parts of the supply chain function, Finance and Business Area teams to strengthen the overall order-to-cash process.  Contribute to regional and selected global improvement projects.       What we expect    Relevant academic degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field, higher vocational education (KY/YH), or equivalent experience  Several years of experience in Customer Service operations, Supply Chain or a similar area.  Experience from working in an international team and supporting or leading people in a cross-cultural environment.  Experience of leading change and developing processes, systems and ways of working.  Strong analytical skills and experience using KPIs and data to drive performance and improvement.  Good understanding of ERP systems, Office tools and BI solutions.  Strong communication and collaboration skills in an international, cross-functional environment.  Fluency in English and Swedish.       Why Kiilto?

Aziende che sanno coniugare efficienza operativa, eccellenza nel servizio e capacità di guidare complessi processi di trasformazione aziendale. Il contesto aziendale è dinamico, strutturato e fortemente orientato all'innovazione dei processi e al miglioramento continuo. Lavorerai a stretto contatto con la direzione per riprogettare le logiche operative del dipartimento. Le tue principali responsabilità includeranno:   Coordinare, motivare e guidare il team di Customer Service nello svolgimento quotidiano delle attività e nelle fasi di cambiamento.  Gestire progetti complessi di riorganizzazione, digitalizzazione e trasformazione dei processi di Customer Operations e Assistenza Clienti.  Ottimizzare i flussi di comunicazione e operativi tra il Customer Service, la Supply Chain e la macro area Operations.  Definire, monitorare e analizzare i KPI di servizio per garantire standard elevati di qualità, tempestività e customer satisfaction.  Promuovere l'implementazione di nuovi strumenti gestionali e best practice di customer care.       HARD & SOFT SKILLS    Consolidata esperienza (5-8 anni) in ruoli analoghi di Project Management o Coordinamento in ambito Customer Service, preferibilmente in contesti industriali o B2B complessi.  Comprovata capacità nella gestione di progetti di trasformazione organizzativa e di digitalizzazione dei processi.  Forte leadership, empatia e spiccata attitudine alla gestione e allo sviluppo delle risorse.  Eccellente padronanza nell'uso e monitoraggio dei principali KPI di Customer Service.  Spiccate doti di problem solving, visione strategica e capacità di mediazione tra i vari stakeholder interni ed esterni.       SALARY PACKAGE     Ral Annua:  65.000 € - 70.000 € (in base all'effettiva esperienza del candidato).   Livello e contratto:  CCNL Metalmeccanico.   Benefit:  MBO, Premio feriale, Piano Welfare aziendale, Laptop, Mobile phone, 1 giorno alla settimana di smart working.       COSA OFFRIAMO    Inserimento in un'azienda solida, strutturata e di riferimento nel proprio settore.  Un ruolo ad alta visibilità strategica, con autonomia decisionale

title: Onboarding Specialist
location: Kongens Lyngby, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
description: 💼  Who we are   Do you have good business sense, enjoy working with people and like taking ownership? Would you thrive in a dynamic, multicultural environment where things move quickly and no two customer projects are quite the same? Then the Boarding Specialist role at Market Pay Online could be your next adventure.  Our core product is a technical payment platform. We handle the technical integrations that connect our customers to online payments and banking services: Card payments, iDEAL, PayPal and more.  🌟  The Role    Context   As our business continues to grow, we are looking for a Boarding Specialist to join our onboarding team, working from our office on Gothersgade in Copenhagen  🎯  Your Key Responsibilities   As a Boarding Specialist, you will own the customer journey from the moment Sales hands over a new customer and continue supporting them beyond go-live — ensuring their setup runs smoothly, evolves with their needs, and that they feel confident throughout their time with Market Pay Online.  Reporting to the Onboarding Leads, you'll be the coordinator and driving force throughout the process, working closely with the customer, our acquiring partners and colleagues across Market Pay Online.   That Means     Setting up and managing acquiring applications, while also handling ongoing merchant maintenance and keeping oversight of periodic KYC reviews to ensure compliance throughout the customer’s lifecycle.  Guiding customers through requirements and helping them reach a solid setup and continuing to support them throughout their time with Market Pay Online, building strong, trusting relationships.  Explaining complex processes, technical requirements and compliance needs clearly and simply, and translating “payments” into language customers can actually understand.  Coordinating closely with internal teams and managing external stakeholders and partners, keeping everyone aligned and making sure nothing falls between two chairs.  Keeping the whole process moving; managing deadlines, priorities and dependencies, even when systems misbehave, partners introduce new requirements, or customers need extra reassurance.  Being the calm, trusted point of contact who makes both onboarding and ongoing merchant life feel easy.    Success in the role means that customers know exactly where they stand, colleagues know what they need to do, and new merchants get through the boarding process efficiently and without unnecessary friction.  🔍  Who we’re looking for   This is a customer-facing role, so you genuinely enjoy working with people. You are approachable, service-minded and good at building trust, while also being comfortable taking the lead and pushing things forward when needed.  You are thorough and detail-oriented. You thrive in creating your own structure in day-to-day processes. Our onboarding flows evolve constantly, and you are comfortable working in an environment where priorities shift, requirements change and not everything

title: Chef.fe de Projet Senior
description: Rattachement hiérarchique   Directement rattaché au CEO.  Travaille en étroite collaboration avec les équipes  Sales ,  Produit ,  Tech  et  R&D .   Mission principale   Garantir la réussite client et la bonne exécution des projets de Craft.AI, depuis le hand-over commercial jusqu’à la phase d’exploitation et de renouvellement.  Le Chef.fe de Projet Senior est à la fois :    un  chef d’orchestre  opérationnel de l’exécution client    un  CSM stratégique  responsable du succès et du renouvellement des comptes,    un  manager  des équipes IA (3 DataScientist), projets (1 chef de projet) et support (Care & Success),    et un  ambassadeur  de la valeur Craft.ai auprès des clients.       Responsabilités clés    1. Pilotage de la relation client :     Assurer la continuité client après la signature (hand-over Sales → Delivery)    Être l’interlocuteur privilégié des clients stratégiques (C-level, sponsors techniques et métier).    Définir la stratégie de compte : objectifs, roadmap IA, alignement roadmap produit, adoption, upsell.    Piloter les  revues trimestrielles de performance (QBR)  et garantir la satisfaction client.       2. Gestion et exécution des projets     Participer avec l’équipe commerciale à la construction des propositions en Avant-Vente, dès la phase de diagnostic.    Superviser et/ou assurer en direct la  chefferie de projets IA  (cadrage, planning, ressources, risques, budget).    Piloter l’équipe IA (3 Data Scientists) pour garantir la qualité et le respect des engagements Craft.AI sur chaque déploiement (plateforme MLOps/LLMOps, CraftGPT, développement fonctionnels, intégrations…).    Travailler main dans la main avec les équipes Produit, Tech & R&D pour l’opérationnalisation rapide des cas d’usage IA.    Participer à l’amélioration continue de la vélocité et l’industrialisation des cas d’usages développés pour les clients.    Assurer la documentation, la traçabilité et le transfert de connaissance auprès des clients.       3. Customer Success Management     Définir et suivre les KPIs de  Success  (adoption, usage, valeur créée, renouvellement).    Garantir la qualité du delivery et la performance des cas d’usages, y compris en phase de montée en puissance.    Mettre en place des actions proactives pour améliorer l’usage et favoriser les renouvellements.    Identifier les opportunités d’ upsell / cross-sell  sur les produits    Gérer les plans de compte en coordination avec les Sales pour maximiser le  Net Retention Revenue (NRR).        4. Pilotage du Care / Support utilisateur     Superviser le support utilisateur (Care) et garantir une qualité de service irréprochable.    Structurer les processus d’escalade et le suivi des incidents en lien avec les équipes Tech.    Définir et suivre les indicateurs de performance : SLA, satisfaction, réactivité.    Mettre en place des ressources self-service (knowledge base, FAQ, tutoriels, onboarding  utilisateurs).       5. Management & leadership     Encadrer la chef

title: Installation Partner Manager
description: AutoStore™ holds a simple yet powerful vision: to store and move things for everyone, everywhere. Founded in Norway, we've grown into a global technology company. AutoStore uses advanced software to automate and orchestrate order fulfillment. Our goal is to ensure orders arrive faster than ever, with minimal environmental impact. That’s how we help brands exceed customer expectations.  We have more than 1600 systems in nearly 60 countries, and we grow continuously as a community of employees, partners, customers, suppliers, and connected technologies. Automation should make life easier, and by listening carefully to our community, we innovate to meet the industry’s most complex needs. With AutoStore™, brands gain speed, efficiency, and improved workplaces. And much more floor space.  AutoStore – moving things forward.   The Role:   AutoStore is seeking an Installation Partner Manager who will be responsible for developing, managing, and scaling AutoStore’s global Installation Partner ecosystem. In this newly created role, you’ll build systems and relationships to ensure close collaboration between AutoStore, partners, and service providers. You’ll ensure high quality installation is the norm, service providers are versed in the latest AutoStore technology, and Partners are kept abreast of every development.   Key Tasks and Responsibilities:    Partner Program Ownership     Serve as the global owner of the Installation Partner Framework.  Oversee operational, technical, and quality-governance structures for the partner network.  Ensure partners deliver, via their assigned installation teams, grid installations to AutoStore standards.      Operational Relationship Management     Review installation readiness, documentation compliance, product updates, and capacity planning.  Align on installation load forecasting, resource requirements, and support needs.  Coordinate cross-functional inputs from Sales, Operations, Academy, Service and support, and Product.      Certification & Technical Compliance     Ensure Installation partners are certified, via completion of required training.  Oversee supervised installations and validate installation certification standards.  Verify each installation team includes the defined number of certified installers.  Ensure compliance with all manuals, technical documentation, and quality guidelines.      Quality Assurance Oversight     Ensure each Installation partner performs the specified minimum installations per year.  Manage yearly audits of installations with each Installation Partner.  Track audit findings, orchestrate corrective actions, and ensure continuous quality improvement.  Facilitate mandatory post-installation feedback sessions involving all stakeholders, including partners, installation partners, and Autostore Sales Account team, Service and Support and Academy teams. title: Kasvujohtaja
description: Oscar Software Oy – Kasvujohtaja      Oscar Software hakee kasvujohtajaa johtamaan yhtiön myynnin kokonaisuutta ja rakentamaan seuraavaa kasvuvaihetta yhdessä toimitusjohtajan, johtoryhmän ja osaavan organisaation kanssa.     Tehtävä tarjoaa laajan vastuun suomalaisen ohjelmistoyhtiön kasvusta. Vahva asiakaspohja, oma tuotekehitys, toimialaosaaminen ja uuden sukupolven Oscar P1 -tuoteperhe luovat erinomaisen perustan kaupallisen toiminnan uudistamiselle ja skaalaamiselle.      Oscar Software lyhyesti      Oscar Software on vuonna 2005 perustettu suomalainen ohjelmisto- ja palveluyhtiö, joka tarjoaa ERP-toiminnanohjauksen, talouden, verkkokaupan ja digitaalisen liiketoiminnan ratkaisuja erityisesti valmistavan teollisuuden ja tukkukaupan yrityksille.     Yhtiöllä on yli 700 asiakasyritystä ja noin 120 ammattilaista, joista lähes 50 työskentelee tuotekehityksessä. Ohjelmistokehitys tapahtuu Suomessa. Vuonna 2025 liikevaihto oli noin 14,1 miljoonaa euroa, liikevoitto noin 887 000 euroa ja omavaraisuusaste noin 50 %. Oscarilla on toimipisteet Tampereella, Espoossa ja Raisiossa.     Oscar yhdistää ohjelmistotuotteen ja jatkuvat asiantuntijapalvelut pitkäaikaiseksi asiakaskumppanuudeksi.      Tehtäväsi kasvujohtajana      Kasvujohtajana vastaat Oscar Softwaren kaupallisen kasvun johtamisesta koko asiakkaan elinkaaren läpi. Johdat uusasiakashankintaa, nykyasiakkaiden kasvattamista ja asiakaspitoa sekä kehität myynnin johtamista, prosesseja, mittareita ja toimintamalleja.     Keskeisiä vastuitasi ovat:      Rakennat Oscarille ennustettavan, skaalautuvan ja kannattavan kasvukoneen.  Johdat ja kehität noin kahdeksan henkilön kaupallista organisaatiota, joka vastaa uusasiakashankinnasta, pre-sales-toiminnasta ja nykyasiakkuuksien kaupallisesta kehittämisestä.  Selkeytät myynnin toimintamallit, tavoitteet, vastuut, mittarit ja johtamisrytmin.  Vahvistat uusasiakashankintaa ja kasvatat myyntiputken määrää, laatua ja ennustettavuutta.  Kehität nykyasiakkaiden kasvattamista, asiakaspitoa ja asiakaskokemusta.  Rakennat uusien tuotteiden go-to-market-malleja, hinnoittelua, paketointia ja myynnin argumentaatiota yhdessä tuotehallinnan kanssa.  Osallistut kaupallisen strategian luomiseen ja Oscar P1 -tuoteperheen kaupallistamiseen.  Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä markkinoinnin, tuotehallinnan, tuotekehityksen, palveluorganisaation, talouden ja henkilöstön kanssa.  Osallistut itse keskeisten asiakkuuksien, kumppanuuksien ja kaupallisesti tärkeiden kokonaisuuksien kehittämiseen.      Odotamme kasvujohtajan olevan lähellä myyjien ja asiakkaiden arkea sekä muuttavan suunnitelmat konkreettiseksi tekemiseksi ja mitattaviksi tuloksiksi.     Kasvujohtaja kuuluu Oscar Softwaren johtoryhmään ja raportoi toimitusjohtaja Jakke Vyyryläiselle.      Ensimmäiset 1–6 kuukautta      Ensimmäisten kuukausien aikana muodostat kokonaiskuvan Oscarin strategiasta, asiakkaista, tuotteista, markkinasta ja kaupallisen toiminnan nykytilasta. Samalla tartut käytännön tekemiseen nopeasti.     En

description: Palvelujohtaja, Varsinais-Suomi      N-Clean Oy    Etsimme tuloshakuista ja kehitysmyönteistä Palvelujohtajaa. Saat vastuullesi Varsinais-Suomen palvelualueen sekä Turun alueen laivaliiketoiminnan johtamisen ja kehittämisen. Vastaat alueen operatiivisesta toiminnasta, asiakassuhteista, henkilöstön työkyvyn johtamisesta, resurssien hallinnasta sekä liikevaihdon ja kannattavuuden kasvattamisesta. Palvelujohtajana toimit osana yrityksen operatiivista johtoryhmää ja raportoit liiketoimintajohtajalle. Esimerkilläsi johdat oman alueesi johtoryhmää kohti strategiassamme asetettuja tavoitteita yhtiömme arvojen ja toimintamallien mukaisesti. Johtoryhmääsi kuuluu myös osaamiskeskustemme asiantuntijoita.  Sinulla on kokemusta keskisuuren tai suuren yrityksen liiketoiminnan, asiakaskokemuksen tai myynnin strategisesta johtamisesta. Tavoitteenamme on olla Suomen paras palveluyritys, joten omaat näkemystä ja kokemusta asiakaslähtöisten palvelukonseptien jatkuvasta parantamisesta.  N-Clean on siivouspalveluyritys, joka tukee asiakkaidensa jokapäiväistä toimintaa puhtaampien toimitilojen muodossa. N-Clean on osa ruotsalaisomisteista MIAB konsernia. Liikevaihtomme ylitti vuonna 2025 80M€ ja meitä N-Cleanilaisia työskentelee Suomessa jo lähes 3000.  N-Cleanin arvot: luottamus, arvostus ja sitoutuminen näkyvät päivittäisessä työssämme. Odotamme sinun kokevan arvomme omaksesi ja tuovan mukanasi positiivista fiilistä työyhteisöömme ja periksiantamatonta onnistuu-asennetta. Nautit työskentelystä kehittyvässä ja kasvavassa organisaatiossa, jossa pääset haastamaan itseäsi. Tukenasi on lämminhenkinen organisaatio ja helposti lähestyttävät kollegat.   Palvelujohtajan keskeisiä vastuita ovat:     Palvelualueen johtaminen. Vastaa oman Palvelualueensa tuloksesta ja johtaa aluetta yrityksen arvojen ja johtamisjärjestelmän mukaisesti tavalla, joka tukee yrityksen strategiaa ja liiketoimintatavoitteita.  Asiakassuhteiden hallinta ja kehittäminen. Vastaa oman alueensa asiakassuhteiden johtamisesta, kehittämisestä sekä asiakaskokemuksesta.   Henkilöstön johtaminen ja resurssien hallinta. Johtaa tiimiään N-Cleanin johtamisjärjestelmien ja johtamisfoorumien mukaisesti. Vastaa alueensa henkilöstön ja henkilöstön työkyvyn ja suorituksen johtamisesta.   Toiminnan kehittäminen ja uudistaminen. Seuraa ja analysoi tehokkuutta, tunnistaa parannuskohteita ja johtaa kehitystoimenpiteitä talousalueellaan.  Talous ja tuloksellisuus. Vastaa palvelualueensa kokonaisuuden tuloksesta sekä taloudellisen tuloksen suunnittelusta, ohjaamisesta, raportoinnista

title: Partner Success Director
description: WHO WE ARE:  Plug and Play Tech Center is the ultimate innovation platform, bringing together the best startups and the world's largest corporations to create the most meaningful connections that bring innovation to anyone, anywhere. We are on a mission to bring the benefits of Silicon Valley to all corners of the world. Each year, hundreds of entrepreneurs join our vertical-specific accelerator programs to team up with our corporate members or receive a direct investment from Plug and Play.  WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:  We’re a diverse team with backgrounds in technology and entrepreneurship and we’re growing rapidly to deliver on our mission. We’re actively seeking a Director of Partner Success to continuously deliver value to our partners.  The Director, Partner Success will help define the strategy, metrics, and operating processes for the role. You must be highly strategic, analytical, detail oriented, and able to effectively influence these skills within the organization and external partners.  HOW YOU WILL MAKE A DIFFERENCE:     Define our partner success strategy that is unique and differentiated in the marketplace   Identify opportunities to evolve the experience across the partner lifecycle   Prioritize the partner experience improvements that have the highest impact on partners   Drive cross-functional team support to ensure successful implementation   Oversee and manage a growing team of partner success reps globally   Develop your team through motivation, counseling and product knowledge education   Define metrics that measure our delivery of value to partners (e.g., product utilization, NPS, retention, renewal rate, etc...) and build out dashboards that communicate them to the team   Construct and automate dashboards for key performance metrics   Other duties as assigned   Drive business development efforts to secure new projects with Korean government agencies and corporate    partners.     Lead proposal and RFP development for government-funded and corporate open innovation programs. Experience with government-funded projects and corporate open innovation programs in Korea preferred  All CVs must be submitted in English

title: BCN Sales and Account Management Director
description: Job Purpose   The role holder is responsible for leading sales and account management activities within the Business-Critical segment, including developing sales strategies, managing key client relationships, driving revenue growth, and ensuring effective execution of sales plans. The role focuses on overseeing sales performance, managing pipelines, and ensuring alignment with business objectives and customer requirements in accordance with Specialized’s approved policies and procedures. Drive lead generation and engagement with prospective beneficiaries through networking, business development activities, and industry events in coordination with Marketing and Communications.   Lead consultative sales approaches to understand client needs and ensure delivery of tailored solutions.   Oversee the development of upselling and cross-selling approaches to expand existing accounts.   Monitor sales performance and ensure identification and capture of cross- and up-selling opportunities.   Lead negotiation of commercial terms, including discounts and bulk deals, in alignment with Finance and Product Development guidelines.   Manage complex negotiations to ensure mutually beneficial agreements in coordination with the Legal team.   Drive the positioning and showcasing of Business-Critical offerings and identify incremental business opportunities with enterprise customers. Oversee account management activities, ensuring effective contract management and timely renewals. Provide inputs on sales performance to Product Development & Management and support product/service enhancements aligned with customer demand. プラットフォームの機能や特長をお客様のビジネスの優先事項やロードマップに適用することで、Salesforce製品に関する実践的な知識を示す。 ・テクニカルインサイトの提供によるCustomer Enablementの推進: 製品アップデートや障害、サポート終了（EOL）等の技術情報を「顧客の価値」へと翻訳し、IT/業務部門がテクノロジーを最大限に活用できるよう伴走、支援する。 description: Guesty is the all-in-one platform helping hospitality businesses around the world automate, optimize, and scale their operations. We’re a fast-growing global startup that’s transforming how the industry works — from guest experience to business growth.  With a powerful suite of features and integrations with 150+ industry partners — including Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com, Expedia, Google Travel, and many more — Guesty empowers property managers to deliver top-tier guest experiences while running more efficient, data-driven operations. title: Franchise Support Manager
description: Position Responsibilities   As ZUS continues to expand internationally via Franchise model, we need to ensure that our partners have world-class support delivered to them, while optimizing required resources of the ZUS HQ teams. This is a newly established and highly visible role in the growing International Franchise department. The role’s objective is to enhance existing workflows, find efficiencies as well as grow the team’s capabilities to support a large and growing number for Franchisee partners. The role reports directly into the IF Director. The role will have 3 team members reporting into it.      Budget ownership of the Business Unit; correlated with Franchisees’ business plans;  Channel management of a franchisee as a customer: supporting the rest of the Department in establishing a smooth lifecycle for ZUS Franchisees, from onboarding to day-to-day operations;  Close coordination with Franchise Business Development and Franchise Operations teams to deliver on Department’s objectives and key results;  Own, manage, improve and create required tools, processes and frameworks for smooth Franchising operations;  Improve internal coordination with the rest of the HQ departments, ensuring close collaboration and constant exchange of information and best practices – act as a bridge between the Department and other central functions;  Enhance existing and create missing R.A.C.I. alignments with internal and external stakeholders;  Support in development of central functions cost allocation principles;  Develop long-term motivation program for ZUS Franchisees;  Establish the culture and frameworks for Continuous improvement of the IF Department;  Represent the department in regular internal engagements with senior stakeholders.       Qualification and Experience    Over 10 years of relevant working experience in F&B and/or Retail environment; with focus on internal processes, Operational Excellence, Channel management and Strategic projects.  Operational experience in the past, but since then worked on strategic initiatives and have an ability to view “the big picture”, without forgetting about operational details  Superior stakeholder management and “delivery through others” skills is a must  Self-starter mindset: you see where things can be improved and act on it without waiting for formal processes;  Change management skills, Team leadership skills  Six sigma or Continuous improvement certification is a big advantage  Experience of working in a big corporate environment, comfortable working in a matrix structure  Financial planning and financial literacy  Fluency in English is a must; additional languages is an advantage.       a Necessity, not a Luxury

title: Chef de Projet Déploiement Technique / Customer Success Manager
description: QUI SOMMES-NOUS ?    ASTRIIS est une société grenobloise spécialisée dans la maintenance prédictive des machines tournantes complexes. Issue de 30 ans de recherche publique, notre technologie brevetée est déployée dans les secteurs de l'éolien, de l'hydroélectricité et de l'industrie lourde.  Après une levée de fonds de 1,7 M€ en 2025 et la signature des premiers grands comptes dans le portefeuille, ASTRIIS entre dans sa phase d'accélération. La technologie est prouvée, le marché répond — il reste à le conquérir.  Rejoindre ASTRIIS aujourd'hui, c'est piloter des projets de déploiement technique à fort enjeu, au cœur d’une DeepTech qui a du sens.    En tant que Customer Success Manager, vous êtes le garant de la réussite de ces déploiements — du cadrage technique jusqu'au succès client mesuré — et le point de contact privilégié entre la R&D, le commercial et nos clients.  À un moment où chaque déploiement compte, votre empreinte sur l'entreprise sera immédiatement visible, au sein d'une équipe à taille humaine où chaque personne compte.      LE POSTE    Véritable pivot entre nos équipes internes (R&D et commercial) et nos clients, vous pilotez la gestion de projet de bout en bout — de la phase avant-vente jusqu'au suivi post-déploiement. Vous travaillez en binôme avec le responsable des Opérations et portez la réussite des déploiements : planning, jalons, commandes, gestion des risques.  Chaque jour est différent : cadrage technique avec un prospect, formation d'une équipe terrain, analyse des retours produit, animation d'un comité de suivi… Vous jonglerez entre le pilotage de projet, la gestion des relations et la résolution de problèmes technique.        Avant-vente & cadrage    Participer aux phases de qualification et de réponse aux offres en apportant votre expertise produit  Apporter un support technique aux équipes commerciales lors des démonstrations et soutenances. title: Implementation Manager - Italy
description: Build with us   Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.  Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable.  With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions.  We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of.  Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.   Your impact   As Implementation Manager, you'll own the post-sales integration phase for Mollie's largest and most complex deals, guiding merchants from handover through testing to go live. You'll run kickoffs with internal and external stakeholders, set go live dates, keep progress on track, and coordinate testing and feedback along the way. You'll work closely with colleagues across sales, product and engineering, as well as with merchants directly, keeping everyone aligned as deals move toward launch. description: Introduction  The Customer Engagement Manager assures customer success by driving adoption, value realisation and renewal across the full customer lifecycle. This role orchestrates both success and services activities to ensure our customers achieve their desired business outcomes from our products and services, from initial engagement through ongoing value and growth.  As a customer success centric engagement manager, you will balance customer success goals (adoption, value, health, advocacy) with project delivery excellence and commercial performance. You will be overseeing a portfolio of client engagements, ensuring revenue and profitability targets are achieved. This role will report to the Head of Professional Services for the EMEA. Own a portfolio of customer engagements as vehicles for adoption and value realisation, ensuring they are structured around measurable outcomes rather than only scope and tasks.   Lead cross functional project teams to design and implement solutions, success plans, and adoption programs that drive time to value and sustainable usage.   Drive the adopt phase by defining and managing customer success plans, enablement paths, proposing services offerings and solutions along with usage milestones; monitor customer health and intervene proactively to remove blockers to value.   Support the Renew phase by ensuring customers achieve agreed upon business outcomes, can clearly articulate the value received, and are prepared with data and success stories that justify renewal and potential growth.   Own or heavily influence key customer success KPIs for your portfolio (i.e. adoption metrics, health scores, time-to-value, NPS/CSAT, expansion and renewal rates) and use them to steer engagement strategy.   Identify opportunities for process improvements and revenue growth through repeatable, outcome-oriented service offerings, playbooks, and LAER aligned engagement patterns.   Ensure projects and engagements are delivered on time, within scope and budget, while also meeting agreed success metrics and value hypotheses.  C

title: Klar for neste steg i lederkarrieren? Bli vår nye Coffee Shop Manager i Espresso House Thon Senter Moa!
description: Klar for neste steg i lederkarrieren? Bli vår nye Coffee Shop Manager i Espresso House Thon Senter Moa!      Vil du lede, inspirere og skape gode opplevelser – både for gjester og ansatte? Nå søker vi en daglig leder til vår coffee shop på Thon Senter Moa i Ålesund! Stillingen er en fulltidsstilling med oppstart snarest.          Om rollen   Som Daglig leder i Espresso House er du hjertet i din coffee shop. Du skaper rammene for trivsel, kvalitet og gode gjesteopplevelser, og leder teamet ditt i tråd med Espresso House sine verdier. Du har det overordnede ansvaret for drift, arbeidsmiljø og økonomiske resultater, og sørger for at shopen drives på en måte som skaper både resultater og arbeidsglede.     Du er en synlig, engasjert leder som bygger lagånd og går foran som et godt eksempel. Sammen med teamet ditt står du i baren, møter gjestene med et smil og sørger for at kvalitet og service alltid er på topp. Rollen kombinerer ledelse, drift og kundeservice – perfekt for deg som liker å ta ansvar, motivere andre og skape et miljø der både mennesker og resultater får vokse.          Noen av dine arbeidsoppgaver vil være å:       Lede og utvikle teamet ditt, samt sikre et trygt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø  Følge opp salg, budsjett og økonomiske resultater  Sikre høy kvalitet i service, produkter og renhold slik at din shop lever opp til Espresso House sine driftsstandarder  Ha totalt personalansvar, inkludert rekruttering, onboarding, oppfølging og planlegging av vaktlister  Jobbe aktivt i driften og bidra til gode gjesteopplevelser        Som Coffee Shop Manager / Daglig leder rapporterer du til Operations Manager.        Hvem ser vi etter?      Vi ser etter deg som:      Er en menneskeorientert leder som motiverer, inspirerer og følger opp  Har erfaring fra ledelse eller drift i servicebransjen  Jobber strukturert, tar ansvar og håndterer utfordringer på en løsningsorientert måte  Trives i et høyt tempo og har stor arbeidskapasitet  Brenner for god service  Er sulten på resultater og har en god forståelse for tall og lønnsomhet  Kan jobbe fulltid i turnus tilpasset avdelingens åpningstider       Hva kan vi tilby deg?       En spennende lederstilling med stort ansvar (100% stilling)  En variert, sosial og meningsfull arbeidshverdag  Grundig opplæring og kontinuerlig lederutvikling  Muligheten til å «drive din egen coffee shop» – med et stort støtteapparat i ryggen  Verdifull erfaring innen ledelse, service, drift og økonomi  Fordeler som personalrabatt og personalmat-ordning  Lønn etter avtale      Espresso House skal være et sted alle føler seg sett og velkommen. Sammen jobber vi derfor for å skape verdens beste kaffeopplevelse til verdens beste gjest – og som Coffee Shop Manager er du en nøkkelperson i å gjøre dette mulig hver eneste dag.         Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Da vil vi gjerne høre fra deg!

description: 중고거래실을 소개해요   중고거래실은 한국에서 가장 많은 사람들이 쓰는 중고거래 서비스를 만들고 있어요. 매일 수많은 이웃이 물건을 사고팔고, 신뢰를 쌓고, 때로는 예상치 못한 문제를 경험해요. Product Operations Manager는 이 거대한 생활 플랫폼의 현장에서 발생하는 문제를 가장 먼저 발견하고, 그 문제를 단순 대응이 아니라  제품과 비즈니스 레벨의 해결 과제 로 끌어올리는 사람이에요.  사용자의 불편, 거래 리스크, 운영 비효율, 정책의 빈틈을 발견했을 때, 왜 이 문제가 반복되는지, 제품 구조를 어떻게 바꾸면 예방할 수 있는지, 정책과 운영 기준을 어떻게 재설계하면 더 나은 거래 경험과 비즈니스 기회로 이어질 수 있는지 고민하고 실행해요. 이 역할은 운영을 관리하는 일이 아니라,  운영에서 발견한 신호를 바탕으로 제품과 사업을 성장시키는 일 이에요. 제품팀과 원 팀으로 일하며 문제를 정의하고, 실험하고, 개선하고, AI와 자동화를 활용해 더 확장 가능한 해결 구조를 만들어가요.  우리는 앞으로의 운영이 사람이 반복 업무를 더 많이 처리하는 방식이 아니라,  AI와 데이터로 문제를 더 빨리 발견하고, 더 정교하게 판단하며, 더 높은 밀도로 서비스를 개선하는 방식 으로 진화해야 한다고 믿어요. 이 포지션은 그 변화를 중고거래실 안에서 직접 설계하고 실행하는 역할이에요.  자율적으로 문제를 발견하고, 근본 원인을 파고들고, 제품·정책·비즈니스·AI를 연결해 실제 변화를 만들어내는 데 에너지를 느끼는 분이라면 이 역할에서 큰 임팩트를 만들 수 있어요. 반복되는 운영 문제를 더 잘 처리하는 사람이 아니라,  그 문제가 더 이상 반복되지 않도록 제품과 비즈니스의 구조를 바꾸는 사람 을 찾고 있어요.   이런 일을 해요    중고거래 제품에서 발생하는 운영·정책·사용자 경험 문제를 스스로 발견하고 정의해요. 단순히 접수된 이슈에 대응하는 것이 아니라, 문제의 반복 구조와 근본 원인을 파악해 제품과 비즈니스 레벨의 해결 과제로 전환해요  ‘더 잘 처리하는 방법’이 아니라 ‘문제가 덜 발생하는 구조’를 고민해요. 프로세스 개선에 그치지 않고, 제품 플로우·정책 기준·운영 시스템·AI 자동화 구조를 함께 재설계해요  AI와 데이터를 활용해 확장 가능한 문제 해결 방식을 만들어요. 반복 업무를 자동화하는 것을 넘어, 문제 탐지·분류·판단·모니터링 체계를 설계하고, 운영 밀도와 의사결정 품질을 높여요  변화하는 시장과 플랫폼 환경에 맞춰 오래된 운영 기준을 다시 정의해요. 기존 정책이나 프로세스를 그대로 유지하는 것이 아니라, 지금의 사용자 행동과 사업 방향에 맞게 재해석하고 개선해요  신규 기능과 사업 변화에 맞는 운영 대응 체계를 준비해요. 제품 출시 전후의 리스크를 예측하고, 필요한 정책·가이드·프로세스·모니터링 구조를 설계해요  외부 파트너사와의 관계를 쌓고, 사용자 가치를 전달하는 문제를 함께 풀어가요  중고거래의 신뢰와 안전, 거래 활성화, 사용자 경험, 운영 효율을 함께 바라보며 우선순위를 판단해요. 운영 관점만이 아니라 제품 임팩트와 비즈니스 임팩트를 함께 고려해 핵심 이슈를 선제적으로 다뤄요    이런 분을 찾고 있어요    누가 시키지 않아도 문제를 발견하면 근본 원인을 파고들고, 문제를 스스로 정의하고, 해결까지 주도적으로 끌고 가는 분  운영을 ‘처리하는 일’이 아니라 ‘제품과 서비스를 성장시키는 일’로 바라보고, 제품 구조와 비즈니스 모델 개선의 기회로 해석하는 분  운영 매니저로서 5년 이상의 경험을 바탕으로, 프로덕트팀과 원 팀으로 서비스를 운영·관리하며 성장시켜보신 분  반복적이고 비효율적인 과정을 발견했을 때, AI·자동화·프로세스 개선을 통해 더 나은 구조를 만들고 확장 가능한 방식으로 해결하는 데 즐거움을 느끼고 실행력을 가지신 분  다양한 조직(CS·프로덕트·정책·PR·GR 등)과 원활히 협업하며 복잡한 문제를 정렬하고 실행까지 이끌 수 있는 분  정해진 답을 따르기보다, 더 나은 기준과 방식을 새롭게 만들어가는 데 동기부여를 느끼는 분    이 역할에서 얻을 수 있는 것    한국에서 가장 큰 중고거래 플랫폼의 핵심 문제를 직접 다룰 수 있어요. 수많은 사용자가 매일 경험하는 거래의 불편, 신뢰, 안전, 리스크 문제를 실제 제품과 운영 구조의 변화로 해결할 수 있어요  운영과 제품, 사업의 경계를 넘나드는 경험을 할 수 있어요. 현장의 문제를 단순히 전달하는 것이 아니라, 제품팀과 함께 문제를 정의하고 해결책을 만들며, 실제 서비스 변화까지 이끌게 돼요  운영 문제를 비즈니스 레벨의 기회로 바꾸는 경험을 할 수 있어요. 정책, 신뢰, 리스크, 운영 효율, 사용자 경험을 함께 바라보며 서비스의 성장과 지속 가능성에 영향을 주는 의사결정을 하게 돼요  AI Native Operations를 직접 만들어볼 수 있어요. 운영 업무에 AI를 ‘도구’로 쓰는 수준을 넘어, 문제 탐지·분류·처리·모니터링의 구조 자체를 새롭게 설계하는 경험을 할 수 있어요  자율성과 주도성을 크게 발휘할 수 있어요. 정해진 업무만 수행하기보다, 중요한 문제를 직접 찾아내고 우선순위를 정하며, 여러 조직을 움직여 해결까지 이끌어야 하는 역할이에요  복잡하고 의미 있는 문제를 풀 수 있어요. 중고거래는 단순한 거래 서비스가 아니라 사람, 신뢰, 지역, 물건, 돈, 안전이 얽힌 복잡한 플랫폼이에요. 이 복잡성을 이해하고 더 나은 시스템으로 바꾸는 과정에서 큰 성장과 성취감을 느낄 수 있어요    참고해 주세요    정규직 채용의 경우 3개월의 수습기간이 있어요  ‘장애인고용촉진 및 직업재활법’, ‘국가유공자 등 예우 및 지원에 관한 법률’에 따라 장애인 및 보훈대상자는 채용 전형 시 우대하고 있어요  직무 인터뷰에서 수행하신 사전 과제에 대해 질의응답하는 시간이 있어요    이렇게 합류해요   1. 서류 전형 → 2. 화상 인터뷰 → 3. 직무 인터뷰 → 4. 컬처핏 인터뷰 및 레퍼런스 체크 → 5. 처우협의 → 6. 최종 합격 및 입사

title: Key Account Manager/Product Specialist - Overvåkning og Sikkerhet
description: EET er en av Europas ledende distributør innen Overvåkning og sikkerhetsløsninger gjennom sterk vekst og oppkjøp de senere årene i flere europeiske land. Du har inngående kjennskap til faget, gjerne gjennom arbeide med kjente merker som Axis, Bosch, Hanwha, Hikvision, Acre , Milestone, Zenitel etc eller liknende.     Nettverkserfaring  er også ønskelig da produktområdenes team hos oss arbeider tett sammen ut mot forhandlerne.     Har du sertifiseringer innenfor noen av merkene/ områdene er dette selvsagt et pluss. title: Project Manager Cruise

Around 100 people develop and support a modular platform used by leading cruise lines — from property management and point of sale to itinerary planning, supply chain and port operations. title: Senior Product Designer, Growth
description:
About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company. We free people and agents to ship what’s next.

For more than a decade, Vercel has shaped how the web is built. As the team behind Next.js, v0, and AI SDK, we create products that help builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now, software is entering a new era, and the next generation of products will not just be used by people. They will be built, extended, and operated by agents.

We are building the platform for that future, trusted by companies like OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide. Whether you’re building our products, supporting our customers, growing our community, or shaping our story, you’ll help define what comes next.

About the Role:

You’ll help define Growth Design at Vercel and shape the complete self-serve journey: signup, onboarding, first project and deployment, adoption, conversion, expansion, and retention. The work spans people, agents, and the handoffs between them.

You’ll report into Product Design and work closely with Growth Product, Engineering and Data. You’ll have the authority and support to move from an observed problem to a working prototype, shipped experience, and measured result.

Vercel gives you unlimited access to leading LLMs and in-house tools that make product data easier to explore. If a tool limits the work, you can partner directly with its builders or improve it yourself.

This role does not come with a mature Growth Design playbook, stable briefs, or one bounded product surface. Priorities change as evidence arrives. Some experiments will not ship. Our data and tools allow us to validate hypotheses. You should enjoy finding the right problem, making something real, working through implementation, and staying accountable after launch.

If you’re based within a pre-determined commuting distance of one of our offices (SF, NY, London, or Berlin), the role includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday. If you're located beyond that distance, the role is fully remote. For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team.

What You Will Do:

  • Own the self-serve experience across onboarding, activation, adoption, monetization, and retention for people and agents.
  • Find high-impact opportunities through customer research, product data, and direct use of Vercel.
  • Co-own Growth strategy, priorities, hypotheses, and success measures with Growth Product, Engineering, and Data.
  • Build and test working prototypes using the right tools for the question, including Figma, v0, Cursor, and Claude Code.
  • Design and ship experiments, stay involved through implementation, and interpret results without losing sight of trust, accessibility, or the broader funnel.

title: Projekttechniker/in Blasformen (m/w/d)
description:
Mauser Packaging Solutions ist ein globaler Marktführer von hochwertigen und wegweisenden Verpackungen für industrielle Zwecke. Das Leistungsspektrum umfasst ein vielfältiges Produktportfolio, zu dem Kunststoffverpackungen, Fibertrommeln, Stahlfässer, Intermediate Bulk Container (IBC) in verschiedenen Größen sowie die Rücknahme gebrauchter Verpackungen gehören (Rekonditionierung). Damit bietet Mauser Packaging Solutions einen Komplettservice, der von der Produktion bis zur Wiederverwendung der Verpackungen auf Nachhaltigkeit ausgerichtet ist ("ECO-CYCLE®"). Nach dem Zusammenschluss von BWAY, MAUSER Group, NCG und ICS im Jahr 2018 beliefert Mauser Packaging Solutions mit mehr als 11.000 Beschäftigten an über 180 Standorten namhafte Kunden aus der Chemie, Petrochemie, Landwirtschaft, Pharmaindustrie und der Lebensmittelindustrie.Die Aufgaben und Herausforderungen für MAUSER wachsen.

Aufgaben

  • Unterstützung der Produktionsstandorte bei der Optimierung und Instandhaltung der Produktionsanlagen, insbesondere der Extrusionsblasformmaschinen
  • Durchführung von Maßnahmen zur Vermeidung oder Reduktion von Stillstandszeiten
  • Leitung von Projekten zur Durchführung von Reparaturen, Überholungen und Verlagerung von Produktionsanlagen; Erstellen von Termin- und Kostenplänen
  • Handwerkliche Arbeit bei Montage / Demontage / Reparatur von Maschinenkomponenten
  • Reinigung / Begutachtung von Bauteilen und bei Bedarf Einholen und Abstimmen von Angeboten
  • Koordination von internen und externen Lieferanten im Hinblick auf eine sachgemäße Durchführung der Arbeiten und die Minimierung der Stillstandszeiten in Koordination mit der Produktionsplanung bzw. der Leitung des betroffenen Standortes
  • Bewertung und Dokumentation von Maschinenzuständen sowie der daraus abzuleitenden Maßnahmen und Verwaltung eines entsprechenden Datenbestandes
  • Erstellung von Lastenheften
  • Erstellung von systematischen Wartungsplänen

description:
about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. title: Technical Product Lead - AI Investing
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

title: Asiakaspalvelutiimin esihenkilö
description: Asiakaspalvelutiimin esihenkilöksi?       Meistä      Storia Oy on yli satavuotias suomalainen logistiikkatalo. Olemme ulkoistetun logistiikan-, ja tukkumyyntialan pioneeri. Toimitamme asiakkaillemme yli 20 miljoonaa tuotetta vuosittain. Olemme kirjamaailman logististen palvelujen edelläkävijä, ja verkkokauppapalvelujen kehittäjä. Toimintamme ulottuu varastoinnin ulkoistamisesta toimituksiin, laskutukseen ja rahaliikenteen hallintaan. Digitaaliset lisäpalvelumme, kuten verkkokauppa-alusta, tukevat asiakkaitamme heidän liiketoiminnassaan. Haluamme olla asiakkaidemme ensisijainen liiketoimintakumppani. Haluamme kasvaa liiketoiminnassamme, ja laajentaa toimintaamme uusiin asiakasryhmiin.        Tehtävästä      Asiakaspalvelutiimin esihenkilönä olet avainroolissa viemässä asiakaspalveluamme seuraavaan vaiheeseen. Tavoitteenamme on asiakaspalvelu, joka hallitsee asiantuntijana palveluketjun kokonaisuutta, hyödyntää ajantasaisia toimintamalleja, tekee laadukasta ja itsenäistä asiakastyötä. Storian asiakaspalvelu toimii asiakkaan arjen etulinjassa ja on tärkeä osa palveluketjumme laatua, sujuvuutta ja asiakaskokemusta. Tehtävässä johdat tiimiä, jonka työssä yhdistyvät monikanavainen asiakaspalvelu, asiakkuuksien hoito, reklamaatioiden ja ongelmatilanteiden ratkaisu, järjestelmien käytön neuvonta sekä tiivis yhteistyö liiketoimintojen, hallinnon tukitoimintojen, ja asiakkaiden kanssa.      Arkesi asiakaspalvelutiimin esihenkilönä?       Vastaat asiakaspalvelutiimin päivittäisen työn sujumisesta, työn organisoinnista ja tehtävien jakamisesta.  Toimit tiimin esihenkilönä ja hoidat työsuhteen elinkaareen liittyviä asioita.   Motivoit, tuet ja kehität tiimiä kohti tavoitteellista, laadukasta ja asiantuntevaa asiakaspalvelutyötä.  Osallistut asiakaspalvelutyöhön ja pysyt kiinni tiimin arjessa, asiakasrajapinnan tilanteissa ja palveluketjun toimivuudessa.  Seuraat asiakaspalvelun laatua, asiakastyytyväisyyttä ja sovittuja mittareita, kuten vastausaikoja, palvelutasoa, asiakasmääriä, poikkeamia ja reklamaatioita.   Rakennat sujuvaa yhteistyötä sisäisten sidosryhmien kanssa ja viet eteenpäin palveluketjun kehittämistä sekä asiakkaiden että liiketoiminnan näkökulmasta.       Mitä toivomme sinulta?       Hyvää ymmärrystä palveluketjusta ja sen kehittämisestä, asiakkuuksista ja asiakaspalvelutyön merkityksestä liiketoiminnalle.  Halua ja kykyä johtaa tiimiä arjen tilanteissa läsnä olevalla, rakentavalla ja tavoitteellisella otteella.  Kykyä hahmottaa kokonaisuuksia, ratkaista ongelmia ja viedä asioita eteenpäin.  Hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja viestintätaitoja sekä pelisilmää toimia asiakkaiden, tiimin ja sisäisten sidosryhmien kanssa.  Paineensietokykyä, palautteen antamisen ja vastaanottamisen taitoa sekä halua vahvistaa avointa ja luottamuksellista työilmapiiriä.  Kehitysmyönteisyyttä, oma-aloitteisuutta ja kiinnostusta asiakaspalvelun toimintamallien, järjestelmien ja osaamisen kehittämiseen. Om ReData   ReData er et lille team med store ambitioner og et produkt der virker og allerede bruges af hundredvis af kunder.  Vi samler al ejendomsdata ét sted - transaktioner, lejedata, BBR, plandata og markedsindsigt og leverer det til +250 kunder: banker, realkreditinstitutter, investorer, advokater og ejendomsmæglere. Blandt vores kunder er Jyske Realkredit, Nordea, Lærernes Pension og PWC. Vi er i vækst, markedet er stort, og vi er klar til at byde flere kunder velkommen.     Vi er ikke et stort corporate team med mange lag mellem dig og beslutningerne. Du kommer ind i et lille, ambitiøst team og du sætter fra dag ét fingeraftryk på, hvordan vi fastholder og udvikler vores kunder. Vi holder til på Amaliegade i hjertet af København.      Om rollen   Som Customer Success Manager får du direkte ansvar for at vores kunder lykkes med ReData, fra de skriver under, til de er aktive brugere der ikke kan undvære platformen. Du er bindeleddet mellem kunden og resten af teamet, og din indsats er synlig fra dag ét.     Dine primære opgaver:   Onboarding af nye kunder: Du sikrer at de kommer godt fra start og forstår værdien af platformen  Løbende dialog med eksisterende kunder: Du spotter risiko for churn før det sker  Mersalg til eksisterende kunder: Du identificerer muligheder og lukker dem  Sparring med salgsteamet om kundeindsigt og feedback fra markedet  Besvarelse af henvendelser fra nye og eksisterende kunder  Løbende opdatering i Salesforce       Hvem er du   Vi forestiller os at du har et par års erfaring inden for Customer Success, Account Management, Retention eller rådgivning - gerne i en SaaS-virksomhed eller med B2B-kunder. Du forstår at fastholdelse ikke handler om at svare på support mails, men om proaktivt at skabe værdi for kunden.     Det vigtigste for os:   Du er proaktiv og du venter ikke på at kunden klager, du ringer inden de overvejer at forlade os  Du er god til relationer og ved hvordan man opbygger tillid hos beslutningstagere  Du ser mersalg som en naturlig forlængelse af god kundeservice  Du er struktureret: du logger, opdaterer og følger op løbende i Salesforce   Det er et plus hvis du har erfaring med PropTech, fintech eller ejendomsmarkedet, eller har arbejdet med kunder inden for bank, finans eller investormiljøer.        Hvad vi tilbyder    Et produkt der er efterspurgt - over 250 betalende kunder, leads og et marked der vokser  Et lille, ambitiøst team hvor din stemme tæller og din indsats ses  Konkurrencedygtig løn + attraktiv provision på mersalg  Mulighed for at vokse i takt med at vi skalerer teamet       Praktisk     Placering: Amaliegade, København    Hjemmearbejde: Efter aftale    Startdato: Hurtigst muligt        Ansøgningsproces    Stillingen udfyldes hurtigst muligt, men vi venter gerne på den rette kandidat. title: Team Manager - Corporate Services
description: Habit Health is seeking an experienced Team Manager to lead our Corporate Services team across the Wellington region. description: 쏘카 차량서비스팀을 소개합니다     차량서비스팀은 쏘카를 이용하는 모든 순간의 차량 상태를 책임집니다. 데이터 기반의 운영 개선과 정책 설계로 세차·위생 품질을 고도화하고, 사용자에게 더 나은 이동 경험을 제공합니다.   또한 장소의 제약 없이 카셰어링을 이용할 수 있도록, 차량을 고객이 원하는 위치로 배달하고 회수하는 핸들러 운영을 총괄합니다.  이번 포지션은 세차·위생 협력사 관리와 핸들러 운영을 함께 담당하며, 두 영역을 아우르는 운영 체계와 품질 기준을 만들어갑니다.     담당하시게 될 업무를 소개합니다     협력사 운영 및 성과 관리 (세차·위생)  차량 서비스(세차, 위생 등) 품질 유지를 위한 협력사 운영 모델 수립  계약·단가 협의, KPI/SLA 정의 및 품질 모니터링  거점·현장 실사를 통한 수행 품질 점검과 개선 과제 도출  핸들러 운영  차량을 고객이 원하는 위치로 배달·회수하는 핸들러 운영 전반 관리  적시 배달률(도착 지연) 개선 - 지연 원인 분석, 운영 기준·알림 체계 정비  핸들러 공급 관리 - 배차 수락률·매칭률 모니터링과 공급 부족 구간 대응  단가·할증(인센티브) 정책 설계 - 공급이 필요한 시간·지역으로 배차 유도  운영 정책 및 프로세스 고도화  현장 이슈(분실물, 차량 위생 장애, 배달 지연 등) 대응 프로세스의 구조화  지연·이상 상황 감지 알림과 에스컬레이션(CS·협력사·핸들러) 체계 설계·운영  운영 기준 문서화 및 반복 업무 자동화 과제 발굴  데이터 기반 운영 개선  빅쿼리(BigQuery)를 활용한 핵심 지표 모니터링 (적시성·품질·건당 비용)  운영상의 Pain Point 분석을 통한 개선 시나리오 수립과 예상 효과 산정  사업 및 프로덕트 부서와 협력하여 서비스 운영 시스템의 기능 개선 및 정책 반영     이런 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다     운영 기획 또는 공급망·파트너 운영 경력 5년 이상 (협력사 계약·단가·품질 관리, 또는 배송·물류·플랫폼 등 공급자 네트워크 운영 경험)  SQL(BigQuery)로 필요한 데이터를 직접 추출하고 지표를 검증할 수 있는 분 (조인·집계 활용 수준)  데이터로 문제를 정의하고 정책·프로세스 변경으로 연결해 본 분  Google Workspace 및 MS Office 활용 능력이 우수한 분  운전면허(2종 보통 이상) 보유 및 실제 운행 가능하신 분     이런 분이면 더욱 좋습니다     A/B 테스트·파일럿을 설계하고 결과를 해석해 정책 의사결정에 활용해 본 경험이 있는 분  단가·인센티브 구조를 설계하고 건당 비용 등 유닛 이코노믹스를 관리해 본 경험이 있는 분  AI 도구(Claude, ChatGPT 등)나 RPA로 반복 업무를 직접 자동화해 본 경험이 있는 분 (리포트·대시보드·데이터 정리 등)  파이썬 등을 활용한 데이터 처리·자동화 경험이 있는 분  공유 모빌리티 또는 관련 온·오프라인 연계 서비스(O2O) 종사 경험이 있는 분  현장 인력·거점 운영 등 오프라인 운영을 직접 관리해 본 경험이 있는 분  정책·전략 문서를 논리적으로 작성하고 내부 설득에 활용한 경험이 있는 분     미래의 쏘팸이 되기 위한 과정    서류 전형 → 1차(직무) 인터뷰 → 2차(컬쳐 핏) 인터뷰  → 입사 조건 협의(처우, 입사일) → 최종 합격 확정 → 입사     처우 협의가 완료된 후보자 분들께 최종 합격 안내를 드리고 있습니다.  후보자 혹은 회사의 상황에 따라 전형이 추가될 수 있습니다.  입사 후 3개월의 수습 평가 기간이 있습니다.     지원하시기 전에 꼭 읽어 주세요!     각 전형 결과는 지원 시 기재해주신 이메일 주소로 안내 드릴 예정입니다.  채용 관련 문의는 talent@socar.kr으로 보내주시기 바랍니다.  제출해주신 지원서 내용 중 허위 사실이 있는 경우 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.  해당 공고는 수시 채용으로, 채용 완료 시 조기 마감 될 수 있습니다.  국가유공자 및 장애인 등 취업 보호 대상자는 관계 법령에 따라 우대합니다.     👀   채용 중인 쏘카의 포지션 한눈에 보기

description: Vil du være med å videreutvikle Agrias salgssenter?      Agria er markedsleder innen dyreforsikring i Norge og en av Europas største aktører innen sitt felt. Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.

AI doesn’t work without real-world, contextualized data - Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.

In 1905, chief engineer John Stevens inherited one of the most ambitious infrastructure projects in history: the Panama Canal.

The challenge wasn’t digging a ditch between two oceans. It was figuring out how to move ships safely through a system of locks, gates, reservoirs, and changing conditions without bringing global commerce to a halt.

The solution wasn’t to stop movement. It was to create a framework that allowed movement at scale.

Modern financial infrastructure presents a similar challenge. Payment systems, banking products, compliance obligations, and regulatory frameworks all exist for a reason. The goal isn’t to eliminate complexity. It’s to build systems that allow innovation, growth, and customer value within it.

Since 2019, Mercury has been on a mission to reinvent banking‡ for the modern age. We blend elegant design and cutting-edge technology to offer checking and savings accounts, debit cards, payment services, credit products, cash management tools, and sophisticated analytics. Everything we build reflects our belief that financial products should be thoughtfully crafted, fast, transparent, and genuinely enjoyable to use.

As we continue expanding and iterating on our product offerings and as we work to build a nationally chartered bank, we’re looking for a Counsel, Product & Regulatory (Payments & AML) to help us navigate increasingly complex questions at the intersection of product, regulation, and financial infrastructure.

Our Product & Regulatory Legal team operates like the rest of Mercury: with urgency, curiosity, and a bias toward action.

We embed with product teams from early ideation through launch, working alongside engineers, designers, compliance partners, operations teams, and risk stakeholders to get products right. We move fast, we take ownership, and we don’t wait to be asked. If something needs figuring out, we’re up to the task.

We are not a team that sits on the sidelines reviewing finished proposals. We work alongside our partners to identify risks, unlock opportunities, and find practical paths forward. We care deeply about good judgment, strong relationships, and building frameworks that scale.

title: Service Delivery Manager
description: Als Service Delivery Manager bij Circular IT group ben je verantwoordelijk voor een aantal klanten en de dienstverlening die we voor hen leveren.     Je zorgt dat afspraken worden nagekomen, houdt overzicht en schakelt met de teams die het werk uitvoeren. Je zit er bovenop als iets niet loopt en zorgt dat het wordt opgelost.     Je bent voor klanten het vaste aanspreekpunt en weet wat er speelt. Tegelijkertijd zie je waar dingen beter kunnen en pak je dat op.      Wat ga je doen?    Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de dienstverlening richting jouw klanten  SLA’s worden door jou bewaakt en opgevolgd  Je schakelt met operations, logistiek en support  Issues signaleer je en los je op met de juiste teams  Service reviews bereid je voor en voer je uit  Je draagt verbeteringen aan in processen en samenwerking  Je houdt overzicht en zorgt dat acties worden opgepakt       Wie ben jij?    HBO werk- en denkniveau  Ervaring met servicemanagement of een vergelijkbare rol  Overzicht houden in een omgeving waar meerdere teams en processen samenkomen  Ervaring met SLA’s en het bewaken van serviceafspraken  Duidelijk en direct communiceren, ook als iets niet loopt zoals afgesproken  Structuur aanbrengen en zorgen dat afspraken worden nagekomen  Verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor de kwaliteit van dienstverlening  In staat om teams en klanten mee te krijgen in wat nodig is       Wat bieden wij?    Een salaris tussen €4.250 en €5.000 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van ervaring.  Een leaseauto of volledige reiskosten vergoeding.  Standplaats Nieuwegein met de mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken.  Een rol waarin je direct invloed hebt op hoe nieuwe klanten starten bij Circular IT group.  24 vakantiedagen en een laptop en telefoon van de zaak.  Deelname aan onze vrijwillige pensioenregeling met volledige eigen bijdrage  Samenwerken met teams uit verschillende onderdelen van de organisatie, van sales tot operations.      In het kader van de Wet Bevordering Participatie en Diversiteit nodigen wij nadrukkelijk kandidaten van diverse achtergronden uit om te solliciteren. Wij geloven in de kracht van een inclusieve werkomgeving en streven ernaar om kansen te bieden aan iedereen, ongeacht leeftijd, geslacht, afkomst, geloof, of beperking. Samen werken we aan een diverse en innovatieve werkplek waar iedereen zich thuis voelt.     Wil jij deel uitmaken van een groeiend bedrijf waar je écht impact maakt?  Solliciteer nu en versterk ons team in Nieuwegein!

Our marketplace connects parents with childcare providers. Our software and services help providers reach families, manage their programs, and operate more effectively. We also work with employers that want to help their employees find childcare.  Wonderschool is a Series B company backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Goldman Sachs, and First Round Capital. Work with product and engineering to address underlying causes and verify that solutions work.     Make the Marketplace Work     Help more families successfully connect with childcare providers. Establish consistent training and cross-training practices to strengthen team capabilities, business continuity, and customer responsiveness

title: Customer Operations Specialist (B2B)
description: Ben jij iemand die graag contact heeft met klanten, overzicht houdt en het leuk vindt om processen steeds slimmer in te richten? Werk je graag met systemen en data, zonder dat je een IT-specialist bent? Dan is deze functie iets voor jou.     Als Customer Operations Specialist zorg jij ervoor dat onze Wholesale (B2B) klanten soepel met ons kunnen samenwerken. Jij bent het aanspreekpunt voor vragen over data en digitale koppelingen en zorgt ervoor dat alles achter de schermen goed geregeld is.     Je begeleidt nieuwe klanten bij de inrichting van de samenwerking, houdt datastromen in de gaten en lost eventuele verstoringen op. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met Sales, Customer Service en IT. Jij hoeft geen koppelingen te programmeren, maar begrijpt wel hoe systemen samenwerken en vindt het leuk om uit te zoeken waar iets misgaat. Door jouw klantgerichte instelling en analytisch vermogen zorg je voor een optimale samenwerking met onze klanten én help je processen continu te verbeteren.      Dagelijks houd jij je bezig met:    Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor klanten met vragen over data-uitwisseling en digitale koppelingen.   Je begeleidt de onboarding van nieuwe wholesale klanten en zorgt ervoor dat de digitale samenwerking goed wordt ingericht.   Je bewaakt de kwaliteit van data en signaleert afwijkingen of verstoringen.   Je onderzoekt problemen en zorgt samen met collega's voor een passende oplossing.   Je stemt af met Sales, Customer Service en IT om klantvragen snel en goed op te lossen.   Je denkt actief mee over hoe processen slimmer, efficiënter en klantvriendelijker kunnen.   Je signaleert terugkerende knelpunten en komt met verbetervoorstellen.   Je helpt mee om onze B2B-processen verder te professionaliseren.        Dit breng jij mee:    HBO werk- en denkniveau.   Ervaring in een klantgerichte binnendienst-, operations- of supportfunctie.   Je vindt het leuk om met systemen en data te werken.   Je bent analytisch en zoekt graag uit waar een probleem vandaan komt.   Je kunt goed schakelen tussen klanten en interne collega's.   Je werkt nauwkeurig, gestructureerd en denkt in oplossingen. title: Guest Experience Manager
description: Buscamos un/a  Guest Experience Manager  para incorporarse a una empresa del sector hotelero y de alojamiento turístico en Granada. La persona seleccionada será responsable de  coordinar, supervisar y mejorar la experiencia del huésped en todas las fases de su estancia, garantizando un servicio personalizado, resolutivo y alineado con los estándares de calidad de la empresa.      Su  misión principal  será anticipar necesidades, crear experiencias memorables, gestionar incidencias, analizar el feedback de los huéspedes y coordinar a los distintos departamentos para asegurar una experiencia excelente antes, durante y después de la estancia.   Trabajo presencial  en un excelente ambiente laboral, dentro de una empresa sólida y comprometida con la mejora continua.       Funciones principales  : coordinación de la  experiencia del huésped durante todo el ciclo de estancia; gestión y seguimiento de incidencias; análisis de comentarios, encuestas y métricas de satisfacción; coordinación con recepción,  housekeeping  , mantenimiento, dirección y otros departamentos; formación y entrenamiento del equipo de recepción para alinearlo con los estándares de excelencia en el servicio; propuesta de mejoras para elevar la calidad del servicio; seguimiento de la reputación online y apoyo en la respuesta a comentarios en plataformas digitales.       Requisitos mínimos  :   Formación relacionada en Gestión hotelera, Turismo, Relaciones públicas, protocolo o Dirección de Empresas.  Experiencia mínima de  al menos 2 años  en puestos de atención al cliente en hoteles (guest relations, concierge), de cadena hotelera o consultora, gestionando incidencias y con trato directo con huéspedes.  Conocimiento de los diferentes sistemas de gestión relacionados con el puesto.  Conocimiento y gestión de las principales  OTA (Booking.com, Airbnb, Expedia)  y sus extranets.  Excelentes habilidades comunicativas y don de gentes.   Coordinación interdepartamental y liderazgo operativo, siendo el enlace entre recepción,  housekeeping , mantenimiento, dirección y el cliente.  Resolución de conflictos y gestión emocional.  Nivel alto en el manejo de herramientas tecnológicas de reputación online, comunicación con huéspedes y gestión hotelera  (PMS, Channel Manager, CRM, etc.) . Se valorará el conocimiento del entorno Ulyses y Septeo.  Capacidad de análisis de  feedback  y métricas de satisfacción, con orientación a resultados y mejora continua.  Proactividad y capacidad de anticipación. Orientación al detalle y a la excelencia.  Manejo de  paquete office nivel avanzado.   Idiomas:  inglés imprescindible;  se valorarán otros idiomas.  Proactividad y autonomía.       Se ofrece : incorporación a una empresa sólida del sector hotelero y de alojamiento turístico en Granada; contrato indefinido; entorno de trabajo profesional y colaborativo; participación directa en la mejora de la experiencia del huésped; oportunidades de desarrollo vinculadas a proyectos de calidad y mejora continua.

title: Customer Relationship Manager till Svea Bank
description: Vi söker nu dig som vill bli vår nya kollega i säljteamet till vårt affärsområde Administrativa och Finansiella tjänster (AFT), som hanterar ett brett utbud av bolagets företagsfinansiering. Vidare får du ett stort eget ansvar för att planera, utföra och strukturera ditt arbete, likväl som att bygga upp relationer både internt och externt som är hållbara och långsiktiga. Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer bland annat innefatta:    Delaktig vid överlämning och/uppstartsmöten av kund från säljare till produktion.  Ansvara för kundkommunikation före, under och efter leverans av produkter/tjänster.  Kontinuerligt utveckla nya affärsmöjligheter tillsammans med kunden, utarbeta nya förslag på lösningar, i enlighet med affärsområdet  Ansvara för avtalsförhandling vid förändringar och förlängningar.  Delta och bjuda in kunder till olika events och andra aktiviteter samt följa upp genomförda aktiviteter.     Erfarenheter och krav   Vi söker dig som har relevant högskole- eller universitetsexamen. Det är positivt om du har erfarenhet av att arbeta i en liknande roll samt arbetat kundnära och kund fokuserat inom bank och finansverksamhet. Vidare har du goda kunskaper i kredit-och riskarbete samt en god förståelse för regulatoriska krav med ett stort intresse för både affären och det regulatoriska processerna. Du har mycket goda kunskaper i Officepaketet samt behärskar flytande svenska och engelska, såväl tal som skrift.   Vem är du?   För att lyckas i den här rollen har du ett genuint engagemang för att skapa goda affärsrelationer och långvariga samarbeten med några av våra främsta nyckelkunder. Din förståelse för vår affär i kombination med din analysförmåga gör att du arbetar på ett strategiskt sätt med affären och kunden i fokus. Då du kommer befinna dig i många olika typer av möten och situationer ser vi att du har lätt att anpassa dig, samt är flexibel och kommunikativ. Vidare är du självgående, vet hur du ska prioritera och driva dina processer framåt och kan hålla god struktur i ditt arbete även när du har många parallella uppgifter. title: Key Account Manager
description: Iver er et ambisiøst og dynamisk selskap i sterk vekst. Vi har gründerbakgrunn og en kultur som kjennetegnes av fleksibilitet og samarbeid. Vårt mål er at kundene våre, skal anse oss som en ledende partner for digital transformasjon, og hjelpe dem til å finne rett vei til skyen. Forhandlingsmetodikk og "drive" til å levere resultater  Bransje-/vertikalkompetanse og teknisk forståelse og interesse  Kommersiell kontrakts-/juridisk kompetanse  Gode kommunikasjonsevner     Hvorfor bør du søke?   I Iver får du muligheten til å jobbe med den nyeste teknologien og være en del av en spennende vekstreise. Vi er inkluderende og tilstreber genuint samarbeid der vi jobber mot felles mål. Vi støtter din videre utvikling, enten du vil lære mer innen ditt fag, ledelse eller nye områder. I Iver vil du være en del av et ambisiøst og innovativt selskap.
