title: Trade Account Manager - Mitre10 Mega Wanaka
description: Mitre 10 Mega Wanaka    Trade Account Manager   Mitre 10 MEGA Wanaka is a dynamic and fast-growing company with a vision to provide a high level of customer service and expertise to our customers in Wanaka and the surrounding areas. This is a fantastic opportunity to join the Trade team that has been awarded "Mitre 10 Trade Store of the Year" numerous times.  Working closely with the entire Trade Team this is a key role in the relationship between customers and the business and requires a broad skill set and ability to engage with both internal and external customers. This role will be responsible for engaging with a portfolio of trade account customers and ensuring the delivery of their building material needs. This role is multi-faceted, fast paced and requires someone who is dynamic and has the talent and ability to establish customer’s requirements and liaise with suppliers and internal personnel to deliver exceptional customer experiences.   You will bring;     Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills  Demonstrated sales/account management experience in a technical environment  Demonstrated ability to pursue and secure new business  Demonstrated ability to work autonomously and as part of a team  A very strong attention to detail and accuracy  Intermediate computer/keyboard skills and ability to learn new systems and software  A true focus on customer service  Good multi-tasking skills and ability to learn and understand new products  Ability to problem-solve and maintain high customer standards under pressure  Organisation and time management skills     Practical knowledge and experience with building products and the sector would be advantageous , but not a requirement if you are willing and capable of learning technical product.   What we provide;     A positive, supportive, professional work environment  Development opportunities and growth  Great staff discounts and discounts with local Wanaka businesses    This is a full-time permanent role Monday-Friday. There is some flexibility around work hours and this can be discussed with the successful candidate.  Applicants must be either a New Zealand resident or hold a current work visa (valid at least until January 2028) and the role requires a full New Zealand drivers license.  An Information Pack is available on request.  All applications must contain a CV and Cover Letter. The Cover Letter (max 2 pages) must present detail of examples where an applicant has demonstrated skills, competencies and behaviours that would make them a strong candidate for the Role.  Email all Information Pack requests and applications in confidence to the Trade General Manager jason.watkins@mitre10.co.nz or call 027-215-5277 for a confidential discussion.  Applications close  Monday 21 September . Applications will be reviewed and considered as they are submitted.

title: Customer Success Manager
description: ¿Te apasiona el mundo de los negocios y aprender de nuevas industrias? ¿Buscas unirte a una startup con retos ambiciosos y crecimiento profesional exponencial? ¿Quieres volverte un experto en el mundo del marketing y ventas B2B?     Estás a punto de unirte en el momento más estratégico de Flows. Tras cerrar +120 clientes y validar un modelo que funciona, entramos en fase de escalado comercial.     Si alguna vez has querido ver cómo se escala una empresa real desde dentro, y ser protagonista en vez de espectador, esta es tu oportunidad.      Sobre la empresa:      En Flows ayudamos a empresas B2B a generar oportunidades de negocio mediante campañas de Cold Email altamente personalizadas. En poco más de dos años nos hemos convertido en una de las agencias de referencia del sector y nuestra ambición es clara: liderar el mercado español y seguir expandiéndonos internacionalmente.      Hemos trabajado con +120 clientes nacionales e internacionales como MAPFRE, ThePowerMBA, Continental, Sesame...       Hemos generado +7000 reuniones comerciales cualificadas para ellos a través de +2.000.000 emails enviados y estrategias outbound exclusivamente.       Hemos generado +3 millones de euros en facturación para nuestros clientes.      Operamos principalmente en España pero con proyectos también en mercados internacionales como Latinoamérica, Holanda, Alemania y Francia. Nos destacamos en la elaboración de estrategias outbound B2B, la automatización de la extracción de datos y la segmentación precisa de clientes potenciales para entregar mensajes de venta personalizados en el momento adecuado, aumentando así la conversión a llamadas cualificadas para nuestros clientes.      Descripción del trabajo:      Para seguir creciendo buscamos un Customer Success Manager con mentalidad analítica, curiosidad por entender negocios y obsesión por optimizar resultados. No buscamos a alguien que simplemente gestione clientes, sino a una persona capaz de convertirse en un partner estratégico para ellos.     Trabajarás directamente con CEOs y fundadores de empresas de distintos sectores, ayudándoles a diseñar la estrategia de outbound que impulsará su crecimiento. Cada cliente supondrá un reto diferente y tendrás libertad para experimentar, aprender y mejorar continuamente.      En qué consistirá tu día a día:       Reunirte con CEOs y fundadores para entender a fondo su negocio, su propuesta de valor y sus objetivos comerciales. title: Serviceleder til Ventilationsteamet
description: Vil du have en lederrolle, hvor du både arbejder tæt med mennesker og får mulighed for at bruge din tekniske indsigt?   Har du lyst til at være en del af et trygt og stærkt fagligt fællesskab og samtidig få mulighed for at påvirke udviklingen af vores ventilationsteam?  Så kan du måske være vores nye kollega i Ringsted.   Hvad kan du forvente hos os?     En hverdag med stor grad af frihed og variation i opgaverne  Du bliver en del af et tværfagligt team, der løfter i folk  Tæt sparring med både teknikere, kunder og interne samarbejdspartnere  God støtte under hele onboardingforløbet     Jobbeskrivelse   Som serviceleder på ventilationsområdet i Kemp & Lauritzen kommer du ind i en af Danmarks førende teknikvirksomheder. Du får en central rolle i at styrke og udvikle vores ventilationsservice – fra mindre opgaver til store serviceaftaler. Derudover vil en af dine ansvarsområder være salg til vores eksisterende kunder og have fokus på gode kunderelationer. Du vil være ansvarlig for den daglig ledelse, kundedialog, opbygge og vedligeholde serviceaftaler, reparationsopgaver og servicekontrakter, der skaber værdi for både kunder og forretningen. Du samarbejder tæt med vores dygtige teknikere og Back Office-team, der hjælper dig med de administrative opgaver.   Dine primære arbejdsopgaver     Ledelse og koordinering af ventilationsservice teknikere  Opsøgende og vedligeholdende kundekontakt både private og offentlige kunder  Udarbejdelse og etablering af serviceaftaler og kontrakter  Tilbudsberegning og materialebestilling  Opfølgning på kundehenvendelser og kvalitetssikring  Aktiv deltagelse i udviklingen af serviceforretningen  Fakturering i samarbejde med Back Office, herunder kreditering, aconto og kontrol  Budgetansvar for egne sager    Dit arbejdssted bliver i Ringsted, dog kan du forvente rejseaktivitet til vores afdeling i Hvidovre.   Hvad søger vi   Vi forestiller os, at du:    Har erfaring fra en lignende rolle inden for ventilation eller teknisk service  Har erfaring med ledelse  Har erfaring eller kendskab til servicekontrakter  Har en grundlæggende økonomisk forståelse  Er tryg ved digitale systemer  Sætter pris på samarbejde og et højt serviceniveau  Trives i en rolle med tæt kundekontakt og daglige beslutninger  Kommunikere tydeligt på dansk  Har en struktureret og planlæggende tilgang    Vi lægger vægt på, at du kan skabe en god hverdag for dine medarbejdere samt sikre en høj kundetilfredshed gennem god dialog og stærk koordinering.   Bliv en af 'Kemperne'   Kemp & Lauritzen A/S er Danmarks førende digitale og grønne teknikpartner med 3.000 medarbejdere fordelt over hele landet. Vi leverer løsninger inden for el, VVS, ventilation og køl – fra daglig service til store entrepriser og unikke specialer.  Hos Kemp & Lauritzen får du en hverdag fyldt med udfordringer, indflydelse og gode muligheder for at udvikle både faglige og personlige kompetencer. Vi tager ansvar i alt vi gør, og vi ønsker at skabe plads til forskellighed –

title: Technical Support Specialist
description: About Enfuce:    Founded in 2016, Enfuce is a female-founded and led global payments partner solving payments complexity for ambitious brands, banks and fintech leaders. Born in the Nordics and built for the world, Enfuce combines deep payments expertise with cloud-native technology to help customers launch and scale with confidence.  Enfuce is a strategic issuing and licensing partner delivering premium, flexible payment programmes across consumer, commercial and B2B use cases. Handle cardholder disputes and chargeback cases in accordance with card scheme rules, regulatory requirements and internal procedures. title: Agentic Customer Success Manager

Help shape and continuously improve Qlik’s scalable customer success model, ensuring customers across the portfolio receive the engagement, education, and support they need to realize value from their investment.     Here’s How You’ll Be Making An Impact   You’ll play an important role in improving customer health, product adoption, and revenue retention across Qlik’s scaled customer segment. Build and deliver scalable digital programs, including onboarding journeys, educational content, webinars, and automated touchpoints.  Help customers increase adoption and realize greater value from Qlik’s cloud and client-managed products. title: Technical Account Manager
description: Chi siamo      Keplero AI è una startup fondata a fine 2023 con una missione semplice: rivoluzionare il modo in cui le aziende parlano con i propri clienti.     Addestriamo modelli di AI sui dati delle aziende e li rendiamo disponibili su tutti i canali di comunicazione, incluso il telefono. Tutto è gestito da un’unica piattaforma che serve già oltre 600 clienti.      Cosa farai      Sarai il riferimento del cliente per tutto il suo percorso con Keplero: dal kick-off al go-live, fino all’adozione e al supporto continuo.      Gestirai la relazione con clienti SMB, mid-market ed enterprise, anche con interlocutori tecnici e C-level.  Tradurrai esigenze di business in requisiti chiari per il team FDE, che realizzerà configurazioni e integrazioni.  Coordinerai onboarding, priorità, ticket e aspettative: il cliente deve sapere sempre cosa succede e perché.  Condurrai conversazioni su API, integrazioni, dati, autenticazione e flussi operativi senza dover configurare direttamente ogni soluzione.  Lavorerai con Product, Sales e FDE per aumentare adozione, valore percepito e velocità di attivazione.  Migliorerai playbook, processi e comunicazioni: ogni onboarding che diventa più semplice scala su centinaia di clienti.      Non cerchiamo un project manager che inoltra richieste. Cerchiamo chi prende ownership del risultato del cliente.      Cosa cerchiamo       Esperienza concreta in Account Management, Customer Success, Implementation, Solution Consulting, Technical Pre-sales o come founder.  Ottima gestione della relazione con il cliente: sai essere chiaro, diretto e affidabile anche in situazioni complesse.  Fondamenta tecniche: sai leggere documentazione API, capire REST, webhooks, JSON, autenticazione e flussi dati.  Capacità di parlare con un CTO di vincoli e integrazioni, e con un responsabile customer service di risultati e casi d’uso.  Attitudine commerciale sana: riconosci opportunità di crescita, ma metti prima il successo del cliente.  Autonomia, pragmatismo e capacità di decidere.  Uso naturale dell’AI per preparare meeting, analizzare contesto e lavorare più velocemente.       Nice to have       Esperienza in SaaS B2B, CRM, customer service software, automazioni o AI.  Background imprenditoriale.  Esperienza con team tecnici o prodotti API-first.  Inglese professionale.       Cosa offriamo       RAL 35.000 € - 45.000 €  Ownership reale su clienti e processi chiave.  Impatto diretto su un prodotto AI in forte crescita.  Team snello, zero burocrazia inutile e spazio per proporre cambiamenti.  Crescita professionale e retributiva legata alla crescita dell’azienda.       Processo di selezione      1. First interview, 30 minuti.  2. Caso pratico: gestione di un onboarding con requisiti business e tecnici.  3. Final interview, 30 minuti. title: ERP-projektipäällikkö
description: Haemme kokeneita hanke- ja projektipäälliköitä toimimaan asiakkaidemme toiminnanohjauksen uudistushankkeissa ja niiden eri vaiheissa, streameissä ja osaprojekteissa.  Asiakkaidemme projektit ovat merkittäviä ja pitkäkestoisia liiketoiminnan ja ydinjärjestelmien uudistushankkeita, joissa pääset hyödyntämään laaja-alaista osaamistasi ja vaikuttamaan asiakkaiden liiketoiminnan kehitykseen ja modernisointiin pitkällä aikavälillä.     Goforen ERP -hankkeiden ja projektien johtajilta toivomme vahvaa osaamista sekä liiketoiminnan että IT:n alueilla, sekä taitoa toimia ihmislähtöisesti muutosprojektien johtajana. Roolissa et vastaa järjestelmän teknisestä toteutuksesta, vaan johdat kokonaisuutta asiakkaan näkökulmasta yhteistyössä valittujen toimittajien kanssa.      Tehtävästä      Projektipäällikkönä johdat ja hallinnoit asiakkaidemme suuria ja keskisuuria ERP -projekteja esiselvityksistä, teknologia- ja toimittajavalintaan sekä toteutukseen ja käyttöönottoon varmistaen korkean asiakastyytyväisyyden. Projektitiimit ovat monitoiminnallisia ja koostuvat eri organisaatioiden edustajista — vastuullasi on varmistaa toimiva yhteistyö ja avoin viestintä sidosryhmien välillä. Roolissa et vastaa järjestelmän teknisestä toteutuksesta, vaan johdat kokonaisuutta asiakkaan näkökulmasta yhteistyössä valittujen toimittajien kanssa.     Roolissasi edistät innovointia ja kehittämistä asiakasprojekteissa sekä huolehdit, että projekti etenee sovitussa aikataulussa ja budjetissa. Toimit asiakkaan luotettuna neuvonantajana ja sparraat johdon sekä projektitiimien päätöksentekoa. Toivomme, että tuot rohkeasti omat ideasi pöytään ja autat meitä viemään asiakkaidemme projektit seuraavalle tasolle.     Goforella näemme ERP-transformaation ennen kaikkea liiketoiminnan muutoshankkeena. Siksi odotamme projektipäälliköiltämme vahvaa liiketoimintafokusta ja kykyä ymmärtää eri toimialojen erityispiirteitä. Ymmärrät muutosjohtamisen merkityksen projektin onnistumisessa ja osaat ohjata sekä ihmiset että tekemisen kohti yhteisiä, kestäviä tavoitteita.  Tällä hetkellä suuri osa asiakkaistamme toimii pääkaupunkiseudulla, mutta työskentelemme myös muualla Suomessa ja kansainvälisesti. Työskentelypaikkasi voi olla joustava, kunhan olet tarvittaessa valmis matkustamaan asiakasprojektien tarpeiden mukaan.      Mitä odotamme sinulta       Vahvaa kokemusta ERP-projektien johtamisesta sekä selkeää näyttöä onnistuneesta projektitoiminnasta suurissa tai keskisuurissa organisaatioissa usean vuoden ajalta  Aikaisempaa työkokemusta konsultointirooleista, esimerkiksi ERP-, liiketoiminnan kehittämisen, teknologia- tai muutosjohtamisen konsultointitehtävistä.  Kykyä toimia ihmislähtöisenä muutosjohtajana, ymmärtäen ERP-transformaation vaikutukset liiketoimintaan, prosesseihin ja organisaation toimintamalleihin.  Kokemusta Goforelle keskeisistä toimialoista, kuten valmistavasta teollisuudesta, vähittäiskaupasta, palveluliiketoiminnasta sekä julkiselta sektorilta ja hyvinvoinnin alueelta.  Ymmärrystä M

title: Key Account Manager
description: Dette er stillingen for deg som vil kombinere relasjoner, resultater og utvikling.   Som Key Account Manager hos oss får du en sentral rolle i å skape gode kundeopplevelser, sikre langsiktige relasjoner og levere forsikringsløsninger som gir reell verdi.    Du trives med ansvar, tar eierskap til kundeporteføljen og motiveres av å skape målbare resultater over tid – gjennom gode relasjoner og riktige prioriteringer.    Om jobben     Som Key Account Manager i Region Nord får du ansvar for salg og fornyelser av næringslivsforsikringer til mellomstore bedriftskunder, i tett samarbeid med meglere og interne fagmiljø.   Du jobber rådgivende og kommersielt, og bidrar til gode kundeopplevelser, riktige risikovurderinger og langsiktige relasjoner.   Vi har ledig plass til deg på vårt kontor i Ålesund   Dine viktigste oppgaver vil være å:       Gi kvalifisert rådgivning og veiledning til mellomstore bedriftskunder, med fokus på helhetlige løsninger innen forsikring og risikovurdering.    Drive vekst og lønnsomhet i egen kundeportefølje gjennom strukturert oppfølging og gode prioriteringer    Identifisere nye muligheter hos eksisterende kunder og bidra til økt verdi for både kunden og Tryg.      Gjennomføre kundemøter fysisk og digitalt.    Koordinere med interne fageksperter for å levere helhetlige løsninger til kunden.   Representere selskapet i møter med eksterne partnere eller kunder på strategisk nivå.         Du får en rolle med mye ansvar og stor påvirkning, samtidig som du har et sterkt støtteapparat og et godt team rundt deg.    Om deg      Vi ser etter deg som trives i rådgiverrollen og som bygger tillit gjennom god dialog, struktur og som kan vise til stabile resultater over tid.  Du har en kommersiell driv og liker å skape resultater, samtidig som du jobber ansvarlig og profesjonelt i tråd med gjeldende rutiner og krav.   Du vil lettere lykkes i stillingen om erfaring fra forsikring, gjerne med rådgivning mot bedriftskunder. Men forsikring skal vi kunne lære deg. Erfaring fra kundemøter, forhandlinger og i arbeidet med å utforme gode tilbud er ønskelig. Du er nysgjerrig, lærevillig og motiveres av å utvikle deg faglig sammen med et sterkt team.    Om oss | Det handler om å skape trygghet     Tryg er Nordens største forsikringsselskap, og vi jobber hver dag for å skape trygghet for både privatpersoner og bedrifter. Hos oss blir du en del av et profesjonelt og engasjert miljø med høy faglighet og tydelige ambisjoner.   Vi samarbeider tett på tvers av roller og team, og vi er stolte av å ha en kultur der utvikling, ansvar og arbeidsglede står sterkt.  Bedrift Norge leverer trygghet og forsikringer til 42 000 bedrifter. Vi har per nå en årlig omsetning på 4,3 mrd NOK og et resultat på 700 mNOK. Forretningsområdet er fordelt på syv divisjoner, med 260 medarbeidere og ledere i Oslo og Bergen.      Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!    Send din søknad og CV innen 16. september. Vi oppfordrer til at du unnlater å vedlegge bilde i CV-en din. V

Du baust dir Sachen lieber selbst, als drei Wochen auf eine Agentur zu warten? Du hast Claude, ChatGPT und Lovable offen, während andere noch das Briefing schreiben? Dann sollten wir reden. Wir sind eine inhabergeführte Marketingagentur mit Herz, Humor und einem tollen Blick über Hamburg – und wir suchen jemanden, der digitales Marketing nicht nur versteht, sondern mit AI-Tools direkt umsetzt. Bei uns erwarten dich kurze Wege, echte Verantwortung ab Tag eins und ein Team, das Lust auf neue Tools hat. PS: auch in Teilzeit möglich.

Aufgaben

In deiner Rolle bist du die Schnittstelle zwischen Idee und fertigem Ergebnis. Du denkst mit, baust selbst und optimierst weiter. Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören unter anderem:

  • Landingpages, Funnels und kleine Tools mit AI-Buildern wie Lovable & Co. konzipieren und umsetzen

  • Tracking sauber aufsetzen und prüfen (Google Tag Manager, GA4, Meta-Pixel, Conversion- und Event-Tracking)

  • Enge Abstimmung mit Kolleg:innen aus Vertrieb, Kampagnenmanagement und Kundenbetreuung

title: Praktikant im Personalrecruiting (m/w/d)
description:
ÜBER DIE HAGEDORN UNTERNEHMENSGRUPPE

Die Hagedorn Unternehmensgruppe mit Sitz in Gütersloh ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter entlang der Wertschöpfungskette der Bauwirtschaft – mit Schwerpunkten in Rückbau, Entsorgung, Recycling, Tiefbau, Schwerlastlogistik, Flächenrevitalisierung und Digitalisierung. 1997 von Thomas Hagedorn gegründet, beschäftigt die Gruppe heute über 2.000 Mitarbeitende und umfasst mehr als 30 Gesellschaften. Mit Standorten in ganz Deutschland sowie Projekten im Ausland gehört Hagedorn zu den international erfolgreichsten Abbruchunternehmen und ist heute mit seinem breiten Leistungsspektrum in zahlreichen Bereichen der Bau- und Flächenentwicklung aktiv.

DEINE AUFGABEN

  • Bewerbermanagement: Du unterstützt unser People-&-Culture-Team bei allen Recruiting-Aktivitäten – vom Anforderungsprofil bis zur Begleitung von Vorstellungsgesprächen.
  • Talentsuche: Über verschiedene Plattformen identifizierst und gewinnst du neue Talente für unser Team.
  • Bewerbererlebnis: Du sorgst dafür, dass Bewerber:innen während des gesamten Prozesses eine professionelle und wertschätzende Erfahrung machen.
  • Kommunikation: Du erstellst Stellenanzeigen, koordinierst Abstimmungen mit Fachbereichen und hältst den Kontakt zu externen Dienstleistern.
  • Mitarbeitererlebnis: Du unterstützt bei vielfältigen Themen rund um unsere Mitarbeitenden – vom Onboarding über interne Veranstaltungen bis hin zu spannenden Personalinitiativen.
  • Projektarbeit: Kleinere Teilprojekte steuerst du eigenständig und bringst deine Ideen aktiv mit ein.

DU BIETEST

  • Ausbildung: Du absolvierst ein Studium im Bereich Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Personalmanagement, Psychologie oder bringst eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit.

title: System Administrator (Web Hosting)
company: Samsung SDS Europe Ltd. German Branch (Logistics Division)
company_normalized: samsung sds europe ltd. german branch (logistics division)
description:
SAMSUNG SDS Smart Logistics (part of the SAMSUNG Group) was founded in 2012 and is one of the fastest-growing logistics service providers in the world. As one of the most innovative companies in the industry, we offer our customers optimized solutions as well as consulting in the field of Supply Chain Management, based on our proprietary transport and warehouse management software, "Cello." SAMSUNG SDS Smart Logistics operates in 40 countries worldwide and employs more than 4,500 logistics experts.

At our Eschborn location, we are looking for System Administrator to support our warehouse!

Tasks

  • Administration of Linux and MS Windows based servers & services
  • Installation and setup of web applications and database servers
  • Setting up customer applications
  • 1st, 2nd & 3rd level support for customer servers, web applications, databases
  • Monitoring, analysis and reporting of performance and volume of the server infrastructure
  • Experience with web stack technologies (HTTP, web servers, reverse proxy, load balancing)
  • Strong understanding of OS-level security (Linux/Windows)
  • Setup and administration of Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL and MSSQL databases
  • Build, Manage, and optimize containerized environment using Docker
  • Automate configuration management, deployment, and orchestration using Ansible
  • Ensuring the integrity and security of systems and applications through the strict technical implementation of internal security guidelines
  • Regular reporting according to the respective escalation level based on the problem management metric

title: Language Lead - French (Contract)
description:
About Cartesia

Our mission is to architect AI that learns from and interacts with the world like humans do.

We're pioneering the model architectures that will make this possible. Our founding team met as PhDs at the Stanford AI Lab, where we invented State Space Models or SSMs, a new primitive for training efficient, large-scale foundation models. Our team combines deep expertise in model innovation and systems engineering paired with a design-minded product engineering team to build and ship cutting edge models and experiences.

We're funded by leading investors at Index Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners, along with Factory, Conviction, A Star, General Catalyst, SV Angel, Databricks and others. We're fortunate to have the support of many amazing advisors, and 90+ angels across many industries, including the world's foremost experts in AI.

Overview

We are seeking native-level French speakers with a linguistics background to serve as the primary language resource for voice AI in their language. You will be the trusted point of contact for all questions, quality decisions, and language-specific work related to French.

This is not a standard annotation engagement. You will own your language end to end, which includes managing annotation quality, auditing data, monitoring product performance, investigating customer-reported issues, and executing projects that require deep linguistic expertise and attention to detail. You will operate independently across these workstreams and serve as the team's go-to resource for anything related to your language.

This is an ongoing contractor engagement. Availability during some US Pacific business hours is preferred to allow for team syncs and real-time support.

Mehr als 60.000 Menschen sorgen an 480 Stand­orten in 31 Ländern dafür, dass die textilen Versorgungs­konzepte von ca. 400.000 Kunden welt­weit laufen wie am Schnürchen. Eine Glanz­leistung unserer Mitarbeitenden, die unsere Hoch­achtung verdient!   In  Deutschland und Österreich  sorgen unsere 49 Stand­orte dafür, dass Kunden aus Hotel­lerie und Gastro­nomie, dem Gesundheits­wesen sowie Industrie und Handel zuver­lässig mit Miet­textilien ver­sorgt werden. Das Head­office in Hamburg unter­stützt die Nieder­lassungen mit zentralen Services und sorgt für reibungs­lose Abläufe im Hinter­grund. So entstehen beste Voraus­setzungen für den täg­lichen Betrieb in unter­schied­lichsten Branchen. Dieses Konzept ist nicht nur wirtschaft­lich sinnvoll, sondern auch nach­haltig – und befindet sich auf einem konti­nuier­lichen Wachs­tumskurs. Wir suchen dich unbefristet als     Operations Manager (m/w/d) mit Kundenfokus     für unsere Standorte in  Chemnitz, Dresden, Leipzig, Striegistal (Böhrigen)  und  Zwickau . title: Principal Customer Success Manager, Strategic DACH
description: Overview    Working at Atlassian   Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. Engage with your customers to unlock early and sustained product adoption and success with Atlassian Solutions.  Develop and execute adoption strategies targeting high value accounts, driving change management, and expanding customer footprint. title: VP, Customer Success
description: This is a remote-friendly role. Ideally, candidates will sit in the following states: AL, AZ, CA, CO, DC, DE, FL, GA, ID, IL, LA, MA, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OR, OH, PA, RI, SC, TX, VA, WA, WI.    At this time, Tapcheck does not provide sponsorship for employment-based visas (e.g., H-1B, L-1, TN, etc.). Therefore, candidates must already possess the right to work in the United States without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future.    About The Job   The VP, Customer Success is the executive owner of Tapcheck's entire post-sale organization: Customer Support, Onboarding, Customer Success, Account Management, and Payment Operations. Reporting to the COO, you will audit the current state of each function, then architect and lead the strategy that carries Tapcheck through its next phase of growth: scaling high-volume support, rebuilding the CSM motion, standing up a proactive Account Management and expansion engine, and tying every decision back to retention and revenue.  This role is for a leader who has built these functions before and wants to build them again with real ownership. In our B2B2C model, we win the employer, then we win adoption, engagement, and trust with their employees. You'll set direction across four functions at different maturity levels while developing a team of managers who run the day-to-day. You will not own individual accounts. Early on, expect to be hands-on: sitting in on executive customer relationships and save conversations, and working alongside your managers to establish the right playbooks and standards. As the team matures and your managers grow into their roles, your involvement shifts from doing the work to coaching the people who do it.   What You'll Do    Strategy & Executive Ownership      Define and own the company-wide Customer Success strategy across the entire customer lifecycle including retention and expansion, building the playbook that will allow us to scale with excellence   Audit the current state of all four functions all with the functional leaders, then set clear priorities: what gets invested in now, what gets deprioritized, and how finite resources are deployed across SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise segments   Establish the metrics, operating rhythm, and early-warning systems that shift the organization from reactive to proactive   Draw a straight line from every CS decision to revenue outcomes, with direct accountability to the executive team     Retention, Expansion & Account Management      Define the Customer Success org structure: clarify roles and responsibilities, set performance expectations, and establish clear ownership and accountability   Stand up the Account Management function from near-scratch alongside its director, defining the operating model, account segmentation, expansion playbook, and revenue targets   Build an early warning system that identifies at-risk accounts early and the appropriate risk mitigating playbooks   Convert organic,

title: Head of Customer Growth
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Customer Growth based in Germany.   As Head of Customer Growth, you will build and lead a comprehensive operating system designed to help customers become stronger, more successful businesses. You will oversee a multi-lane function spanning Customer Success, Growth Advisory, Growth Advocacy, and Customer Enablement, setting the strategy, operating model, talent standards, and investment priorities. The role combines strategic account leadership, customer growth expertise, product adoption, education, and scalable enablement. You will determine where high-touch support can create the greatest impact while developing scalable solutions for the broader customer base. Working closely with Product, Sales, Marketing, Support, Data, and technical teams, you will turn customer insights into measurable improvements. This is a high-impact leadership opportunity in a remote-first environment, working with a diverse global customer base and a rapidly evolving digital product ecosystem.  Accountabilities    Own the Customer Growth strategy: Define how customers are supported throughout their lifecycle, from high-value strategic accounts and high-potential customers to specialist-assisted, scaled, and long-tail segments.  Build segmentation and coverage models: Use customer value, future potential, product adoption, intent, growth opportunities, risk, and strategic importance to determine the right level and type of support.  Lead through the CSM Team Lead: Establish high standards for account strategy, customer context, stakeholder management, growth diagnosis, adoption planning, commercial awareness, and execution while developing a strong leadership bench.  Identify high-potential customers early: Partner with Data, Product, Sales, Marketing, and Support to identify customers with significant future potential before revenue alone makes them obvious.  Govern Growth Advisory: Create clear processes for intake, qualification, expected impact, quality, follow-through, and knowledge reuse, ensuring specialist expertise is deployed against specific high-value challenges. Drive meaningful product adoption: Work with Product and Product Marketing to ensure customers adopt capabilities that genuinely improve their outcomes rather than simply increasing feature usage.  Establish cross-functional decision rights: Clarify how Customer Growth works with Sales, Technical Account Management, Support, Product, Marketing, and Data to ensure effective collaboration and clear ownership. Juul Labs's mission is to transition the world’s billion adult smokers away from combustible cigarettes, eliminate their use, and combat underage usage of our products. title: Full-Stack Software Engineer, Internal Services
description:
At Serve Robotics, we’re reimagining how things move in cities. Our personable sidewalk robot is our vision for the future. It’s designed to take deliveries away from congested streets, make deliveries available to more people, and benefit local businesses.

The Serve fleet has been delighting merchants, customers, and pedestrians along the way in Los Angeles, Miami, Dallas, Atlanta and Chicago while doing commercial deliveries. We’re looking for talented individuals who will grow robotic deliveries from surprising novelty to efficient ubiquity.

Who We Are

We are tech industry veterans in software, hardware, and design who are pooling our skills to build the future we want to live in. We are solving real-world problems leveraging robotics, machine learning and computer vision, among other disciplines, with a mindful eye towards the end-to-end user experience. Our team is agile, diverse, and driven. We believe that the best way to solve complicated dynamic problems is collaboratively and respectfully.

The Full-Stack Software Engineer, Internal Services builds and improves internal deployment tooling that helps Serve ship robot software safely, quickly, and at fleet scale.

Responsibilities

  • Build, test, and maintain internal web services and user interfaces that support software release workflows for engineering, QA, and operations teams.

  • Focused work on frontend, backend, cloud infrastructure and embedded software..

  • Strengthen CI/CD, automated testing, and release safety checks to improve confidence in deployment tooling and reduce operational risk.

  • High expectation on production quality clean, maintainable code and provide thoughtful PR feedback, including constructively challenging assumptions, identifying risks, and improving overall engineering quality.

  • Support production rollouts and release operations as needed, Participate in the oncall rotation for internal services.

  • Demonstrated experience delivering quality software with and without GenAl

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience with meaningful ownership of production systems, internal tools, or other high-visibility software projects.

  • Strong backend experience with Node.js or TypeScript-based ser

title: Network IT Specialist
description:
As the Network IT Specialist at Rockbot, you'll serve as the technical backbone of Rockbot's escalation function — the person the team turns to when issues are complex, environments are nuanced, or recurring problems require durable, systemic solutions.

This is a deeply hands-on technical support role for someone who enjoys solving hard problems, improving systems, and making the entire support organization stronger over time.

You'll own Rockbot's most advanced support scenarios across networking, firewall configuration, hardware, player setup, connectivity, and enterprise environments while also serving as a key partner in evolving our AI-enabled support operations.

With the rollout of Zendesk AI Co-Pilot and related automation tooling, you'll help optimize how support operates at scale — improving triage, workflows, agent efficiency, self-service experiences, and data quality. Just as importantly, you'll help close the loop: identifying patterns, improving documentation, influencing product and operational improvements, and reducing future support volume through scalable fixes.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical troubleshooting skills with systems thinking, operational maturity, and strong customer instincts. You'll partner closely with the Director of Support and cross-functional teams in Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Sales, bringing a practitioner's perspective to configuring and optimizing the systems the team relies on.

What You'll Do

Tier 2 Escalation & Technical Resolution

  • Own escalated Tier 2 technical cases across networking, firewall configuration, hardware troubleshooting, player setup, connectivity failures, and platform-level issues
  • Diagnose root cause through systematic troubleshooting and isolation techniques in complex customer environments
  • Escalate issues to Product and Engineering with clear reproduction steps, technical context, impact assessment, and supporting data
  • Identify recurring hardware or platform failure patterns and proactively surface trends and recommendations
  • Maintain clear, proactive communication with customers and internal stakeholders on status, timelines, and resolution paths
  • Meet SLA commitments for escalated tickets while proactively identifying and escalating risks
  • Participate in on-call rotation and provide occasional after-hours, weekend, and holiday coverage for enterprise escalations

Enterprise & Strategic Account Support

  • Serve as a technical resource for enterprise and high-touch accounts with complex or customized environments
  • Support pilot and trial customers through technical validation, troubleshooting, and implementation guidance
  • Participate in customer calls, Slack channels, and cross-functional account reviews as needed
  • Partner with Customer Succes

title: Division Manager, Louisiana
description:
THE COMPANY:

Juul Labs's mission is to transition the world’s billion adult smokers away from combustible cigarettes, eliminate their use, and combat underage usage of our products. We have the opportunity to address one of the world’s most intractable challenges through a commitment to exceptional quality, research, design, and innovation. Backed by leading technology investors, we are committed to the same excellence when it comes to hiring great talent.

We are a diverse team that is united by this common purpose and we are hiring the world’s best engineers, scientists, designers, product managers, operations experts, and customer service and business professionals. If the opportunity to build your career is compelling, read on for more details.

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Juul is the market leader in the e-Cigarette category with a tremendous amount of growth potential within our US Commercial organization. The Division Manager will report directly to the Region Field Sales Director in your market and lead a team of Territory Managers to maximize sales opportunities. This is an exciting opportunity to elevate sales execution within retail chain doors, independent convenience stores & specialty retailers, as well as develop your people to achieve maximum results against our mission.

In this role, the Division Manager will execute the sales strategy of driving distribution, decreasing out of stocks, improving space and locations of products, along with other sales KPIs through a team of Territory Managers with the ultimate goal of increasing revenue.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead & develop a team of high-performing Territory Managers (TMs) to achieve desired business objectives
  • Plan, organize, and execute sales strategies and Territory plans across the Division and assess both successes and failures with actionable plans for continuous improvement
  • Coach and mentor TMs to develop selling & professional skills (through goal-setting, personalized feedback, joint sales calls, individual coaching sessions, performance reviews, etc.)
  • Synthesize and communicate Division-level insights and business intelligence with the TM team, other Division Managers, Regional Sales Leadership, and supporting functions
  • Achieve KPIs set for the company, regional, and individual levels
  • Work cross-functionally with company HQ, regional HQ, and other teams (e.g. Trade Marketing, Distribution Management, Key Accounts, etc.)
  • Maintain working knowledge of pertinent local and state regulations and taxes in the Division and guide TMs on how to optimize outcomes in their local markets

PERSONAL AND PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Minimum 4 years of previous field sales experience, preferably managing teams of territory sales representatives

title: Marketing Operations Specialist
description:
Do work that matters.

At AlertMedia, we help organizations protect their people, operations, and brand. Our modern Risk Intelligence and Response platform empowers teams to detect emerging threats, assess impact, and respond with confidence. We believe building resilience should be simpler—and it starts with bringing critical information and workflows together in one unified platform.

Our core values drive us in our important mission of keeping people safe & informed:

  • We’re humans not robots
  • Customers always come first
  • We work better together
  • Simplicity is our strength
  • Our reputation is priceless
  • Hard work pays off

As one of the fastest growing software companies in the nation, we’re focused on finding the best talent and building the best team to continue accelerating our rapid growth to keep up with our demand. We’re also an AI-forward company, and we expect everyone on our team to use modern AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, and others, to work smarter, move faster, and optimize processes.

We're looking for a Marketing Operations Specialist to help build, execute, and continuously improve the campaigns that power AlertMedia's marketing engine. You'll work hands-on in Marketo and Salesforce to launch email and nurture programs, keep our CRM and marketing automation systems clean and connected, and partner with enrichment and workflow tools like Clay and Wrike to bring more automation and consistency to how the team operates. This role suits someone who is equal parts builder and troubleshooter: comfortable in the technical weeds of a platform, but just as comfortable explaining a deliverability issue or a tracking gap to a non-technical stakeholder.

  • Work collaboratively with email stakeholders to QA every send using Litmus and AlertMedia's email build standards (link accuracy, UTM parameters, tracking, and rendering) before it goes live. 
  • Build and maintain campaign infrastructure, including workflows, templates, and smart campaigns, to enable scale and consistency across marketing. 
  • Create, maintain, and audit sales email sequences in Outreach.

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 6000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
Mactores is the agent-native AWS modernization firm. We ship AWS modernization to production in weeks, data platforms migrated, legacy applications and databases refactored, AI agents running against real data, for mid-market and lower-enterprise companies in financial services, healthcare and life sciences, internet and software, manufacturing, and TMEGS.

Our delivery model is built around AI agents that absorb the repetitive 60–70% of engagement work, discovery, schema mapping, validation, test generation, cutover rehearsal, that traditional consulting bills against human hours. Forward-deployed engineers work on top of those agents, embedded with the customer's team, owning architecture, judgment, and cutover. We commit to a fixed delivery date on a fixed fee. If we slip for reasons inside our control, the cost sits with us.

Most modernization doesn't ship. Ours does. That is the entire pitch.

You'll be the named Mactores contact for AWS sales teams across US territories. AWS account managers, ISMs, partner-development managers, and specialist sellers each carry a partner deck full of firms that all say roughly the same thing. Your job is to make them see Mactores as the agent-native firm in that mix, the one they route to when their customer needs a modernization program finished, not staffed.

What you'll sell maps directly to what AWS reps care about: we're MAP-eligible, AWS Agentic AI Specialized, and predictable on fixed-date engagements. Our founders built the agent platform we deploy, so deployment depth is a structural advantage and AWS reps make money when we win. The conversation starts on the same side of the table.

You won't run deep technical demos, a forward-deployed engineer does that. You set up the meeting, frame the customer's problem, walk through the agent-native approach in business terms, anchor everything in shipped case studies, and hand off to the FDE when the conversation reaches architecture. Then you close the loop: register the opportunity, keep the AWS rep informed, push the deal forward.

This is not a script-and-cadence BDR seat. AWS reps see hundreds of partner BDRs. The ones who get traction can hold a real conversation about the customer's modernization problem, not run through a sequence.

What you will do?

  • Build coverage across AWS US sales territories: account managers, ISMs, partner-development managers, and specialist sellers (Data, AI/ML, Modernization).
  • Reach out, follow up, show up at AWS Summits and regional partner events, and build named relationships.
  • Walk AWS reps through what agent-native AWS modernization means in practice and why it's different from what every other partner in their deck says.
  • Anchor every conversation in shipped Mactores case studies: named customer, named baseline, named outcome, time-to-value, cost reduction.

title: Projektentwickler - Ostdeutschland (m/w/d)
description:
Q ENERGYs Ziel ist es, eine nachhaltige Welt mit grüner Energie zu ermöglichen. Unsere Unternehmenswerte - Verantwortung, Partnerschaft, Inklusive and "Changemaker" - sind die Grundlage für unser Handeln. Als Europas führender Anbieter von grünen Energielösungen sind wir ein vertrauenswürdiger Partner für das gesamte Spektrum der erneuerbaren Energien. Unser Ziel ist es, die Welt mit Solar-, Wind- und Hybridkraftwerken, innovativen Speicherlösungen und visionären grünen Wasserstoffprojekten neu zu definieren. 

Begleite uns auf dieser spannenden Reise, um unseren Planeten nachhaltig zu verändern.

Für unser Team suchen wir eine engagierte Projektmanager (m/w/d), die die erfolgreiche Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Wind-, PV- und BESS-Projekten von der ersten Standortidee bis zur Genehmigungsreife und Übergabe in die Realisierung verantwortet.

 

Ziel der Rolle ist es, wirtschaftlich attraktive, genehmigungsfähige und technisch umsetzbare Projekte zu identifizieren und gezielt voranzutreiben. Dabei übernimmst Du die ganzheitliche Steuerung der Projekte sowie die Koordination aller relevanten internen und externen Stakeholder und stellst die Einhaltung von Zeit-, Kosten-, Qualitäts- und Entwicklungszielen sicher.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Projektakquise und Standortentwicklung: Identifikation, Bewertung und Sicherung geeigneter Standorte und Flächen für Wind-, PV- und BESS-Projekte einschließlich Machbarkeitsanalysen und Flächensicherung.
  • Projektentwicklung und Genehmigung: Entwicklung und Optimierung von Projekten, Steuerung der Genehmigungs- und Planungsverfahren sowie Koordination von Gutachtern, Planern, Behörden und weiteren Projektpartnern.
  • Technische und wirtschaftliche Entwicklung: Bewertung von Netzanschlussmöglichkeiten, Projektlayouts und Wirtschaftlichkeit sowie Steuerung von Kosten, Terminen, Risiken und Projektbudgets.

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Identity Lifecycle
description:

You'll be part of one dedicated team, but the challenges we tackle often cross team and domain boundaries. You'll work closely with Engineers, Product, Design, Compliance, Risk, and Operations, giving you the opportunity to influence solutions well beyond your own team.

If you enjoy solving complex backend problems, working in a highly collaborative environment, improving reliability, and building scalable capabilities that enable other teams to move faster, this could be an exciting opportunity to make a real impact at SumUp.

  • Design, build, and operate scalable backend services, APIs, event-driven workflows, and system integrations.
  • Build reusable capabilities that power merchant onboarding, identity verification, and KYC/KYB regulatory data collection.

title: Senior Program Manager, Customer Experience and Defect Elimination
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the role

Every contact that reaches a customer support agent, and every credit issued to customers, represents a defect somewhere in our system. This role exists to help find those defects, trace them to their source, and work with the teams responsible to eliminate them at a systemic level.

This is a high impact senior program management role within the EMEA Customer Experience organisation, reporting to the Director of Defect Elimination and Customer Experience. The Senior Program Manager is accountable for turning customer experience signals from Wolt and/or Deliveroo markets into clear, actionable insight, and for driving the resulting fixes through to resolution with partner teams.

What you'll be doing

  • You will own the delivery of the defect elimination program across EMEA, including application of the defect driver taxonomy to identify where defect rate concentrates, and where customer outcomes are worst. You will build a clear, prioritised list of issues for partner teams to work through.

title: Receptionist (m/f/d)
description:
About HV Capital

HV Capital backs the entrepreneurs building Europe's next generation of category-defining companies. Over 26 years and 10 fund generations, we've backed more than 290 companies with over €2.8bn under management — from consumer internet pioneers like Flix and HelloFresh, through enterprise, SaaS and fintech, to today's frontier in AI and deep tech. We stay with founders from early stage through growth, and our team combines investing with hands-on platform support. We're currently investing out of Fund 10, based in Munich and Berlin.

The role

HV's Berlin office is looking for a Receptionist to own the day-to-day of our office — the first point of contact for guests, and the person keeping our office running smoothly. You'll be a steady, friendly presence in the office, handling the daily front-of-house work that keeps things running behind the scenes. This is a hands-on, in-person role at the centre of everything happening in our Berlin office.

What you'll do

· First point of contact for guests, investors, and founders — a friendly, welcoming presence in the office

· Walk through all floors each day to check on cleanliness and order, and catch anything that needs quick attention

· Restocking meeting rooms, kitchens, fridges, and pantry

· General upkeep — coffee stations, communal areas, tidy-up after use

· Watching the calendar to prep rooms ahead of meetings, and checking in on longer meetings for any additional needs

· Resetting rooms after use; sourcing food and drinks as needed

· Receiving, sorting, and distributing mail & packag

title: Senior Software Engineer, Data
description:
We are building the world's decision infrastructure: the strategic twin of every industrial organization for complex combinatorial problems. We unlocked what wasn't possible before: mapping reality with its levers and constraints into a computer, then running n-dimensional optimization on critical value-chain decisions. We help Europe stay strong and the German Mittelstand make good decisions between market shifts, orders, machines and people.

Founded by Dana (CEO) and Erik (CTO) from RWTH research, backed by a €2.8M round led by Vorwerk Ventures, with customers live on our optimization models.

We move fast. We care. No patience for problems left unsolved.

Your mission

Hi, I'm Erik, CTO of Circonomit. This ad is specific on purpose: you should be able to tell from it whether this is your job.

We build decision infrastructure for industrial companies: our customers model their production, with its capacities, costs and constraints, and we compute the answer to "what should we do?" before the decision is made.

Your mission: scale our data platform for multiple customers and domains. Customer data arrives in many formats from many sources, ERP exports included; it has to land in our system consistently, stay manageable at millions of records, and be fast to query when models and results are on-screen. The product is a data-heavy web app with a math-heavy backend (Python, TypeScript, Solid.js, Postgres, on Cloudflare): your center of gravity is data and infrastructure, but you touch the whole stack. We are looking for a system thinker who wants to shape the architecture.

We will not sugarcoat it: short deadlines, real workload, and a platform that grows while customers already run on it.

What you'll own

  • The data platform end to end: ingestion, storage, and the query paths that keep millions of records fast on screen. You design it, you build it, you run it in production.

title: Forward Deployed Scientist II
description:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Your mission

This is one of the most exciting problems in applied AI right now: take the cutting edge of machine learning, optimisation, and agentic systems, and make it work inside real businesses — not in a lab, but on live customer problems where the answer has to hold up commercially.

As a Forward Deployed Scientist II, in our Supply Chain & Retail business, you’ll work directly with some of the world’s biggest retailers and manufacturers on hard, high-stakes problems: demand forecasting, price and promotion optimisation, and supply-chain decisioning. You’ll own the science end-to-end — from understanding a customer’s messy reality to shipping something that changes how they operate.

And you won’t just deliver. What you learn on the front line feeds directly back into the products we build, so you’re shaping the capability the whole business runs on — not just solving one problem at a time.

 

What you'll do at UiPath

  • Own customer engagements end-to-end — frame the problem, build the solution, and drive it to real commercial impact, working directly alongside customer teams.

title: Senior Direct Response Copywriter (m/w/d)
description:
Wir sind Start to Finish.

Wir sind Start to Finish.

Kein Startup kann wachsen ohne das richtige Team: Aus diesem Grund unterstützen wir aufstrebende Startups und Growth Companies wie Snocks, Seller X, Mellow Noir, Pets Deli und viele mehr dabei, die Schlüsselpositionen in ihren Teams zu besetzen.

Mit über 100 zufriedenen Kunden sind wir die #1 Recruiting Boutique für Startups im deutschsprachigen Raum.

Unser Kunde sucht Dich!

Wir suchen keinen Texter. Wir suchen jemanden, der verkaufen kann.

Unser Kunde aus dem Supplement-Bereich wächst – und Copy ist einer der größten Hebel für die nächste Wachstumsphase.

Wir suchen einen Senior Direct Response Copywriter, der versteht, dass gute Copy nicht primär schön klingt.

Sie soll Aufmerksamkeit gewinnen, ein Problem relevant machen, Vertrauen aufbauen und Menschen zum Handeln bewegen.

Aufgaben

Du schreibst und optimierst unter anderem:

  • Meta- und TikTok Ad Copy
  • Hooks & Headlines
  • UGC Scripts
  • Landingpages
  • Product Pages
  • Advertorials
  • E-Mail-Kampagnen
  • Lifecycle / CRM Copy
  • Retargeting Copy
  • Offers und CTAs
  • VSL-/Video-Scripts

Du arbeitest eng mit Creative Strategy und Growth zusammen und nutzt Performance-Daten, um deine Copy kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

Woran wir deinen Erfolg messen

Nicht daran, wie viele Wörter du schreibst.

Sondern daran, was deine Copy bewirkt:

  • Conversion Rate
  • CTR
  • Revenue per Visitor
  • Revenue per Email
  • CAC
  • Performance von Ads und Landingpages
  • Win Rate von Copy Tests

Dein Ziel ist es, Messaging zu entwickeln, das skalierbar verkauft.

Qualifikation

Du passt zu uns, wenn …

  • du mehrere Jahre Dir

title: IT-Systemadministrator Microsoft 365 (m/w/d)
description:
°°°

Du arbeitest gern mit Microsoft 365, löst technische Themen strukturiert und möchtest eine interne IT aktiv mitgestalten, statt nur Tickets abzuarbeiten? Dann findest du bei uns eine Aufgabe, in der du Systeme stabil hältst, Kollegen im Alltag unterstützt und unsere IT Schritt für Schritt einfacher, sicherer und besser machst.

Dabei bewegst du dich in den Themen, die für eine moderne interne IT entscheidend sind: Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Support, Infrastruktur, Security und interne Projekte. Du sorgst dafür, dass Technik nicht nur funktioniert, sondern für deine Kollegen verständlich, verlässlich und gut nutzbar ist.

Was dich erwartet:

  • Support, der ankommt:
    Im First- und Second-Level-Support unterstützt du unsere Anwender, analysierst technische Anliegen und findest Lösungen, die im Alltag wirklich weiterhelfen.
  • Verlässliche Systeme:
    Du betreust Benutzerkonten, Berechtigungen, Arbeitsplätze, Server und Clients, dokumentierst Veränderungen nachvollziehbar und entwickelst bestehende Standards kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Moderne Microsoft Umgebung:
    Microsoft 365, Entra ID und Intune gehören zu deinem Arbeitsalltag. Du betreibst die Systeme nicht nur, sondern bringst sie gemeinsam mit dem Team sinnvoll weiter.
  • Sicherheit und Stabilität:
    Du sorgst mit Endpoint Security, Patchmanagement, regelmäßigen Backupkontrollen und sauberer Dokumentation für einen sicheren und stabilen Betrieb.
  • Guter Start, sauberer Abschluss:
    Beim Onboarding sorgst du dafür, dass neue Kollegen technisch gut ankommen. Beim Offboarding behältst du Sicherheit, Zugänge und Prozesse im Blick.
  • Projekte mit Gestaltungsspielraum:
    Neue Systeme, Rollouts und interne Verbesserungen begleitest du aktiv und bringst deine Ideen ein, wenn Abläufe einfacher, sicherer oder effizienter gestaltet werde

title: Deployment Lead - ERP Solutions
description:
What We Do

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the AI-native ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

Who We Are

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition

title: Solutions Architect
description:
About Plane

Plane's mission is to build the infrastructure the world's work runs on. Every organization runs on three things: the projects it's driving, the knowledge it keeps, and the requests it fields. Plane brings all three into one open, adaptable platform: simple enough for any team to adopt, dependable enough for organizations to build on. And we are building it for a future where humans and AI agents do that work together.

 

Plane began in public on GitHub at the end of 2022. Since then it has grown into a work management platform used by teams around the world: 55,000+ stars, 5,000+ forks, and a contributor community that reads our code and files our issues. Organizations run Plane as a managed Cloud service, on their own infrastructure, or inside fully isolated environments. Building in the open keeps us close to users and raises the standard for everything we ship.

 

Plane is the #1 work infrastructure in aerospace, defense, financial services, and other regulated industries: organizations whose requirements for control, auditability, and data residency rule most software out. When the strictest buyers pick a system of record, that choice means something. Adoption is growing fastest on Plane Cloud and in sovereign clouds, deployments that keep everything inside a country's own borders and rules.

 

Plane is backed by top investors and built across San Francisco, London, and Hyderabad. We work in tightly knit teams, stay close to users, and care about the visible product as much as the unglamorous details that make software dependable. People own problems end to end, and we add process only when it helps the work.

title: Marketing Manager (all genders)

Lumiform is a specialized software for businesses with frontline teams to run inspections, audits and checklists at scale across distributed operations. Companies like EDEKA, AmRest (Starbucks, KFC, La Tagliatella), Nordsee, Hermes or even big Testing Inspection and Certification bodies rely on Lumiform to keep standards consistently high across hundreds of locations.

Our position in the market is clear: we're building authority in answer engine optimization (AEO) for inspection and audit software. We want to be the company that AI systems recommend when people ask "what is the best inspection software?" or "What is the best software for restaurants to nail HACCP documentation" That focus is where we win. It's also where your role is essential.

You will shape how Lumiform gets discovered in large language models and answer engines. You'll work directly with our founders to sharpen our positioning and prove it through content depth, benchmark reports, and answers that LLMs actually cite. You'll execute this strategy hands-on alongside two content writers (this is not a hands off, strategy only role).

This is a strategic role for an executor. You think systematically about positioning and content architecture, then get your hands dirty building it.

Tasks

Your core mandate sits on three priorities.

1. AEO Foundation and Technical Health

  • Conduct an extensive AEO and content audit. This includes technical site audits covering infrastructure, loading times, crawlability, indexation, canonicalization, and how our site structure serves answer engines.
  • Review all content for cannibalization and duplicate content, then systematically eliminate it. Answer engines penalize sites that repeat the same answer across multiple pages.
  • Define the must-win AEO phrases and questions. These are the high-intent searches and prompts where we need to be the answer LLMs recommend. Not every keyword

description: Dignio Oy on terveysteknologiayritys, joka tuo terveyspalvelut suoraan kotiin. Dignio Prevent -hallintajärjestelmä yhdistää laitteet samaan käyttöjärjestelmään, jonka avulla hoitohenkilöstö seuraa potilaiden vointia digitaalisesti ja saa hälytyksen esimerkiksi silloin, kun potilas unohtaa ottaa lääkkeensä tai mittaustulos poikkeaa raja-arvoista. Dignio on Pohjoismaiden ainoa toimija, jolla nämä kaksi ratkaisua toimivat samassa järjestelmässä. Riippumattomat tutkimukset osoittavat konkreettista vaikutusta: muun muassa 32 % vähemmän sairaalajaksoja ja 41-62 % pienemmät kustannukset potilasta kohden vuodessa. Tiiminvetäjäksi Julaan sopii positiivinen, helposti lähestyttävä ja ahkera henkilö, jolla on valmiudet ottaa vetovastuuta tavaratalon arjen sujuvuudesta sekä muiden työntekijöiden tukemisesta. Pystythän myös palvelemaan asiakkaita sujuvasti niin suomen kuin englannin kielellä (ruotsin kieli katsotaan eduksi).  Olethan 18 vuotta täyttänyt!   Mitä Jula tarjoaa sinulle?    Jula tarjoaa sinulle ainutlaatuisen mahdollisuuden päästä rakentamaan Julan ensimmäistä Suomessa sijaitsevaa yksikköä alusta alkaen ammattitaitoisten kollegojen kanssa. description: About AI Acquisition      AI Acquisition is a bootstrapped, founder-led business helping founders and operators scale with AI, combining a sales and delivery engine, one-to-one consultation, and our own SaaS platforms. We move fast, we build constantly, and we hold a high bar for the people who work directly with our clients.     We currently manage thousands of active clients across multiple products, with 250+ new clients onboarding every month. The Account Management function is the front line of that relationship.      The Role      You are the person between the client and the outcome. Not a relationship manager. Not a check-in scheduler. Not someone who forwards tickets and hopes for the best.     You own a portfolio of clients who are building real businesses with our support. Some are launching for the first time. Some are scaling. Some are stuck and frustrated. Your job is to diagnose where they actually are, figure out what's blocking their progress, manage their expectations when needed, and drive them toward commercial results, not just activity. If a client's campaign is generating calls but nobody's closing, you need to be able to tell them why and what to do about it, not pass it to someone else.     Our clients purchase a fully built AI lead-generation business: brand, website, funnel, lead engine, and the systems that help turn leads into customers. You own the relationship around that delivery. You need to know what they bought, what was promised, where they are in the journey, and what needs to happen next, with specifics, not generalities.     You'll work directly with clients on Zoom, Slack, and through our internal systems. You'll run growth workshops, intro calls, and quick syncs. You'll manage escalations without panicking and celebrate wins without coasting. And when a client is about to walk, you'll be the person who finds the path to keep them or makes the honest call that they should go. title: Responsable rétention e-commerce complément alimentaire
description: Type de poste :  plein temps, long terme, remote (Europe). Présentiel possible à Genève, pas indispensable.   Disponibilité :  présence fiable sur les horaires européens   Rémunération :  selon votre expérience, vos résultats prouvés et la valeur que vous créez    Candidature :  uniquement via le formulaire en bas de page     Wellmark recrute un(e) responsable rétention & CRM pour prendre en charge la relation avec nos clients après leur premier achat, sur l'ensemble de nos marques.     Wellmark est un groupe suisse qui conçoit et vend des compléments alimentaires en direct depuis 2015. Plusieurs marques, une équipe réduite et entièrement à distance, et une culture de la donnée : on mesure tout, on teste beaucoup, on décide avec les chiffres.     On a construit une machine d'acquisition qui recrute des clients tous les jours sur différents canaux payants. On veut maintenant construire la meilleure rétention du DTC nutrition en Europe francophone, et on cherche la personne qui a une réelle expérience dans ce domaine.     Le cœur du poste, c'est comprendre une base de clients et les rendre fidèles : expérience après l'achat, communication, offres, abonnement, réactivation. On peut vous apprendre nos produits, nos outils et nos données. On ne peut pas vous apprendre le jugement, l'obsession du client et le sens commercial.  Vous pouvez venir de la rétention e-commerce, du CRM, du lifecycle marketing, de l'email en réponse directe, ou de la data avec une vraie obsession de la communication client. L'expérience en compléments alimentaires, beauté ou alimentaire est un réel plus.      Vous devez aussi être à la pointe de l'IA. On ne cherche pas quelqu'un qui colle un brief dans ChatGPT et nettoie le résultat. On cherche quelqu'un qui a construit un vrai système de travail assisté par IA, pour l'analyse, la segmentation et le contrôle qualité, qui sait où le jugement humain compte, et qui s'en sert pour produire plus et mieux sans jamais produire du générique.      Le résultat que vous possédez   Transformer une base d'acheteurs en une base de clients qui reviennent, et en répondre sur trois chiffres : le taux de rachat, la valeur d'un client sur douze mois, la part du chiffre d'affaires générée par la base. Pour ça, vous devez :   connaître la base mieux que quiconque dans l'entreprise, avec des segments et des cohortes qui servent à décider ;  construire une expérience après l'achat qui aide chaque client à réussir sa cure, à le constater, et à savoir à quoi il le doit ;  faire racheter : offres, abonnement, réassort, gamme, réactivation ;  produire une communication que les clients lisent, en français, dans un ton qui sonne juste pour chaque marque ;       Ce que vous ferez    Lire ce que disent les clients : avis, tickets support, sondages, verbatims, données de parcours. En tirer des segments et des décisions.  Concevoir et piloter le parcours après l'achat : onboarding, contenus de cure, supports physiques dans le colis, demandes d'avis...

title: Customer Success Manager
description: 🌍 La mission de Steeple    Chez Steeple, notre mission est simple :  améliorer l'accès à l'information de millions de collaborateurs, partout dans le monde. En aidant les entreprises à mieux communiquer avec tous leurs salariés, y compris ceux qui n’ont ni ordinateur, ni téléphone professionnel.   Grâce à quoi ?   Une solution phygitale : pas juste une appli mobile, pas un intranet de plus, mais une plateforme aussi accessible sur de grands écrans tactiles, installés au cœur des lieux de travail.   Le résultat ?   Fini les vieux panneaux d’affichage que personne ne lit.  Chaque collaborateur est enfin informé, considéré, engagé.    🚀 Une ambition assumée    Oui, notre mission est ambitieuse.  Mais on avance déjà bien :   👉 Plus de 1500 entreprises équipées  👉 Dans une vingtaine de pays  👉 350 000 collaborateurs touchés   Et on fait tout ça depuis  Rennes, sans levée de fonds, sans injonctions d’investisseurs, en autofinancement total .  Pas pour faire joli.  Parce qu’on croit à la liberté de construire à notre manière.   Créer un leader mondial des logiciels depuis Rennes et en autofinancement ?   Personne ne l’a fait.   Alors on le tente.   Mais ce genre de projet, avec cette ambition-là,  ça ne marche que si la culture d’entreprise est vraiment spéciale . Le résultat que vous possédez   Transformer une base d'acheteurs en une base de clients qui reviennent, et en répondre sur trois chiffres : le taux de rachat, la valeur d'un client sur douze mois, la part du chiffre d'affaires générée par la base. title: Senior CRM Manager (Monetisation)
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior CRM Manager (Monetisation) based in Switzerland.   As a Senior CRM Manager, you’ll take ownership of CRM-led monetization initiatives designed to accelerate revenue and strengthen customer lifetime value. You’ll combine strategic thinking with hands-on campaign execution across the full customer lifecycle. Your work will span acquisition, conversion, engagement, retention, and win-back journeys, supported by rigorous experimentation and data analysis. You’ll play a key role in building scalable CRM processes, optimizing campaign performance, and ensuring reliable technical execution. Close collaboration with Growth, Analytics, Design, and Engineering teams will allow you to connect CRM strategy with broader product and business goals. This is an opportunity to make a measurable commercial impact in a fast-moving, data-driven, and highly experimental environment.  Accountabilities    Lead and execute CRM monetization initiatives and campaigns, taking ownership of projects designed to generate measurable revenue growth.  Design, optimize, and manage customer lifecycle journeys across acquisition, conversion, engagement, retention, and win-back stages.  Take a hands-on approach to CRM operations, independently managing high volumes of campaigns and ensuring accurate, timely, and seamless execution.  Develop sophisticated audience segmentation and communication strategies, continuously testing and refining approaches based on performance.  Build and maintain a robust A/B testing framework to evaluate hypotheses, measure outcomes, and identify opportunities for improvement.  Monitor CRM performance metrics and analyze campaign results to generate actionable insights and recommendations.  Manage the technical CRM setup, including campaign automation, workflow configuration, integrations, and deliverability optimization.  Troubleshoot campaign and technical issues and collaborate with Engineering teams when additional technical support is required.  Work closely with Growth, Design, Analytics, Product, and Engineering teams to align CRM initiatives with wider business and commercial objectives.  Identify opportunities to improve user journeys, operational processes, campaign efficiency, and monetization performance.  Maintain a balance between strategic planning and hands-on execution, taking ownership from initial concept through implementation and analysis.  Continuously introduce new ideas, experiments, and approaches that improve CRM effectiveness and commercial outcomes.     Requirements     5+ years of professional CRM experience, combining strategic communication planning with hands-on campaign execution.  Strong monetization mindset, with the ability to assess CRM initiatives based on revenue potential, customer value, and measurable business impact.  Proven experience managing customer lifecycle strategies

description: About Wolt   At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.  Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.   About The Role   Every contact that reaches a customer support agent, and every credit issued to customers, represents a defect somewhere in our system. This role exists to help find those defects, trace them to their source, and work with the teams responsible to eliminate them at a systemic level.  This is a high impact senior program management role within the EMEA Customer Experience organisation, reporting to the Director of Defect Elimination and Customer Experience. The Senior Program Manager is accountable for turning customer experience signals from Wolt and/or Deliveroo markets into clear, actionable insight, and for driving the resulting fixes through to resolution with partner teams.  What you’ll be doing    You will own the delivery of the defect elimination program across EMEA, including application of the defect driver taxonomy to identify where defect rate concentrates, and where customer outcomes are worst. You will build a clear, prioritised list of issues for partner teams to work through.  You will represent the voice of the customer in the rooms where decisions get made about your markets. That means preparing and presenting data in product reviews, weekly/monthly business reviews and planning sessions, so the cost of poor customer experience is concrete and attributable, and so partner teams understand what is being asked of them and why.  You will build working relationships with partner teams in engineering, marketplace operations, courier operations, and finance, and you will track the fixes they commit to through to completion. You will feed results back into the program so everyone can see what worked, and to ensure defects are eliminated for good.  You will maintain and improve the data infrastructure and reporting that underpins this work, ensuring customer experience insights are credible, available and actionable.
